listings.rawTitle: Guerlain L'Heure Bleue Eau De Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Guerlain L'Heure Bleue Eau De Parfum (75ml) is an amber floral EDP for women, mysterious, elegant and timeless, which reflects that time of the day when day embraces night and the resulting silence embraces the world, spreading harmony.The composition opens with a spicy-sweet melange of Aniseed and fresh Bergamot, leading on to an overtly soft and powdery floral heart of Rose, Carnation, Tuberose, Violet and Neroli. This culminates in a base of creamy Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Iris and Benzoin. The fragrant liquid is housed in an inverted heart flacon adorned with graceful scrolls. The stopper is shaped like a hollow heart which alludes to romantic pre-war years. Top Notes: Anise, Neroli, Coriander, Bergamot and Lemon. Heart Notes: Heliotrope, Carnation, Violet, Cloves, Neroli, Ylang-Ylang, Bulgarian Rose, Jasmine, Orchid and Tuberose. Base Notes: Iris, Vanilla, Benzoin, Sandalwood, Tonka Bean, Musk and Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Oud & Spice Eau De Parfum 180ml
listings.description: Acqua Di Parma Oud & Spice Eau De Parfum (180ml) is a masterful blend of the luxurious Oud essence and the brightness of citrus, presenting an opulent and artistic olfactory experience.This EDP starts with the rare Oud Oil, extracted from the Aquilaria tree's resin, sourced from Laos, and known for its unparalleled smoothness and balance. The composition is further enriched by the warm and spicy notes of Cinnamon and Cloves, creating an unexpected and enveloping scent profile. Bright Bergamot and lively Pink Pepper add luminosity to the blend, while Raspberry introduces a delectable, addictive sweetness. The scent journey concludes with the richness of Rose, the earthy depth of Patchouli, and the sweet, resinous undertones of Cisto Labdanum, weaving together an unforgettable tapestry of olfactory delight, reminiscent of the sun's warmth encapsulating the profound essence of Oud. Top Notes: Bergamot, Raspberry and Rose. Heart Notes: Cinnamon, Pink Pepper and Cloves. Base Notes: Agarwood Oil, Patchouli and Cisto Labdanum.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Oud Eau De Parfum 180ml
listings.description: Acqua Di Parma Oud Eau De Parfum (180ml) is an intense oriental and woody EDP inspired by the warm and deep notes of Agarwood's rare oud essence, at once vigorous and precious.This artistic combination is refined by luminous citrus notes which bring together the richness of the Aquilaria tree's Agarwood with notes of Russian Coriander and Haitian Amyris Wood. Top Notes: Bergamot and Orange. Heart Notes: Haitian Amyris Oil, Russian Coriander and Agarwood Oil (Oud). Base Notes: Cedarwood, Leather accord, Patchouli Oil, Sandalwood and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro The Most Wanted Intense Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Azzaro The Most Wanted Intense Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a sophisticated, woody EDP for men which expresses his enigmatic charisma and perpetual joie de vivre.This sensual olfactory melange serves as the ultimate weapon of seduction with its aromatic, vibrant Cardamom opening leading on to irresistibly sensual, creamy Caramel Accords in the heart. This culminates in a masculine trail of Amber Wood in the long-lasting drydown. The liquid is housed in Azzaro's emblematic, barrel-shaped fragrance bottle in deep, matte black for added masculinity. Top Notes: Caradamom. Heart Notes: Caramel Accord. Base Notes: Amber Wood.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Wanted Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Azzaro Wanted Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a woody, aromatic and spicy EDP for men which combines contrasting hot and fresh sensations. Inspired by a hedonistic lifestyle, this scent 'immerses you in the thrill of the game and its immersive universe.' Replicating the stimulating smell of adrenaline, this scent conveys a bold and brave wearer who instinctively journeys in search of a thrill. The spicy-woody composition combines warm spices with aromatic notes.It opens with refreshing and invigorating, aromatic Juniper Berries, leading on to a heart of earthy, herbaceous Sage. This culminates in an intensely warm and strong, woody Vetiver in the base. The emblematic and masculine Azzaro bottle has been produced in silver metal with a touch of gold. Top Notes: Juniper Berries. Heart Notes: Sage. Base Notes: Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Britney Spears Midnight Fantasy Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Britney Spears Midnight Fantasy Eau De Parfum (30ml) is part of the iconic pop princesses' collection of youthful women's fragrances - created for those who are as seductive, charming and elusive as the superstar herself.Fantasy Midnight is a more intense take on the popular Fantasy fragrance, featuring a passionate aroma that lasts through the night. This fruity and floral women's EDP is a limited-edition fragrance that captures the mischievousness of young love - where the magic begins at midnight. This women's perfume is encased in a rounded, dark blue bottle speckled with Swarovski crystals, and features interlocking rings at the neck that symbolise togetherness. Top Notes: Plum, Sour Cherry and Raspberry. Heart Notes: Iris, Orchid and Freesia. Base Notes: Amber, Musk and Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Afnan 9am Pour Femme Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Afnan 9am Pour Femme Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an irresistible delight for those who adore the luscious allure of fruits. This EDP for women turns an ordinary day into an enchantingly scented journey with its delicious, juicy fruit notes.It is a refreshing, light, and invigorating creation that radiates sophistication and elegance. It is ideally suited for everyday wear, ensuring you feel confident and rejuvenated throughout the day. The scent opens with vibrant top notes of Mandarin Orange, Bergamot, and Grapefruit, introducing an immediate burst of freshness. The journey continues with the heart notes of Black Currant and Raspberry, adding a rich and tantalising depth. Finally, the fragrance settles into the warm and comforting base notes of Musk, Amber, and Orange, leaving a lasting and memorable impression.Inspired by Ralph Lauren Pour Femme. Top Notes: Mandarin Orange, Bergamot and Grapefruit. Heart Notes: Black Currant and Raspberry. Base Notes: Musk, Amber and Orange.

listings.rawTitle: Ariana Grande Thank U Next Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Ariana Grande Thank U Next Eau De Parfum (50ml) is all about going out and getting what you want. It is about learning from the past, living life on your own terms, and not being afraid to move on.Outspoken, playful yet cool, this is the EDP for learning, loving, and living life to the full with your best mates and not being afraid to say, Thank U, Next! The delightful fragrance opens with juicy notes of sparkling White Pear and Raspberry, which blend seamlessly into the heart of creamy Coconut and delicate Pink Rose Petals. Macaroon Sugar and a Velvet Musk finish the lively scent that lasts long into the night. Cruelty-free. Top notes: White Pear and Wild Raspberry. Heart notes: Creme De Coconut and Pink Rose Petals. Base notes: Macaroon Sugar and Velvet Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Boucheron Pour Homme Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Boucheron Pour Homme Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a floral, fruity EDP for men, a refreshing masculine scent, citrus and woodsy with sweet floral olfactory notes. Refined and sensual, it is a timeless expression of sophistication and prestige.The composition opens with a fruity floral melange combining zesty Lemon, Mandarin and Orange with the freshness of Bergamot and aromatic Lavender. This leads on to an overtly floral heart contrasting with the powdery earthiness of Orris Root, before culminating in a warm, woody and earthy drydown with Sandalwood, Incense, Vetiver and Oakmoss. Top Notes: Lemon, Lemon Verbena, Bergamot, Lavender, Orange, Basil and Mandarin Orange. Heart Notes: Rose, Carnation, Jasmine, Ylang-Ylang, Lily-of-the-Valley and Orris Root. Base Notes: Oakmoss, Vetiver, Incense, Sandalwood, Musk, Benzoin, Amber and Tonka Bean.

listings.rawTitle: Billie Eilish Eilish By Billie Eilish Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Eilish By Billie Eilish Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an amber, vanilla EDP for women with a seductive, sensual character, personified by the iconic bottle, crafted in the voluptuous and alluring shape of a female upper torso. The first fragrance launched by renowned music artist Billie Eilish, this fragrance was launched in 2021 and has rapidly gained popularity due to its enticing, sweet notes offset by the warm, ambery hues. Opening with a sweet and fruity, floral melange of Mandarin, Red Berries and Sugar, the composition leads on to a creamy, sensual heart of Vanilla, Rose and Cacao. This culminates in a woody, musky dry down where Tonka Bean melds with Amber. Cruelty-free & vegan-friendly. Top Notes: Sugar, Red Berries and Mandarin Orange. Heart Notes: Vanilla, Cacao, Spicy Notes and Rose. Base Notes: Tonka Bean, Amber, Musk and Woody Notes.

listings.rawTitle: Mugler Angel Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Mugler Angel Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a floral, fruity EDP for women which is an ode to sensuality, depicting a bold, alluring, and seductive wearer.This composition opens with a celestial facet in the form of a delicate swirl of Calabrian Bergamot notes. This progresses to a delicious facet at the heart with irresistible gourmand notes of Praline blended with zestier Red Fruit notes. The scent concludes with a voluptuous facet in the base with a trail of sensual Vanilla and Patchouli. Top Notes: Bergamot and Helional. Heart Notes: Fruit and Honey. Base Notes: Vanilla, Chocolate, Caramel and Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a floral, woody musk EDP for women which seeks to reflect their desire to attract and seduce. This sweet, lustful character emanates from the sensual Musk in its heart with a Rose note in the top. A mysterious, rich character is introduced by the exotic woods in the base, blending Sandalwood and Patchouli. The fragrance is packaged in a pink bottle with seductive black box. Top Notes: Rose and Peach. Heart Notes: Musk and Amber. Base Notes: Patchouli and Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Amber Men Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Prada Amber Man Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a fresh and authentic, floral EDT for men, as timeless as it is luxurious. Rich and opulent in its composition, this light and refreshing fragrance seamlessly blends powerful floral notes with warm, refined Suede Accords to create a perfume that is an enduring ode to classic masculinity.This fragrance opens with refined notes of Neroli, Cardamom, Bergamot and Mandarin Orange, eventually leading to a rich heart of Myrrh, Musk, Orange Blossom, Geranium and Vetiver. The dry down reveals a warm, woody base of Saffron, Vanilla, Leather, Tonka Bean, Sandalwood and Patchouli. The fragrance is housed transparent glass bottle, decorated with a silver plaque describing the composition of the untapped brilliance held within. Top Notes: Neroli, Cardamom, Bergamot and Mandarin Orange. Heart Notes: Myrrh, Musk, Orange Blossom, Geranium and Vetiver. Base Notes: Saffron, Vanilla, Labdanum, Leather, Tonka Bean, Sandalwood and Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Mugler Angel Eau De Parfum Refill 100ml
listings.description: Mugler Angel Eau De Parfum Refill (100ml) is a floral, fruity EDP for women which is an ode to sensuality, depicting a bold, alluring, and seductive wearer.This composition opens with a celestial facet in the form of a delicate swirl of Calabrian Bergamot notes. This progresses to a delicious facet at the heart with irresistible gourmand notes of Praline blended with zestier Red Fruit notes. The scent concludes with a voluptuous facet in the base with a trail of sensual Vanilla and Patchouli. Presented in an easy-to-use refillable bottle to be kind to our planet. Top Notes: Bergamot and Helional. Heart Notes: Fruit and Honey. Base Notes: Vanilla, Chocolate, Caramel and Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Black XS Pour Homme Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Paco Rabanne Black XS Pour Homme Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a sensual, seductive, woody EDT for men which is expressly masculine despite its sweet undertones. Sultry and distinctive, it is at once bold and enduring which makes it perfect for evening wear.Opening with a citrus, herby blend of Lemon and Sage, it leads on to a heart of Praline, Cinnamon and Cardamom. This culminates in a woody, earthy dry down of Rosewood, Amber and Patchouli. Top Notes: Lemon and Sage. Heart Notes: Praline, Cinnamon, Black Cardamom and Tolu Balsam. Base Notes: Brazilian Rosewood, Black Amber and Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Luna Rossa Carbon Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Prada Luna Rossa Carbon Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a spicy, woody fragrance for men which conveys extreme masculinity and a relentless quest for inspiration and achievement.Personifying strength like the darkest rock, mixed with the freshness of air, this EDT unites steam-distilled botanicals and synthetics in a mineral-rich composition. The scent opens with refreshing Bergamot and Pepper, leading on to a heart of fragrant Lavender mixed with the earthy tones of Coal and Soil Tincture. This culminates in the warmth of the Ambroxan base, depicting indulgence and luxury. Top Notes: Bergamot and Pepper. Heart Notes: Lavender, Metallic Notes, Coal, Watery Notes and Soil Tincture. Base Notes: Ambroxan and Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Prada L'Homme Eau De Toilette 150ml
listings.description: Prada L'Homme Eau De Toilette (150ml) is an amber, aromatic fragrance for men which compliments the subtle masculinity of the contemporary man. A fragrance defined by contrast and complementarity, this EDT is an instant classic male Fougere, encompassing notes of Neroli and Geranium, whilst a feminine hint is alluded to by Prada signatures of Amber and Iris.Opening with, floral and woody notes, this perfume challenges traditional idea of gender roles, completely subverting the old-age view of masculinity. Neroli, Black Pepper, Cardamom and Carrot Seed initially entices the senses, before a floral heart of Iris, Violet, Geranium and Mate hints at the fragrances sheer sensibility. The fragrance finally settles on a woody base of Amber, Cedar, Patchouli and Sandalwood. The fragrance is housed in a bottle of classic Prada design, accentuated by silver tone accents and finish in a wrapping of Saffiano Leather. Top Notes: Neroli, Black Pepper, Cardamom and Carrot Seeds. Heart Notes: Iris, Violet, Geranium and Mate. Base Notes: Amber, Cedar, Patchouli and Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Paco Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Paco Rabanne Paco Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a woody aromatic fragrance for the relaxed, casual man - sunny and uplifting in character.Paco EDT opens with the soothing, comforting herbal smell of Rosemary and Clary Sage, leading on to a floral heart where powdery Lavender and leafy-rose Geranium combine. This culminates in a sweet, musky base with the earthy undertones of Oakmoss. Top Notes: Rosemary, Clary Sage and Brazilian Rosewood. Heart Notes: Tonka Bean, Lavender and Geranium. Base Notes: Honey, Amber, Musk and Oakmoss.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne One Million Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Paco Rabanne 1 Million Parfum (50ml) is a floral leather men's fragrance that captures the essence of sun-drenched charm, pushing boundaries and playing with the senses. Intensely masculine, this parfum contrasts the duality of salty notes with the warmth of leather. The amber heat enhances its sensuality, reminiscent of skin that's been kissed by the sun. 1 Million Parfum is not just addictive but also bold, exaggerated, and designed for those who dare to stand out in the crowd.The fragrance plays between the salty pulse of Salty Tuberose, Ambroxan, and Cashmeran, leading to the leathery opulence of Sun-drenched Leather and Citrus Resin. Housed in a 1 Million ingot bottle with extreme lines cut from glass and gold, it epitomises opulence and audacity. The golden hue shines with extreme radiance, capturing light and making its presence known, a true emblem sculpted in metal. Top Notes: Salty Tuberose, Ambroxan, and Cashmeran. Heart Notes: Sun-drenched Leather and Citrus Resin. Base Notes: Amber Heat.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Pour Homme Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Paco Rabanne Pour Homme Eau De Toilette (100ml) is an aromatic, woody EDT for men which is perfect for casual, everyday wear. Launched in 1973, it has become a classic fragrance choice with a cult following attracted by the spicy tone which lends a cool, modern edge.Opening with top notes of Brazilian Rosewood, Clary Sage, and Rosemary, it leads on to a heart of Geranium, Lavender, and Tonka Bean. This culminates in a dry down of Honey, Amber, Musk and Oakmoss. It is presented in what has become an iconic, simple green glass bottle. Top Notes: Rosemary, Clary Sage and Brazilian Rosewood. Heart Notes: Lavender, Geranium and Tonka Bean. Base Notes: Oakmoss, Honey, Musk and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Nina Ricci Eau De Toilette 80ml
listings.description: Nina Ricci Eau De Toilette (80ml) is a vegan-friendly, fruity floral EDT for women which uses the playfulness of a Toffee Apple note to evoke the irresistible temptation of the forbidden fruit.Bright, sparkling and exuding positivity, the composition opens with a zesty citrus melange of Italian Lemon and Caipirinha Lime. This uplifting opening leads on to a delicious, gourmand heart of Toffee Apple, the crunchy Caramel balanced expertly with green and creamy Gardenia. This culminates in a drydown of dazzling sensuality with voluptuous Cedarwood embracing rich, warm White Musk. This scent contains 90% natural origin ingredients. The iconic, apple-shaped Nina bottle has a glossy translucent pink finish decorated with a precious silver cap. Top Notes: Lemon and Lime. Heart Notes: Gardenia and Toffee Apple. Base Notes: Cedarwood and White Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Pure Musc Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Pure Musc Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a floral, woody fragrance for women which combines sophistication and delicacy in an addictive scent which seeks to convey feminine purity and strength. A sublime heart of Musc is augmented with a white floral bouquet while Cashmeran at the base lends warmth. The frosted white lacquer bottle with black cap perfectly symbolises this paradox of strength and softness. Top Notes: Jasmine and Orange Blossom. Heart Note: Heart of Musc. Base Note: Cashmeran, Amber and Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Luna Rossa Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Prada Luna Rossa Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a fruity aromatic EDT for men with a warm sensuality which was named after the stunning Luna Rossa yacht which participates in the America's Cup competitions. The fragrance takes inspiration from this innovative, maritime world of extreme competition, bestowing prestige on the wearer.The composition centres on the key note of Lavender, blending with classical notes in fresh and intense combinations. The scent opens with the fresh and invigorating duo of Lavender Absolute and Bitter Orange, leading on to a herbal heart of Clary Sage and Spearmint . This culminates in a woody, musky dry down of Ambrette Absolute and Ambroxan Molecule in the base. Top Notes: Lavender and Bitter Orange. Heart Notes: Mint and Clary Sage. Base Note: Ambrette (Musk Mallow) and Ambroxan.

listings.rawTitle: Prada L'Homme Intense Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Prada L'Homme Intense Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a more intense, masculine composition which takes its main body fragrance from Prada's L'Homme Eau De Toilette. An ambery, woody fragrance complimented by Tonka Bean facets, this fragrance promises to delve into the essence contemporary masculinity, with seemingly juxtaposing notes becoming an ode to the man who is self-assured, experimental and ready to try something new.The EDP opens with glowing notes of Amber, before developing into a heart of Patchouli and Iris before resting on a woody base of Sandalwood and Roasted Tonka Bean. The fragrance is housed in a matte black bottle, stoppered by a simple chrome stop-top and decorated with silver tone detailing. Top Notes: Amber. Heart Notes: Amber and Patchouli. Base Notes: Sandalwood and Roasted Tonka Bean.

listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Polo Black Eau De Toilette 125ml
listings.description: Ralph Lauren Polo Black Eau De Toilette (125ml) is part of the iconic US fashion house's signature collection of men's fragrances. The scent is inspired by the masculinity of a sporting lifestyle - with a more modern edge than the original classic.The fragrance is described as scent for the urban, professional man - a new expression of Polo that expresses mysterious sensuality with a hint of danger. The woody men's fragrance is created by blending herbaceous notes with distinctly masculine undertones that last throughout the day and leave a memorable impression. This EDT comes packaged in the timeless Polo bottle - coloured black with an instantly recognisable silver emblem. Cruelty-free. Top notes: Iced Mango, Mandarin, Lemon, and Cardamom. Heart notes: Jasmine Accord, and Silver Armoise. Base notes: Patchouli Noir, Tonka Bean, and Cedarwood.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Pure Musc Eau De Parfum 100ml

listings.description: Paloma Picasso Mon Parfum Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a powerfully evocative floral women's EDP which is perfect for those wishing to display a bold and daring aura.The natural floral opening of Rose and Hyacinth perfectly complements the fruity blend of Bergamot and Amalfi Lemon. The overtly floral heart delights with its combination of fragrant Jasmine, Mimosa and Rose before the composition culminates in an earthy, woody and natural base blending Patchouli, Sandalwood and Oakmoss with Honey and Iris. Top Notes: Rose, Angelica, Hyacinth, Bergamot, Ylang Ylang and Lemon. Heart Notes: Rose, Coriander, Mimosa and Jasmine. Base Notes: Oakmoss, Honey, Sandalwood, Amber, Patchouli, Musk and Iris.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Luna Rossa Ocean Eau De Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Prada Luna Rossa Ocean Eau De Toilette (50ml) is a fresh and invigorating, aromatic floral EDP for men which depicts the union between performance and innovation, man's intellectual and physical prowess pushing back the boundaries of what is possible.This fragrance opens with the zingy sharpness of Pink Pepper and Bergamot, leading on to a clean, fresh, and racy heart of Lavender and Sage. This culminates in a woody dry down blending Musk and Patchouli but with the subtle sweetness of Caramel. Top Notes: Bergamot, Pink Pepper and Artemisia. Heart Notes: Lavender, Iris, Sage, Suede and Saffron. Base Notes: Musk, Haitian Vetiver, Patchouli and Caramel.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Lady Million Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Paco Rabanne Lady Million Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a floral and woody fragrance for women which conveys flamboyance, opulence, and a sensual nature.Opening with the seductive sparkle of Bitter Orange with a touch of Raspberry and a burst of smooth Neroli, this EDP delicately evolves in to a heart of heady Orange Blossom, overtly demanding attention as it intertwines with Arabian Jasmine and Gardenia. This culminates in a base of pulsating Patchouli, sweetly addictive Honey, and Amber. Presented in a gold diamond-shaped flacon, the design draws inspiration from the world famous Regent Diamond on display at the Louvre in Paris. Top Notes: Raspberry, Neroli and Amalfi Lemon. Heart Notes: Jasmine, African Orange Flower and Gardenia. Base Notes: White Honey, Patchouli and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Candy Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Prada Candy Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a luxurious, gourmand fragrance for women - a modern take on Prada's previous perfume creations. This EDP is for the woman who celebrates life and happiness, venturing into the world to bring forth joy and colour wherever she goes, it effectively encapsulates the spirit of empowered femininity within every Prada woman.Indulgent and luxurious, this perfume mingles the sweet aroma of Caramel with Powdery notes to create a long-lasting, sensual scent. Once settled, the base rests on a bed of Vanilla and Benzoin, developing into a distinct and addictive finish. The fragrance is housed in a beautifully-decorated cylindrical glass, as tall as the confidence of those whom wear it. Top Notes: Caramel. Heart Notes: Powdery Notes and Musk. Base Notes: Benzoin and Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Paloma Picasso Mon Parfum Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Paloma Picasso Mon Parfum Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a powerfully evocative floral women's EDP which is perfect for those wishing to display a bold and daring aura.The natural floral opening of Rose and Hyacinth perfectly complements the fruity blend of Bergamot and Amalfi Lemon. listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradoxe Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Prada Paradoxe Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a brand new, signature EDP for women by Prada. Designed for the woman impossible to frame, this new and feminine fragrance is your invitation to explore, develop and express the facets of your being, allowing you to celebrate your identity and sense of self.This floral, amber fragrance embraces the paradoxes of traditional ingredients to become something new, a reinvention resulting in an instant classic. Opening with delicate, subtle yet crisp notes of Neroli, these are complimented by the citrus, fruity hints of Tangerine and Bergamot. At the heart, a floral symphony of Orange Blossom and Jasmine Sambac lends this perfume its distinctly feminine tone, capturing the flower's freshest aspects. The perfume dries down into a subtle yet intense and long-lasting trail or Amber accords, Musks, Vanilla and Benzoin. Top Notes: Tangerine, Bergamot and Neroli. Heart Notes: Orange Blossom and Jasmine Sambac. Base Notes: Amber, White Musk, Bourbon Vanilla and Benzoin.

Observing their lives and their capability to challenge expectations, swim against prevailing currents, and invent a brand new tempo, Nagel composed a fragrance that mingles Ginger, Tuberose, and Sandalwood in a new, exhilarating way. These elements are combined distinctively to unfurl as a searing spice, a disconcerting attraction, and a revelation of the carnal. Each bottle is adorned with a hand-tied silk ribbon in a final flash of wit, ensuring every piece is uniquely charming. 1 x Hermes Twilly D'Hermes Eau De Parfum (15ml).

listings.rawTitle: Britney Spears Fantasy Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Britney Spears Fantasy Eau De Parfum (100ml) is part of the iconic pop princesses' collection of youthful women's fragrances - created for those who are as seductive, charming and elusive as the superstar singer herself.Fantasy is alive with enchantment - a magical potion that leaves a tantalising trail of love and sensuality. This women's EDP is an intoxicating blend of exotic fruits and florals with a sensual base that creates a fairy tale fragrance inspired by the thrill of the chase. The women's perfume is encased in a rounded, pink bottle speckled with Swarovski crystals, and featuring interlocking rings at the neck that symbolises togetherness. Top Notes: Red Lychee, Golden Quince and Kiwi. Heart Notes: Jasmine Petals and White Chocolate Orchid. Base Notes: Musk, Orris Root and Sensual Woods.

listings.rawTitle: Armaf Oud Niche Eau De Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Armaf Oud Niche Eau De Parfum (90ml) is a sophisticated, oriental, amber fragrance which has been perfectly blended for both men and women.This EDP can be worn equally well during the daytime or for an evening occasion. It opens with notes of Caraway, Sage, Spice and Bergamot zest, culminating in Amber and Leather notes. Top Notes: Caraway, Sage, Bergamot and Spicy Notes. Heart Notes: Cedar, Iris and Black Pepper. Base Notes: Leather, Patchouli, Vanilla and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Oud & Spice Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Acqua Di Parma Oud & Spice Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a masterful blend of the luxurious Oud essence and the brightness of citrus, presenting an opulent and artistic olfactory experience.This EDP starts with the rare Oud Oil, extracted from the Aquilaria tree's resin, sourced from Laos, and known for its unparalleled smoothness and balance. The composition is further enriched by the warm and spicy notes of Cinnamon and Cloves, creating an unexpected and enveloping scent profile. Bright Bergamot and lively Pink Pepper add luminosity to the blend, while Raspberry introduces a delectable, addictive sweetness. The scent journey concludes with the richness of Rose, the earthy depth of Patchouli, and the sweet, resinous undertones of Cisto Labdanum, weaving together an unforgettable tapestry of olfactory delight, reminiscent of the sun's warmth encapsulating the profound essence of Oud. Top Notes: Bergamot, Raspberry and Rose. Heart Notes: Cinnamon, Pink Pepper and Cloves. Base Notes: Agarwood Oil, Patchouli and Cisto Labdanum.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Wanted By Night Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Azzaro Wanted By Night Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a woody, spicy EDP for men who live life to its fullest and follow their instincts in search of victory. Celebrating a hedonistic lifestyle, this energising scent bestows a feeling of strength, power and irresistibility on the wearer.This composition opens with an energising melange of zesty Tangerine and warming Cinnamon. This leads to a spicy heart of Cumin, balsamic Incense and Red Cedar. The scent culminates in a woody drydown with Cypress and Cedar meeting the masculine aroma of Tobacco. The cylindrical bottle with its chrome lid and striking black smoke varnish contrasts perfectly with the amber liquid within. Top Notes: Tangerine and Cinnamon. Heart Notes: Red Cedar, Cumin and Incense. Base Notes: Cedar, Cypress and Tobacco.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Wanted Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Azzaro Wanted Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a seductive, woody and spicy EDT for men which reflects a charismatic, bold and seductive character who arouses desire in others through his unshakeable confidence and 'carpe diem' mentality.This fragrance's opening and heart notes are both characterised by the combination of fruity, spicy and floral notes with Lemon, Ginger, Lavender and Mint at the top, followed by the melange of Apple, Juniper, Cardamom and Geranium at the heart. The composition culminates in a complex, seductive and woody blend of Tonka, Vetiver and Amberwood. The luxurious, masculine bottle with its cylindrical shape is adorned with a shiny metal cap which reflects this fragrance's solar power. Top Notes: Lemon, Ginger, Lavender and Mint. Heart Notes: Apple, Juniper, Guatemalan Cardamom and Geranium. Base Notes: Tonka Bean, Amberwood and Haitian Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Oud Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Acqua Di Parma Oud Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an intense oriental and woody EDP inspired by the warm and deep notes of Agarwood's rare oud essence, at once vigorous and precious.This artistic combination is refined by luminous citrus notes which bring together the richness of the Aquilaria tree's Agarwood with notes of Russian Coriander and Haitian Amyris Wood. Top Notes: Bergamot and Orange. Heart Notes: Haitian Amyris Oil, Russian Coriander and Agarwood Oil (Oud). Base Notes: Cedarwood, Leather accord, Patchouli Oil, Sandalwood and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Mandorlo Di Sicilia Eau De Toilette 30ml
listings.description: Acqua Di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Mandorlo Di Sicilia Eau De Toilette (30ml) is a EDT for men and women with a delightfully soft fragrance evoking the sweet memories of a Sicilian way of life.The caressingly sweet fragrance is characterised by top notes of Star Anise, Bergamot and Orange. listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Taylor Diamonds & Emeralds Eau De Toilette 100ml

Top Notes: Gardenia, Peach, Apricot, Hiacynth, Orange Blossom, White Rose, Water Lily, Mandarin Orange and Sage. Heart Notes: Tuberose, Jasmine, Magnolia, Lily, Carnation, Rose and Lily-of-the-Valley. Base Notes: Vanilla, Amber, Tonka Bean, Musk and Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Taylor Diamonds & Sapphires Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Elizabeth Taylor Diamonds & Sapphires Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a light floral and feminine fragrance, ideal for the office or casual daytime wear with a refreshing botanical scent.This EDT uses a luscious blend of refreshing notes including Lily Of The Valley, Rose, Ylang Ylang, Jasmine Spice and musky Sandalwood. listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Musc Noir Rose Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Musc Noir Rose Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an amber, floral EDP for women which conveys a light-hearted, sensual femininity. listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Explorer Eau De Parfum 60ml
listings.description: Montblanc Explorer Eau De Parfum (60ml) is a masculine woody, aromatic leather fragrance which takes you on a fantastic journey, an irresistible call for adventure.This unconventional woody, aromatic EDP reveals Italian Bergamot with green notes, contrasting with rich Vetiver and Patchouli from Indonesia. listings.rawTitle: Mugler Alien Eau De Parfum 90ml

listings.rawTitle: Mugler Alien Goddess Eau De Parfum 30ml

listings.rawTitle: Nina Ricci L'Air Du Temps Eau De Parfum 100ml

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne One Million Eau De Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Paco Rabanne 1 Million Eau De Toilette (50ml) is a warm, spicy and leathery EDT for men that is as intoxicating as it is powerful. listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Ultraviolet Man Eau De Toilette 100ml

listings.rawTitle: Nina Ricci L'Air Du Temps Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Nina Ricci L'Air Du Temps Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a spicy floral EDT for women which exudes femininity, timeless sophistication and pure optimism. Created as an ode to peace, love and freedom during the elation of the post-war era, this fresh and elegant scent has a Spring accord as delicious and intense as a bouquet of roses enhanced by the clove notes of Pink Carnation and the warmth of Sandalwood.The luscious composition of L'Air Du Temps opens with a fragrant Carnation and Gardenia accord uplifted with fiery accents for a distinctive individuality. This leads on to a rich and opulent heart with delicate Centifolia Rose notes and sensual Jasmine creating a burst of blossom. This culminates in the warming caress of a base combining creamy Sandalwood and powdery Orris. The liquid is housed in a bottle of flowing twists and, to represent the concept of peace and love, it has been adorned with two entwined doves perched on the top. Top Notes: Carnation and Gardenia. Heart Notes: Centifolia Rose and Grasse Jasmine. Base Notes: Iris and Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Nina Ricci Eau De Toilette 50ml

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Phantom Eau De Toilette 100ml

listings.rawTitle: Billie Eilish Eilish No. 2 By Billie Eilish Eau De Parfum 30ml

listings.description: Elizabeth Arden True Love Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a distinctly floral perfume for women from the iconic beauty house's extensive collection. Opening with top notes laden with fruity tones, the women's perfume gives way to rare flowers from all over the world before leaving a lasting impression with accents of wood and grasses. The fragrance comes packaged in an elegant glass bottle with gold finishing bearing its name and a white top. Top Notes: Peach, Freesia, Apricot and Green Notes. Heart Notes: Iris, Orris Root, Jasmine, Heliotrope, Lily of the Valley and Rose. Base Notes: Sandalwood, Amber, Vanilla and Cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Emporio Armani Stronger With You For Him Eau De Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Emporio Armani Stronger With You For Him Eau De Toilette (50ml) is a warm, woody and spicy EDT for men who seek to embody the spirit of modern love, exuding confident elegance and the effortless sensuality of youth.This composition opens with the spicy accords of Pink Pepper and Cardamom combining with ozonic Violet Leaf. This leads to a fruity floral heart with Melon and Pineapple drawing warmth from Cinnamon and earthy notes from Sage. This culminates in a sensual, woody base with creamy Vanilla meeting the varied olfactory woody notes of Cedar, Guaiac and Amberwood. Top Notes: Cardamom, Pink Pepper, Violet Leaf and Mint. Heart Notes: Pineapple, Cinnamon, Melon, Sage and Lavender. Base Notes: Vanilla, Chestnut, Amberwood, Cedar and Guaiac Wood.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Intense Femme Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Intense Femme Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a luminous and citrus-filled EDP for women, inspired by the blue shores and skies of the beautiful Mediterranean. More than just a scent, the nose behind this fragrance carefully selected notes to capture the pure aura Mediterranean, allowing you to escape with a simple spritz.With wondrously sharp and tangy notes, this fragrance opens with citrus hints of Lemon and Granny Smith Apple, following by a floral accentuating heart of Jasmine and Marigold before settling on a musky base of Musk and Amberwood. The parfum is housed in an attractive frosted glass bottle, showcasing the sky blue perfume within to remind you of the clear skies above the seas. Top Notes: Lemon and Granny Smith Apple. Heart Notes: Jasmine and Marigold. Musk and Amberwood.

listings.rawTitle: Elie Saab Le Parfum In White Eau De Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Elie Saab Le Parfum In White Eau De Parfum (90ml) is a floral, fruity EDP for women which evokes a new modern femininity, personified in the white sheer fabric of an haute couture wedding dress.Orange Blossom, Mandarin Essence and Blackcurrant Buds combine in a sparkling citrus opening, leading to a luminous union with Jasmine in the heart. The composition culminates in an addictive, mesmerising veil of White Musk and Patchouli in the base. This fragrance is housed in a transparent glass bottle, stoppered with an opaque, multifaceted white top, expression pure femininity. Top Notes: Orange Blossom, Red Berries, Mandarin Orange and Bergamot. Heart Notes: Jasmine and Peach. Base Notes: White Amber, White Musk, Patchouli, Benzoin, Vanilla and Tolu Balsam.

listings.rawTitle: Michael Kors Gorgeous Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Michael Kors Gorgeous Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a floral woody EDP for women which conveys the optimism and self-assured ease of a confident female personality. Emboldening and stimulating, it effortlessly depicts the sensation of feeling good in your own skin. Opening with a modern take on the classic scent...

listings.rawTitle: Michael Kors Gorgeous Eau De Parfum 30ml

listings.rawTitle: Michael Kors Pour Femme Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Michael Kors Pour Femme Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a floral woody musk EDP with an elegant finish which surrounds the wearer with an aura of luxury, confidence and sensuality. The multi-faceted olfactory notes and long-lasting finish conjure images of a solid gold chain warmed by sun-kissed skin, radiating sophistication, confidence and strength. The composition opens with fresh, zesty notes of Blackcurrant and Mandarin, enlivened by spicy Pink Peppercorn, for a tantalising effect which awakens the senses and invigorates body and soul. This leads on to an overtly feminine heart with its refined floral melange of delicate Jasmine and fragrant Rose Blossoms. This culminates in a sensual, earthy and woody base which combines creamy Vanilla, seductive Musk and intoxicating Patchouli leaves. The fragrant liquid is housed in a vertical, clear rectangular flacon in glistening gold. The bottle reflects the brand's total craftsmanship and luxury with its accentuated, large chain links, an element frequently used by the brand. Top Notes: Blackcurrant, Mandarin and Pink Peppercorn. Heart Notes: Jasmine and Rose Blossoms. Base Notes: Patchouli, Vanilla and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Love Eau De Toilette 30ml
listings.description: Marc Jacobs Daisy Love Eau De Toilette (30ml) is a fruity floral fragrance for women which conveys an addictive spirit, intoxicated by contagious and irresistible joie de vivre.This gourmand radiant EDT opens with a vibrant, fruity burst of sweet and sour Cloudberries, leading on to a floral heart of delicate Daisy Tree Petals before culminating in a feminine base in which sparkling Cashmere Musks and Driftwood mingle to create an unforgettable gourmand twist. The clear glass bottle with gold cap has been adorned with an over-sized, white daisy which contrasts with the warm amber glow of the fragrance. Top Notes: Crystalised Cloudberries. Heart Notes: Daisy Tree Petals. Base Notes: Cashmere Musks and Driftwood.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Legend Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Montblanc Legend Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a masculine EDT which simultaneously expresses strength and softness, clarity and mystery. This fragrance invokes peacefulness with an irresistible edge that is fresh and compelling.A fresh fougere, the top notes of Italian Bergamot and French Lavender are clean and fresh. The heart reveals woody-floral notes of Oakmoss, Cedar and Pomarose, a fruity, spicy raw ingredient developed using cutting edge technology, while the base blends Sandalwood and Tonka Bean. The craftsmanship of Montblanc pens is echoed in every aspect in Legend from the modern fragrance to the classic, masculine bottle design. Top Notes: Lavender, Pineapple, Bergamot and Lemon Verbena. Heart Notes: Red Apple, Dried Fruits, Oak Moss, Geranium, Courmarin and Rose. Base Notes: Tonka Bean and Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Moschino Toy 2 Pearl Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Moschino Toy 2 Pearl Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a floral fruity EDP for women and men which takes its inspiration from the seabed and Tahitian mother-of-pearl. The composition opens with the zesty citrus combination of two forms of Lemon, refreshing Lemon Heart and sparkling Lemon Sorbet, augmented by the heady aroma of Oregano. This leads on to an overtly floral heart blending the fragrant elegance of Jasmine and Freesia, paired with the comforting olfactory strains of Sand to conjure images of a sun-soaked island paradise. The scent culminates in a woody base with invigorating Cypress softened by the subtle powdery smell of Musk. The fragrant liquid is housed in an iridescent bottle shaped like the Moschino teddy bear. Each bottle has a unique shade to emphasise the sophistication and attention to detail stored within. Top Notes: Lemon Sorbet, LMR Lemon Heart and Oregano. Heart Notes: Sand, Freesia, LMR Vetiver Essence and Jasmine. Base Notes: Cypress and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Moschino Fresh Gold Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Moschino Fresh Gold Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a fruity, feminine, and floral scent, presented in a gold household cleaner bottle to ironically contrast mundanity with a fragrance so elegant and sensual. The unique bottle is packaged in an elegant box with a stunning gold look, offset by a black inset band for a touch of sophistication and luxury.Its playful, ironic notes open with a blend of vibrant Mandarin, Pear and White Peach. A floral heart of enchanting Jasmine and Orchid enhances the radiant femininity of the scent, before it culminates in a sensual blend of Sandalwood, Musk and Vanilla. Top notes: Grapefruit, Mandarin, Pear, White Peach, Mango and Rhubarb Leaf. Heart notes: Jasmine, Orchid and Lily Of The Valley. Base notes: Patchouli, Sandalwood, Vanilla, Musk and Akigala Wood.

listings.rawTitle: Lancome Miracle Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Lancome Miracle Eau De Parfum (30ml) is a sparkling floral and fruity EDP for women which conveys the recurring miracle that is the dawning of a new day.Fresh, dewy notes of Lychee and Freesia herald this natural rebirth, leading to a spicy heart which reverberates with notes of Magnolia, Jasmine, Ginger and Pepper. This culminates in a warm base which envelopes the wearer in the sensual splendour of Amber and Musk. Top Notes: Juicy Lychee, Freesia and Pink Peppercorn. Heart Notes: Peony, Damascena Rose, Delicate Magnolia, Bourbon Pepper and Ginger. Base Notes: Absolute Jasmine, Musk, Patchouli and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Emblem Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Montblanc Emblem Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a zesty, oriental fragrance for men which is described as the embodiment of the authentic essence and elegance associated with the Montblanc brand.Opening with a splash or aromatic Clary Sage and Cardamon mixed with notes of Sparkling Grapefruit, this EDT develops into a luxurious heart of Frosted Violet Leaves and spicy sweet Cinnamon, before settling on a woody base of Precious Woods and Tonka Beans. Top Notes: Bitter Grapefruit, Cardamom, Clary Sage and Black Peppercorns. Heart Notes: Frosted Violet Leaves and Cinnamon. Base Notes: Precious Woods and Tonka Beans.

listings.rawTitle: Moschino Fresh Couture Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Moschino Fresh Couture Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a soft, feminine, and floral scent, presented in a household cleaner bottle to ironically contrast mundanity with a fragrance so luxurious.This fragrance overlaps fresh and joyful accents to develop a scent of tempting femininity. The unique bottle is packaged in an elegant box with a more feminine, bright pink look offset by a silver band for a touch of sophistication and luxury. Top notes: Bergamot, Mandarin, Raspberry. Heart notes: Osmanthus, Peony, Ylang Ylang. Base notes: Cedarwood, White Patchouli, Ambrox.

listings.rawTitle: Missoni Man Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Missoni Man Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a woody, aromatic fragrance for men which takes its inspiration from the Mediterranean landscape, warmed by the sun. Fresh, luminous, and full of contrasts, this precious EDP reflects the colours of the Mediterranean Sea.The leaves and pulp of Green Lemon and Ginger, together with Pink Pomelo mix with the timeless, aromatic notes of Lavande Aspic, fruity Pomarose and a light touch of Jasmine Petals. The dry down contains comforting notes of Sandalwood, as enveloping as a precious Missoni cardigan, with the passionate, sensual and masculine touches of Oakwood, Birch, Patchouli and vibrant Musks. Top Notes: Grapefruit, Lemon and Lavender. Heart Notes: Ginger, Apple and Jasmine. Base Notes: Birch, Oak, Sandalwood, Musk and Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Mugler A*Men Eau De Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Mugler A*Men Eau De Toilette (50ml) is a woody, amber EDT for men which combines vitality and sensuality in a potent, masculine fragrance for the timeless hero.Bold, strong and confident in tune with its wearer, the scent pursues contrasting trails with Patchouli and Vanilla meeting Arabica Coffee. Heart Notes: Caramel, Patchouli, Honey, Milk, Cedar, Jasmine and Lily-of-the-Valley. Base Notes: Coffee, Patchouli, Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Benzoin, Amber, Sandalwood and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Legend Night Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Montblanc Legend Night Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a woody aromatic fragrance for men. The refined and elegant men's scent embodies the man of taste, with an aroma that is equal parts invigorating and graceful.The scent opens with the aromatic notes of Clary Sage and Peppermint, enhanced with cool spices like Cardamom and sparkling Bergamot, setting a fresh and lively tone that reflects the natural radiance of a sophisticated man. Top Notes: Bergamot, Clary Sage, Peppermint, and Cardamom. Heart Notes: Apple, Fir, Cedar, Lavender, and Violet. Base Notes: Vetiver, Black Vanilla, Akigalawood, Patchouli, and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Michael Kors Sexy Amber Eau De Parfum 100ml

listings.rawTitle: Mugler Alien Eau De Parfum 60ml

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Love So Sweet Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Marc Jacobs Daisy Love So Sweet Eau De Toilette (100ml) is an irresistible spirit filled with love, freshness and an enticing sweetness which envelopes the wearer in an aura of lustrous energy and sparkling glamour.This EDT opens with sparkling notes of sweet White Raspberries, harmonising with glistening hints of Blackberry and refreshing Bergamot. listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Honey Eau De Parfum 100ml

Base Notes: Honey, Vanilla and Woodsy Notes.

listings.rawTitle: Moschino Toy 2 Eau De Parfum 50ml

This culminates in the sensuality of Amberwood and Sandalwood, with Musk, adding radiance. Top notes: Apple, Mandarin, Orange and Magnolia. Heart notes: White Currant, Peony and Jasmine. listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy So Intense Eau De Parfum 100ml

Top Notes: Strawberry, Pear and Bergamot. Heart Notes: Honey, Jasmine and Rose. Base Notes: Vanilla, Musk, Benzoin and Moss.

listings.rawTitle: Lanvin L'Homme Eau De Toilette 100ml

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Dot For Women Eau De Parfum 100ml

listings.description: Marc Jacobs Daisy Love Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a fruity floral fragrance for women which conveys an addictive spirit, intoxicated by contagious and irresistible joie de vivre.This gourmand radiant EDT opens with a vibrant, fruity burst of sweet and sour Cloudberries, leading on to a floral heart of delicate Daisy Tree Petals before culminating in a feminine base in which sparkling Cashmere Musks and Driftwood mingle to create an unforgettable gourmand twist.
