Heart Notes: Daisy Tree Petals. Base Notes: Cashmere Musks and Driftwood.

listings.rawTitle: Makeup Revolution Revolutionary Noir Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Makeup Revolution Revolutionary Noir Eau De Toilette (100ml) lets you lose yourself in the opulent air of unadulterated luxury with its sophisticated fragrance profile, perfect for relaxed evening wear.This spicy yet sweet EDT for women opens with hints of Vanilla and Coffee, which builds into warm heart before nestling on a bed of addictive woods. Top Notes: Vanilla and Coffee. Heart Notes: Spice. Base Notes: Woods.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Legend Eau De Toilette 30ml
listings.description: Montblanc Legend Eau De Toilette (30ml) is a masculine EDT which simultaneously expresses strength and softness, clarity, and mystery. This fragrance invokes peacefulness with an irresistible edge that is fresh and compelling.A fresh fougere, the top notes of Italian Bergamot and French Lavender are clean and fresh. The heart reveals woody-floral notes of Oakmoss, Cedar and Pomarose, a fruity, spicy raw ingredient developed using cutting edge technology, while the base blends Sandalwood and Tonka Bean. The craftsmanship of Montblanc pens is echoed in every aspect in Legend from the modern fragrance to the classic, masculine bottle design. Top Notes: Lavender, Pineapple, Bergamot and Lemon Verbena. Heart Notes: Red Apple, Dried Fruits, Oak Moss, Geranium, Courmarin and Rose. Base Notes: Tonka Bean and Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Explorer Eau De Parfum 200ml
listings.description: Montblanc Explorer Eau De Parfum (200ml) is a masculine woody, aromatic leather fragrance which takes you on a fantastic journey, an irresistible call for adventure.This unconventional woody, aromatic EDP reveals Italian Bergamot with green notes, contrasting with rich Vetiver and Patchouli from Indonesia. The bottle depicts the Earth's two hemispheres, recalling the multiple destinations explored during this olfactory expedition. At the bottom lies Montblanc's emblem, the iconic star representing the six glaciers of the highest mountain in Europe. Top Notes: Bergamot and Sage. Heart Notes: Pomarose. Base Notes: Leather, Vetiver, Sandalwood, Patchouli, Ambrofix and Akigalawood.

listings.rawTitle: Lancome La Vie Est Belle Eau De Parfum Refill 100ml
listings.description: Lancome La Vie Est Belle Eau De Parfum Refill (100m) is a floral EDP for women which conveys a contentment with natural beauty and the simple yet joyful pleasure gained from life.Featuring Iris at its heart, the scent opens with a fruity melange of Pear and Blackberry, leading on to a heart of Orange Blossom and Jasmine. The composition culminates in a warm Patchouli base. The crystal smile bottle evokes an exuberant joie de vivre and is adorned with a pearlescent grey ribbon. Top Notes: Pear and Blackberry. Heart Notes: Pallida Iris Concrete, Orange Blossom and Jasmine Sambac Absolutes. Base Note: Patchouli Essence.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Love Eau De Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Marc Jacobs Daisy Love Eau De Toilette (50ml) is a fruity floral fragrance for women which conveys an addictive spirit, intoxicated by contagious and irresistible joie de vivre.This gourmand radiant EDT opens with a vibrant, fruity burst of sweet and sour Cloudberries, leading on to a floral heart of delicate Daisy Tree Petals before culminating in a feminine base in which sparkling Cashmere Musks and Driftwood mingle to create an unforgettable gourmand twist. The clear glass bottle with gold cap has been adorned with an over-sized, white daisy which contrasts with the warm amber glow of the fragrance. Top Notes: Crystalised Cloudberries. Heart Notes: Daisy Tree Petals. Base Notes: Cashmere Musks and Driftwood.

listings.rawTitle: Michael Kors Pour Femme Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Michael Kors Pour Femme Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a floral woody musk EDP with an elegant finish which surrounds the wearer with an aura of luxury, confidence and sensuality. The multi-faceted olfactory notes and long-lasting finish conjure images of a solid gold chain warmed by sun-kissed skin, radiating sophistication, confidence and strength. The composition opens with fresh, zesty notes of Blackcurrant and Mandarin, enlivened by spicy Pink Peppercorn, for a tantalising effect which awakens the senses and invigorates body and soul. This leads on to an overtly feminine heart with its refined floral melange of delicate Jasmine and fragrant Rose Blossoms. This culminates in a sensual, earthy and woody base which combines creamy Vanilla, seductive Musk and intoxicating Patchouli leaves. The fragrant liquid is housed in a vertical, clear rectangular flacon in glistening gold. The bottle reflects the brand's total craftsmanship and luxury with its accentuated, large chain links, an element frequently used by the brand. Top Notes: Blackcurrant, Mandarin and Pink Peppercorn. Heart Notes: Jasmine and Rose Blossoms. Base Notes: Patchouli, Vanilla and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Eau So Fresh Eau De Toilette 30ml
listings.description: Marc Jacobs Daisy Eau So Fresh Eau De Toilette (30ml) is a fresh, floral EDT for women which arouses the senses with its bold, feminine elegance and sweet, whimsical charm. The bright aroma conveys an energetic yet sophisticated spirit with a sunny, sensual disposition.Opening with the enticing, playful top notes of Raspberry and Grapefruit, this composition leads on to a captivating heart of Wild Rose, Violet and Jasmine, before concluding with a fragrant, radiant dry down of Musks, Warm Plum and Cedarwood. Top Notes: Pink Grapefruit, Raspberries, Green Leaves and Pear. Heart Notes: Wild Rose, Violet, Apple Blossom, Lychee and Jasmine Petals. Base Notes: Soft Musks, Plum and Cedarwood.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Eau De Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Marc Jacobs Daisy Eau De Toilette (50ml) is a floral EDT for women which effectively conveys the joyful, free spirit of the Marc Jacobs woman with their exuberant, unquestioning joie de vivre.This composition opens with a zesty, floral melange with the tender, powdery softness of Violet combining with citrusy sweet Wild Berries. This leads on to a heart of heady Jasmine with its rich, sensual, and musky notes, culminating in an earthy dry down of Sandalwood. The fragrance is presented in a lovely bottle decorated with daisy flowers atop. Top Notes: Wild Berries and White Violet. Heart Notes: Jasmine Infusion. Base Notes: Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Individuel Eau De Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Montblanc Individuel Eau De Toilette (75ml) is a highly refined and distinguished EDT designed for men. This scent boasts a rich blend of natural ingredients, creating a harmonious composition of oriental elements and warm woods, enlivened by spicy accords and aromatic herbs.It opens with a captivating blend of Lavender, Cinnamon, and Fresh Pineapple, creating an initial impression that is both aromatic and subtly spicy. As the scent develops, the heart notes of Orange Blossom, Violet, Geranium, and Jasmine emerge, adding a floral and slightly sweet dimension, while maintaining its sophistication. Individuel is tailored for the confident, sophisticated, elegant, and distinctive man. Top Notes: Lavender, Cinnamon, Pineapple, Juniper Berries, Mint, Bergamot, Rosemary, Cardamom, and Coriander. Heart Notes: Orange Blossom, Violet, Geranium, and Jasmine. Base Notes: Raspberry, Vanilla, Sandalwood, Dark Chocolate, Musk, Amber, Patchouli, Vetiver, and Oakmoss.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy So Intense Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Marc Jacobs Daisy So Intense Eau De Parfum (50ml) is an amber, floral EDT for women, inspired by the brilliance of Marc Jacobs Daisy.Offering a deeper, more intense twist than its precursor, this fragrance opens with vibrant, sparkling notes of Strawberry and Fresh Pear and Bergamot, mingling with the natural sweetness of Honey in the heart and complimented by floral hints of Jasmine and Rose Bud. The parfum rests on a sweet, musky bed of Vanilla, Musk, Benzoin and Moss. The perfume is housed in a golden opaque bottle, inspired by the golden sweet honey within and stopped with an oversized white flower petal with a golden accent. Top Notes: Strawberry, Pear and Bergamot. Heart Notes: Honey, Jasmine and Rose. Base Notes: Vanilla, Musk, Benzoin and Moss.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Perfect Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Marc Jacobs Perfect Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a playful, floral EDP for women which takes its inspiration from Marc Jacobs' philosophical mantra I am perfect as I am' which is symbolised by a tattoo of the word perfect' on his wrist.This scent conveys the concept of self-worth, accepting and embracing one's true self with a sense of optimism, self-satisfaction and pride.The scent opens with a classic, floral fruity melange of tart Rhubarb and friendly Daffodil, a symbol of good fortune, leading on to a nutty heart of Almond Milk. The composition culminates in a dry down of spicy, woody Cashmeran. The bottle combines elegance and modernity with its weighted glass base, whilst the cap is crowned with an eclectic, multicoloured array of mismatched charms. Top Notes: Rhubarb and Daffodil. Heart Notes: Almond Milk. Base Notes: Cashmeran.

listings.rawTitle: Missoni Man Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Missoni Man Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a woody, aromatic fragrance for men which takes its inspiration from the Mediterranean landscape, warmed by the sun. Fresh, luminous, and full of contrasts, this precious EDP reflects the colours of the Mediterranean Sea.The leaves and pulp of Green Lemon and Ginger, together with Pink Pomelo mix with the timeless, aromatic notes of Lavande Aspic, fruity Pomarose and a light touch of Jasmine Petals. The dry down contains comforting notes of Sandalwood, as enveloping as a precious Missoni cardigan, with the passionate, sensual and masculine touches of Oakwood, Birch, Patchouli and vibrant Musks. Top Notes: Grapefruit, Lemon and Lavender. Heart Notes: Ginger, Apple and Jasmine. Base Notes: Birch, Oak, Sandalwood, Musk and Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Missoni Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Missoni Missoni Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a floral, fruity fragrance which provides femininity and sensuality for the modern woman.Confident and elegant, the wearer will be conscious of her presence, and view this EDP as a dress that glides on the body, enhancing her vitality and charm. Top Notes: Lemon, Bergamot, Cedar, Pear and Pomme d'Amour. Heart Notes: Mahonial, Petalia and Jasmine Sambac. Base Notes: Ambra, Tonka Bean and Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Perfect Intense Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Marc Jacobs Perfect Intense Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an amber, floral EDP for women which takes its inspiration from Marc Jacobs' philosophical mantra I am perfect as I am' which is symbolised by a tattoo of the word perfect' on his wrist.The scent conveys the concept of self-worth, accepting and embracing one's true self with a sense of optimism, self-satisfaction, and pride. This composition opens with a heady floral melange of Daffodil and Jasmine, leading on to a nutty heart of Roasted Almonds. The composition culminates in an earthy, sultry dry down of Sandalwood. Designed in collaboration with Marc Jacobs himself and including an unusual mix of disparate elements, the bottle has a weighted glass base and displays all the femininity and grace of a classic parfum. The crystal-cut cap is crowned with a bizarre collection of mis-matched charms, all bedecked in shades of gold, silver, black, white, yellow, and a dash of cherry red. Top Notes: Daffodil and Night Blooming Jasmine. Heart Notes: Roasted Almonds. Base Notes: Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Moschino Pink Fresh Couture Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Moschino Pink Fresh Couture Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a fresh and floral scent, presented in a pink household cleaner bottle to ironically contrast mundanity with a fragrance so luxurious. The unique bottle is packaged in an elegant box with a more feminine, pop-pink look offset by a silver band for a touch of sophistication and luxury.Fresh and lively Pink Grapefruit and Blackcurrant combine with the innocent and luminous notes of Lily of the Valley. In the heart, a floral accord of refined Wild Rose and Pink Hyacinth is enhanced by juicy Pomegranate grains. This culminates in an intense, sensual trail of Cedarwood, Ambroxan and Musk. Top notes: Pink Grapefruit, Blackcurrant and Lily Of The Valley. Heart notes: Pomegranate, Rose and Pink Hyacinth. Base notes: Cedar, Musk and Ambroxan.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Explorer Platinum Eau De Parfum 60ml
listings.description: Montblanc Explorer Platinum Eau De Parfum (60ml) is a woody, ambery men's EDP which has been created to reflect a new aspect to Montblanc Explorer, pursuing a new avenue of the spirit of exploration which propels the wearer towards new adventures located in the world's highest mountains.The composition opens with the vibrant green, herbaceous notes of Violet Leaves and Clary Sage, enveloped in the woody intensity of Cedarwood and an accord of sensual, warm and exotic ambery notes. The bottle has been decorated with an impressive, textured silver sleeve inspired by the Montblanc 1858 Geosphere, the watch which paid tribute to the world's seven summit mountaineering challenge. Top Notes: Violet Leaves. Heart Notes: Clary Sage. Base Notes: Cedarwood.

listings.rawTitle: Michael Kors Wonderlust Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Michael Kors Wonderlust Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a spicy, floral EDP for women which reflects an insatiable lust for experiences, realised in the spontaneous sensuality of an impromptu expedition. The opening has at its core the Dianthus Flower, creating the notion of Almond Milk blended with a spicy, creamy...

listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Polo 67 Eau De Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Ralph Lauren Polo 67 Eau De Toilette (75ml) is a bold and powerful, woody solar EDT which reflects the spirit of sporting elegance. An ideal scent for the man always on top of his game, Polo 67 elevates and enhances the Polo fragrance collection with its ultimate expression of an active lifestyle.The composition opens with a warm vibrance which emanates from a combination of floral and fruity notes including sun-drenched Bergamot and fragrant Lavender. This leads on to a heart where the earthy aroma of Sunflower Seeds meets the balsamic notes of Clary Sage, before culminating in a sensuous, woody and earthy drydown featuring Patchouli, Sandalwood and Vetiver. Produced in a rich, dark blue tone with a shiny white cap, the refillable bottle puts a playful spin on the iconic Polo logo with a reference to 1967 - the year Ralph Lauren launched his Polo brand. Top Notes: Bergamot Essence, Aquatic Accord and Lavandin Heart. Heart Notes: Geranium, Sunflower Seeds Accord and Clary Sage Essence Heart. Base Notes: Haitian Vetiver, Sandalwood Essence and Patchouli Sustain Heart.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Oud Satin Mood Scented Body Oil 70ml
listings.description: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Oud Satin Mood Scented Body Oil (70ml) is a luxurious, lightweight oil that nourishes the skin while enveloping it in the sumptuous and velvety scent of Oud Satin Mood.Infused with the powdery elegance of Violet and the deep floral richness of Bulgarian Rose, this silky formula absorbs effortlessly, leaving the skin soft, radiant, and beautifully fragranced. At its heart, the sensual depth of Laotian Oud and the resinous warmth of Benzoin from Siam add a rich, enveloping dimension, while the smooth embrace of Vanilla and radiant Amber lingers on the skin with an indulgent, long-lasting sillage. A decadent addition to any fragrance ritual, this body oil elevates daily self-care with a touch of opulence.Directions of use: After cleansing and showering, rub the desired amount and pat onto face and neck. Massage over the body until absorbed. Alternatively smooth through hair, working from ends to roots.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Red Eau De Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Lacoste Red Eau De Toilette (75ml) is an energetic fougère EDT for men who thrive in high-stakes environments.A bold blend of crisp Green Apple delivers an invigorating burst, seamlessly transitioning into the earthy warmth of Pine and Patchouli. The scent settles into a refined base of Vetiver, adding depth and confidence. Housed in a sleek bottle featuring the iconic Lacoste crocodile, this dynamic fragrance is perfect for men who are always on the move. Top Notes: Green Apple. Heart Notes: Pine Tree. Base Notes: Patchouli and Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Ard Al Zaafaran Bint Hooran Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Ard Al Zaafaran Bint Hooran Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a refined and elegant EDP that embodies the essence of traditional Arabic perfumery. Soft and calming on the skin, it creates a sense of peace and understated sophistication, making it an ideal everyday scent for those with a modest, measured style. Presented in a beautifully curved bottle, it also makes a thoughtful gift for anyone who appreciates classic, well-crafted aromas.Opening with an intricate blend of Coriander, Cypress, Mandarin, Tarragon, Yuzu, Lemon, Sage, Bergamot and Calamus, it delivers a vibrant and aromatic introduction. The heart reveals warm, spiced layers of Nutmeg, Mignonette, Ceylon Cinnamon, Bourbon Bark and Saffron, softened by delicate Lily of the Valley and the aquatic touch of Blue Lotus. In the base, Tahiti Vetiver, Musk, Sandalwood, Cedar, Amber and Tobacco combine for a rich, earthy and long-lasting finish. Top Notes: Coriander, Cypress, Mandarin, Tarragon, Yuzu, Lemon, Sage, Bergamot, Lemon and Calamus. Heart Notes: Nutmeg, Mignonette, Ceylon Cinnamon, Bourbon Bark, Saffron, Lily of the Valley and Blue Lotus. Base Notes: Tahiti Vetiver, Musk, Sandalwood, Cedar, Amber and Tobacco.

listings.rawTitle: French Avenue Vulcan Sable Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: French Avenue Vulcan Sable Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a bold, intoxicating EDP created for those who command attention and exude raw magnetism. Balancing fire and finesse, it blends mystery, warmth, and refined masculinity into an unforgettable olfactory statement.The opening bursts with warm Whiskey, aromatic Coriander, and the citrus brightness of Mandarin Orange, enriched with earthy Sesame and a subtle spice from Anise for a daring yet sophisticated introduction. The heart reveals a luxurious fusion of rich Cacao, creamy Sandalwood, and the velvety muskiness of Cashmeran, creating a seductive gourmand depth that is smooth, warm, and irresistibly addictive. In the dry-down, Tonka Bean and resinous Benzoin intertwine with smoky Styrax and soft White Cedar Extract, while Patchouli and Vanilla bring an earthy-sweet allure. Cashmere Wood completes the composition with a long-lasting, comforting finish. Top Notes: Whiskey, Coriander, Mandarin Orange, Sesame, and Anise. Heart Notes: Cacao, Sandalwood, and Cashmeran. Base Notes: Tonka Bean, Benzoin, Styrax, White Cedar Extract, Patchouli, Vanilla, and Cashmere Wood.

listings.rawTitle: French Avenue Veneno Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: French Avenue Veneno Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a daring and seductive EDP for those who crave depth, mystery and magnetic allure. Smouldering, sweet and dangerously captivating, it is the essence of temptation captured in a rich, smoky elixir that commands attention with every spray.Opening with the crisp juiciness of Apple, laced with the spicy warmth of Cinnamon and enveloped in a veil of Smoke, it sets a darkly alluring tone where sweetness and spice meet fire and intrigue. The heart reveals a sultry blend of Tobacco and Moss, adding earthy richness, smooth leatheriness and herbal freshness. As it dries down, Bourbon Vanilla brings a rich, creamy warmth with a subtle boozy edge, while Orcanox delivers amber-like depth and lasting softness. Perfect for evening wear or special occasions, Veneno is unapologetically bold and irresistibly charismatic. Top Notes: Apple, Cinnamon and Smoke. Heart Notes: Tobacco and Moss. Base Notes: Bourbon Vanilla and Orcanox.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Lost Cherry Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Tom Ford Lost Cherry Eau De Parfum (30ml) is a rich oriental floral EDP for women and men which immerses the wearer in a candy-like shimmer as Black Cherry mingles with cherry liqueur accords and a hint of Bitter Almond, bursting forth in luscious waves of sweet and tart.The composition moves on from the classic perfection of its indulgent opening to an opulent heart where the floralcy of Rose and Jasmine Sambac blend with an unexpected mélange of voluptuous Plum and Sour Cherry. This culminates in a multifaceted drydown where Peru Balsam and Roasted Tonka blend with the woody melange of Sandalwood, Vetiver and Cedar, warmed by the presence of Cinnamon and Cloves with the creamy sensuality of Vanilla. Top Notes: Bitter Almond, Black Cherry and Cherry Liqueur. Heart Notes: Sour Cherry, Plum, Turkish Rose and Jasmine Sambac. Base Notes: Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Cinnamon, Peru Balsam, Benzoin, Sandalwood, Cloves, Cedar, Patchouli and Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Hugo Reversed Eau De Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Hugo Boss Hugo Reversed Eau De Toilette (75ml) is a woody, aromatic men's EDT with an urban cocktail of energising citrus, aromatic Rosemary and cool Vetiver.This fragrance has been designed for men who dare to challenge the status quo. Switch up the everyday perspective with this fresh scent. Top Notes: Grapefruit and Calabrian Bergamot. Heart Note: Rosemary. Base Note: Haitian Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Matiere Premiere Radical Rose Extrait De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Matière Première Radical Rose Extrait De Parfum (100ml) is a floral unisex fragrance that celebrates the highest concentration of Rose Centifolia Absolute from organically grown flowers in Grasse.This powerful and vibrant composition is enriched with Immortelle Absolute from Croatia, chosen for its distinctive character that balances floral and salty nuances, adding a dark, mineral depth to the lush Rose note. With an even higher concentration than the original Radical Rose, this Extrait offers a bold and complex interpretation of Rose that is both gender-neutral and deeply expressive. Crafted with between 85% and 92% naturally derived ingredients, it is vegan and free from phthalates and colourants, embodying purity and sophistication in every drop. Cruelty-free & vegan-friendly.Notes: Saffron, Pepper, Rose Centifolia, Cistus Labdanum and Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Elysia Pista Sundae Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Elysia Pista Sundae Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a delightfully decadent gourmand EDP that blends creamy indulgence with soft florals and fruity freshness. Sweet, playful and irresistibly delicious, it captures the joyful indulgence of a favourite dessert reimagined as a luxurious scent, perfect for those who love their perfumes rich, creamy and addictive.Opening with an irresistible combination of Pistachio, Hazelnut and a cool scoop of Ice Cream, it delivers a nutty-sweet introduction that is both creamy and unique. The heart reveals an elegant balance of luminous Jasmine, juicy Pear and tangy Raspberry, adding brightness and playful charm. In the base, smooth Cream and velvety Vanilla create a warm, milky finish that lingers softly on the skin. Top Notes: Pistachio, Hazelnut and Ice Cream. Heart Notes: Jasmine, Pear and Raspberry. Base Notes: Cream and Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Matiere Premiere Radical Rose Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Matière Première Radical Rose Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a unisex floral EDP that showcases the world's highest concentration of Rose Centifolia Absolute, meticulously extracted from organically grown flowers in the Grasse region of France.This unique rose is both dark and luminous, revealing its full complexity through a harmonious blend of floral, woody and spicy nuances. Radiant, spicy facets are enhanced by touches of Saffron and Jamaican Pepper Berry, while its deeper, earthy character is enriched with Indonesian Patchouli and Andalusian Cistus Labdanum. Composed with between 85% and 92% naturally derived ingredients, this vegan fragrance is free from phthalates and colourants, offering a pure and refined interpretation of one of nature's most iconic blooms. Cruelty-free & vegan-friendly. Top Notes: Saffron and Jamaican Pepper Berry. Heart Notes: Rose Centifolia Absolute. Base Notes: Indonesian Patchouli and Andalusian Cistus Labdanum.

listings.rawTitle: French Avenue Veneno Bianco Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: French Avenue Veneno Bianco Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an exquisite composition that captures soft seduction and creamy sophistication. A radiant counterpart to its darker sibling, it blends tropical elegance, floral beauty, and velvety warmth into a fragrance that feels fresh, comforting, and irresistibly refined.Opening with sparkling Bergamot and Neroli, softened by the creamy richness of Milk, it delivers a unique and soothing introduction that is cool, airy, and effortlessly smooth. The heart reveals a lush bouquet of Tiare Flowers, Ylang-Ylang, and White Flowers, evoking sun-drenched island serenity with a romantic, creamy elegance. As it settles, Coconut and Vanilla bring gourmand softness, Guaiac Wood adds a subtle smokiness, and Labdanum infuses amber-like warmth for a beautifully resinous finish. Top Notes: Bergamot, Neroli, and Milk. Heart Notes: Tiare Flowers, Ylang-Ylang, and White Flowers. Base Notes: Coconut, Vanilla, Guaiac Wood, and Labdanum.

listings.rawTitle: French Avenue Royal Blend Sequoia Extrait De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: French Avenue Royal Blend Sequoia Extrait De Parfum (100ml) is a deeply sophisticated fragrance that blends the warmth of rare woods with the richness of gourmand accords, creating an unforgettable scent with refined boldness and lasting allure.Opening with a captivating burst of Cognac, it is elevated by the sweet juiciness of Raspberry and the intoxicating depth of Liquor, delivering a bold yet elegant introduction. The heart reveals a warm, vanilla-like sweetness from Tonka Bean, balanced by the floral opulence of Bulgarian Rose and the earthy green depth of Oakmoss. As it settles, Praline adds a delectable gourmand twist, seamlessly fused with the smokiness of Oak and the creamy smoothness of Sandalwood, leaving a warm, woody and irresistible trail. Top Notes: Cognac, Raspberry and Liquor. Heart Notes: Tonka Bean, Bulgarian Rose and Oakmoss. Base Notes: Praline, Oak and Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Diesel Only The Brave Eau De Parfum 125ml
listings.description: Diesel Only The Brave Eau De Parfum (125ml) is a fougère fragrance for men that intensifies the original Only The Brave statement with heightened sensuality and strength.Opening with the energising freshness of Lemon, Mandarin and Coriander, the scent evolves into a heart of aromatic Clary Sage and Lavandin, before settling into a warm, seductive base of Suede accord and a gourmand accord. Presented in the iconic deep blue clenched fist bottle, it symbolises unwavering strength, fearlessness and the power to surpass limits. Top Notes: Lemon, Mandarin and Coriander. Heart Notes: Clary Sage and Lavandin. Base Notes: Suede accord and gourmand accord.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Man Ice Eau De Toilette 200ml
listings.description: Jimmy Choo Man Ice Eau De Toilette (200ml) is a woody, aromatic fragrance for men which exudes moody masculinity, innate confidence, and effortless attitude, set against the softer spirit of his passion and humour.Dangerously seductive and sophisticated, this EDT has been designed for the contemporary man who lives life on the edge. Top Notes: Citron, Bergamot and Mandarin Orange. Heart Notes: Apple, Cedar, Vetiver and Patchouli. Base Notes: Ambroxan, Musk and Moss.

listings.rawTitle: Matiere Premiere Crystal Saffron Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Matière Première Crystal Saffron Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a spicy unisex EDP that celebrates the luminous and crystalline essence of natural Saffron grown in Greece, renowned as the highest quality Saffron in the worldIt presents a captivating fusion of dark, bold and spicy notes balanced by light, vibrant undertones, resulting in a scent that is both powerful and addictive. The fragrance's contemporary masculine-feminine character is enhanced by Habanolide Musk, while Ambroxan lends a comforting and irresistible quality. Somali Incense Essence intensifies the liveliness and projection of the Saffron, adding texture and depth to the composition. Crafted with between 85% and 92% naturally derived ingredients, this gender-neutral fragrance is vegan and free from phthalates and colourants, embodying purity and sophistication in every drop. Cruelty-free & vegan-friendly.Notes: Saffron Oil, Musk Habanolide, Ambroxan and Somalian Incense.

listings.rawTitle: Ariana Grande MOD Vanilla Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Ariana Grande MOD Vanilla Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an expressive, woody gourmand EDP that forms part of Ariana's modern and sensual MOD collection. Designed to celebrate duality and the freedom of self-expression, it delivers a luxurious and addictive scent experience.MOD Vanilla opens with a luscious fusion of Juicy Plum and Creamy Musks, uplifted by the luminous freshness of Pink Freesia. The heart blends rich Orris Butter with decadent White Praline for a sophisticated gourmand twist. In the base, indulgent Vanilla Absolute and upcycled Cocoa Butter add depth and warmth, creating a beautifully complex and unforgettable signature. Top Notes: Pink Freesia, Juicy Plum and Creamy Musks. Heart Notes: Orris Butter, White Praline and Jasmine Petals. Base Notes: Vanilla Absolute and Cocoa Butter.

listings.rawTitle: French Avenue Tropical Kiss Eau De Parfum 80ml
listings.description: French Avenue Tropical Kiss Eau De Parfum (80ml) captures the essence of a blissful tropical escape, blending vibrant fruits, exotic florals and warm, comforting base notes into an EDP that feels both refreshing and captivating.Opening with juicy Mango, calming Chamomile and the delicate citrus of Orange Blossom, it delivers an invigorating and uplifting introduction. The heart reveals a lush bouquet of Ylang Ylang, soft powdery Orris and creamy Coconut, evoking the serenity of an island getaway. In the base, Amber adds resinous warmth, Benzoin brings sweet balsamic richness, and Vanilla wraps the composition in a creamy, sensual finish. listings.description: Lancome Trésor Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a light and delicate, floral EDP for women which exudes the unmistakable scent of everlasting love.Concealing this absolute emotion like a nugget of hidden treasure within its composition, the scent romantically exposes it through the elegant blend of Rose, Lily Of The Valley and Lilac, with sparkling Peach and Apricot Blossom conveying the innately joyful discovery in a burst of luminosity. The crystalline jewel shape of the bottle is as resplendent as love itself, with its multifaceted, sculpted shape catching and reflecting the light. The intricate cap is adorned with a ring of black lacquer, symbolising eternal union. Top Notes: Rose Petals, Apricot Blossoms and Peach Tree Flowers. Heart Notes: Lily of the Valley, Vanilla, Heliotrope and Iris. Base Notes: Sandalwood and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Perfect Intense Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Marc Jacobs Perfect Intense Eau De Parfum (50ml) is an amber, floral EDP for women which takes its inspiration from Marc Jacobs' philosophical mantra I am perfect as I am' which is symbolised by a tattoo of the word perfect' on his wrist.The scent conveys the concept of self-worth, accepting and embracing one's true self with a sense of optimism, self-satisfaction, and pride. This composition opens with a heady floral melange of Daffodil and Jasmine, leading on to a nutty heart of Roasted Almonds. The composition culminates in an earthy, sultry dry down of Sandalwood. Designed in collaboration with Marc Jacobs himself and including an unusual mix of disparate elements, the bottle has a weighted glass base and displays all the femininity and grace of a classic parfum. The crystal-cut cap is crowned with a bizarre collection of mis-matched charms, all bedecked in shades of gold, silver, black, white, yellow, and a dash of cherry red. Top Notes: Daffodil and Night Blooming Jasmine. Heart Notes: Roasted Almonds. Base Notes: Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Explorer Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Montblanc Explorer Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a masculine woody, aromatic leather fragrance which takes you on a fantastic journey, an irresistible call for adventure. This unconventional woody, aromatic EDP reveals Italian Bergamot with green notes, contrasting with rich Vetiver and Patchouli from Indonesia. The bottle depicts the Earth's two hemispheres, recalling the multiple destinations explored during this olfactory expedition. At the bottom lies Montblanc's emblem, the iconic star representing the six glaciers of the highest mountain in Europe. Top Notes: Bergamot and Sage. Heart Notes: Pomarose. Base Notes: Leather, Vetiver, Sandalwood, Patchouli, Ambrofix and Akigalawood.

listings.rawTitle: Lattafa Asad Eau De Parfum 100ml

This culminates in a base where the unique combination of powdery Amber, spicy Vanilla and slightly caramelised Benzoin is interspersed with accords of Dry Woods and bitter Labdanum. Top Notes: Black Pepper, Pineapple and Tobacco. Heart Notes: Coffee, Iris and Patchouli. Base Notes: Amber, Vanilla, Dry Woods, Benzoin and Labdanum

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Tobacco Vanille Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Tom Ford Tobacco Vanille Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an oriental spicy EDP for women and men which seeks to replicate the classic, warm aromas which emanate within the typical London private members club.Opening with an iconic combination of Spicy Notes and heady Tobacco Leaf, the composition moves on to a heart where the creamy sensuality of Vanilla, Cacao and Tonka Bean meets the delicacy of Tobacco Blossom. listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Mon Guerlain Eau De Parfum 50ml

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier La Belle Eau De Parfum 100ml

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild Eau De Parfum 50ml

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Taylor Passion Eau De Toilette 74ml
listings.description: Elizabeth Taylor Passion Eau De Toilette (74ml) is a refined, woody and oriental fragrance that is ideal for the more mature, sophisticated and confident woman, this mature fragrance is perfect for evening wear.Sensual and elegant, Passion is a fantastic EDT to be worn on romantic evenings. listings.rawTitle: Lacoste L.12.12 Noir Men Eau De Toilette 50ml

listings.rawTitle: Ard Al Zaafaran Jazzab Gold Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Ard Al Zaafaran Jazzab Gold Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an opulent and sophisticated EDP that blends fresh florals, spices and rich woods into a captivating composition.Opening with vibrant citrus, delicate Roses and the earthy depth of Cedar, it delivers a bright yet refined introduction that sets the tone for an indulgent scent journey. Base Notes: Woody Notes, Amber, Cedar, Oud and Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: French Avenue After Effect Extrait De Parfum 80ml
listings.description: French Avenue After Effect Extrait De Parfum (80ml) is an enchanting blend of spices and woods, capturing the essence of intrigue and sophistication. listings.rawTitle: Sundae Hair & Body Fragrance Mist Soft Serve 90ml
listings.description: Sundae Hair & Body Fragrance Mist Soft Serve (90ml) is a sweet, gourmand mist that refreshes both hair and skin with an ultra-fine spray. Heart Notes: Pistachio and Rose Petal. Base Notes: Musk, Balsam, Vanilla and Heliotrope.

listings.rawTitle: Matiere Premiere Vanilla Powder Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Matière Première Vanilla Powder Eau De Parfum (50ml) is an amber unisex EDP that showcases the sophisticated richness of Vanilla Absolute from Madagascar, sourced through the Fair for Life agricultural programme.It unfolds as an enveloping and luminous cloud, contrasting the deep, dark warmth of the Vanilla with a contemporary overdose of perfumer's white powders, creating the impression of a Vanilla pod painted white. Cruelty-free & vegan-friendly. Top Notes: Coconut Powder. Heart Notes: Vanilla Absolute. Base Notes: Palo Santo and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Sundae Hair & Body Fragrance Mist Flower Girl 90ml

listings.rawTitle: Diesel Only The Brave Eau De Parfum 50ml

listings.rawTitle: Matiere Premiere Crystal Saffron Extrait De Parfum 100ml

listings.rawTitle: French Avenue Grecia Eau De Parfum 100ml

listings.rawTitle: Aveeno Daily Moisturising Yogurt Body Cream Apricot & Honey Scent 300ml

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana Devotion Eau De Parfum 30ml

listings.rawTitle: Jennifer Lopez Live Luxe Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Jennifer Lopez Live Luxe Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a fruity and floral EDP fragrance inspired by Jennifer's passion for dance and all things luxurious.It opens with top notes of juicy Mandarin Orange, Apple and Lemon which develops into a sophisticated heart reminiscent of a glittering bouquet of Rose, Jasmine, Lily of the Valley and Ylang Ylang. The fragrance is completed with notes of Amber, Forest Berries, Sandalwood, and a Musk Accord. Top Notes: Mandarin Orange, Apple and Lemon. Heart Notes: Rose, Jasmine Lily of the Valley and Ylang Ylang. Base Notes: Amber, Forest Berries, Sandalwood, Musk Accord.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradoxe Radical Essence Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Prada Paradoxe Radical Essence Parfum (50ml) is an empowering and immersive fragrance that redefines modern femininity by balancing strength with delicacy. This unique composition takes a paradoxical approach to perfumery, blending floral, ambery and woody elements into an enveloping aroma that is both complex and comforting. The fragrance opens with the radiant brightness of Neroli Oil and Orange Flower Absolute, creating a fresh and luminous floral introduction. At the heart, an unexpected Salted Pistachio Accord adds a modern gourmand twist, giving depth and individuality. As it settles, the warm, sensual tones of Sandalwood Accord create a soft, lingering base that envelops the senses. The journey moves from vibrant florals to a salty-gourmand heart and finishes with a creamy, woody warmth. Presented in Prada's iconic triangle flacon, set on its side for an off-centre and unconventional aesthetic, it mirrors the character of this idiosyncratic scent. Top Notes: Neroli Oil and Orange Flower Absolute. Heart Notes: Salted Pistachio Accord. Base Notes: Sandalwood Accord.

listings.rawTitle: Bvlgari Man In Black Eau De Parfum 60ml
listings.description: Bvlgari Man In Black Eau De Parfum (60ml) is a bold and magnetic EDP that embodies the elemental force of fire, creating a powerful statement of modern masculinity. The scent ignites with an energetic burst of vibrant spices blended with the warmth of ambery rum, creating an intoxicating and daring opening. At its heart, rich Tuberose Flower and Iris Concrete intertwine with a smooth Leather Accord, adding depth and sensuality. The fragrance then settles into a warm, creamy base of Benzoin, Tonka Bean and Guaiac Wood, leaving a lingering trail that is both powerful and seductive. The fragrance journey moves from spicy intensity to floral-leathery richness and concludes with a deep, velvety warmth. Housed in a sleek matte black bottle embossed with the Bvlgari logo. Top Notes: Vibrant Spices and Ambery Rum. Heart Notes: Tuberose Flower, Iris Concrete and Leather Accord. Base Notes: Benzoin, Tonka Bean and Guaiac Wood.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Alhambra Sceptre Malachite Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Maison Alhambra Sceptre Malachite Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an intricate and artistic EDP that blurs the line between scent and art, offering a sophisticated olfactory experience.This fragrance brings together a rich and captivating blend of accords, creating a scent that is both enigmatic and refined. Fresh spicy and herbal tones open the fragrance with an invigorating lift, seamlessly merging into aromatic and warm spicy nuances that add depth and texture. At its heart, an opulent Rose note blooms against a backdrop of Amber warmth, while Oud adds a sensual, smoky richness that lingers on the skin. The result is an alluring and memorable fragrance that transports the senses into a world of elegance and artistry. Top Notes: Fresh spicy and herbal accords. Heart Notes: Rose, aromatic notes and warm spices. Base Notes: Amber and Oud.

listings.rawTitle: Bvlgari Man Wood Essence Eau De Parfum 60ml
listings.description: Bvlgari Man Wood Essence Eau De Parfum (60ml) is a woody and aromatic EDP that reconnects man with nature through a dynamic blend of vibrant spices and rich woods, evoking strength and grounded energy.The composition opens with the sharp freshness of Italian citrus zests and aromatic Coriander Essence, creating an invigorating first impression. In the heart, earthy Vetiver from Haiti and Cypress Wood bring a green, resinous depth that emphasises the natural character of the scent. Finally, the base settles into a smooth, grounding fusion of Benzoin from Siam, Cedarwood and an Ambergris Accord, leaving a lasting trail of warmth and masculine sophistication. The fragrance journey moves from bright citrus to earthy woods and finishes with a refined, resinous warmth. Top Notes: Essence of Coriander and Italian Citrus Zests. Heart Notes: Cypress Wood and Vetiver from Haiti. Base Notes: Benzoin from Siam, Cedarwood and Ambergris Accord.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia Eau De Parfum 150ml
listings.description: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia Eau De Parfum (150ml) is a chypre floral EDP for women, conveying the image of a confident wearer brimming with inner strength.The composition features the fruity floral sweetness of the Magnolia flower, its Clary Sage-like edge exuding a joyous spirit. The olfactory melange opens with the juicy citrus notes of Dewberry in sensual unison with the creamy Vanilla freshness of Coconut. This leads on to the floral heart of Magnolia, Jasmine Sambac and calming, warming Clary Sage. The scent culminates in the earthy, intense woodiness of Patchouli and Blonde Woods in a drydown which includes the mellow, leathery undertones of Musk. Gucci's iconic flora pattern, featuring vibrant blooms and rich hues, decorates both the bottle and outer packaging of Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia with its captivating purple shade. Top Notes: Dewberry and Coconut. Heart Notes: Magnolia, Jasmine Sambac and Clary Sage. Base Notes: Musk, Patchouli and Blonde Woods.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Ombre Leather Eau De Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Tom Ford Ombre Leather Eau De Parfum (10ml) is a floral leather, deeply textural EDP which bestows the wearer with a tactile sensuality and the beautiful sense of being desired.With each olfactory note inspired by Tom Ford's American West upbringing, the composition opens with the intensely powerful green scent of Violet Leaf Absolute in combination with the invigorating warm, sweet spice of Cardamom. This leads to a captivating heart where fragrant Jasmine Sambac with its Honeysuckle facets meets the luxurious, creamy sensuality of the signature Black Leather notes. The intoxicating earthiness of Patchouli in the base is given a fresh crispness by the presence of Moss whilst Amber brings a sweet richness. The fragrant liquid is housed in a matte black flacon adorned with a faux leather plaque. Top Notes: Cardamom and Violet Flower. Heart Notes: Jasmine and Black Leather. Base Notes: Amber, Patchouli and Moss.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Never Ending Summer Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Maison Margiela Replica Never Ending Summer Eau De Toilette (100ml) captures the carefree spirit of an eternal summer on the Amalfi Coast, where time slows and every moment feels sun-soaked and free. Created by perfumer Christophe Raynaud, this spicy citrus fragrance evokes the vibrancy of an Italian escape, inspired by the sparkling atmosphere of unplanned adventures and the mood of a never-ending holiday.The fragrance opens with the brightness of a unique Italian Spritz Accord, blended with zesty Bitter Orange and a lively duet of Pepper for an instant burst of energy. In the heart, an aromatic infusion of Earl Grey Accord, Cardamom Heart and Nutmeg Essence adds a refined, spiced warmth that recalls lazy afternoons by the sea. Finally, a sensual base of Cashmeran, Vanilla Accord and Peru Balsam Resinoïd wraps the fragrance in a soft, sun-drenched warmth that lingers on the skin. The fragrance journey moves from sparkling citrus freshness to aromatic spiced warmth, finishing with a smooth, balmy embrace.Maison Margiela's Replica collection of unique scents have been deliberately concocted to recall personally cherished memories, reawakening and reliving the emotions involved. Reflecting a minimalistic approach, the Replica bottle is simple in design with a cotton label bearing the fragrance's name. Top Notes: Spritz Accord, Bitter Orange and Pepper duet. Heart Notes: Earl Grey Accord, Cardamom Heart and Nutmeg Essence. Base Notes: Cashmeran, Vanilla Accord and Peru Balsam Resinoïd.

listings.rawTitle: Bvlgari Man In Black Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Bvlgari Man In Black Parfum (100ml) is an intensely sophisticated amber-woody fragrance that celebrates the mythical power of fire, reinterpreting the original Man in Black with a more concentrated and smouldering character.The fragrance ignites with an opening of smoked spices and resinous Elemi Essence, creating a bold, textured first impression. At its heart, lavish floral notes of Tuberose Absolute and Iris Essence bring an unexpected freshness and elegance that softens the fiery intensity. As it settles, the base reveals a deep fusion of Benzoin and Dark Woods, imparting a leather-like, incense-inspired richness that lingers on the skin with suave, magnetic sensuality. The journey moves from fiery spice to floral refinement and finishes with a warm, resinous depth. Top Notes: Vibrant Spices Accord and Elemi Essence. Heart Notes: Tuberose Absolute and Iris Essence. Base Notes: Dark Wood Accord and Benzoin of Siam Absolute.

listings.rawTitle: Initio Paragon Extrait De Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Initio Paragon Extrait De Parfum (90ml) is a woody spicy fragrance which transcends the skin, reaching deep into the soul to awaken a sense of serenity and inner harmony.Crafted for both women and men, this unisex creation is a journey into the sacred, drawing from the botanical essence of Palo Santo and White Sage, plants revered for centuries by Inca shamans for their protective and purifying powers. At the first touch, Paragon opens with the refreshing calm of Lavender, Sage, and Bergamot, inviting a sense of peace. As it unfolds, notes of ripe Plum and vibrant Black Pepper merge with the mystic warmth of Palo Santo, creating a heart that pulses with energy and depth. The fragrance settles into a grounding base of Sandalwood and rich Agarwood, forming a protective aura around body and spirit. Made in France, Paragon is more than a scent; it is a ritual, a portal to plenitude, and a call to connect with your highest self. Top Notes: Lavender, Sage and Bergamot. Heart Notes: Plum, Palo Santo and Black Pepper. Base Notes: Sandalwood and Agarwood (Oud).

listings.rawTitle: Cerruti 1881 Homme Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Cerruti 1881 Homme Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a sophisticated, timeless fragrance, which is simultaneously seductive and refreshing that calls to mind images of Nature and the great outdoors.Woody with spicy florals, this EDT blends sun kissed herbal elements with velvety, woody notes. Housed in an on-trend, transparent glass bottle stamped with the iconic 1881 logo. Cruelty-free. Top notes: Blackcurrant, Cypress, Bergamot. Heart notes: Ylang Ylang, Patchouli. Base notes: Sandalwood, Pine, Oak, Moss.

listings.rawTitle: Elie Saab Girl Of Now Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Elie Saab Girl Of Now Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a floral, gourmand EDP for women which depicts a playful, spontaneous free spirit whose magnetism and positivity embodies a new generation. In the composition, the Elie Saab olfactory signature of Orange Blossom and Patchouli has been enhanced with an Almond note.Opening with an uplifting blend of Pear, Mandarin Orange and freshly-roasted Pistachio, the scent leads on to the Ormond Flower, combining Almond Essence with Orange Flower. This fragrance culminates in a sensual, woody base of Patchouli and Cashmeran with additional Almond notes. Top Notes: Pistachio, Pear and Mandarin Orange. Heart Notes: Almond, Orange Blossom and Magnolia. Base Notes: Almond Milk, Tonka Bean, Cashmeran and Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden Sunflowers Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Elizabeth Arden Sunflowers Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a classic floral and fruity women's fragrance from the iconic beauty house's extensive collection. The scent was formulated to reflect the warm feeling of a fresh day.This light hearted women's EDT is ideal for casual everyday wear and creates a celebration of...

This leads on...

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana Pour Homme Intenso Eau De Parfum 125ml
listings.description: Dolce & Gabbana Pour Homme Intenso Eau De Parfum (125ml) is a woody aromatic EDP for men which depicts a strong, determined personality, characterised by freedom of expression and a respect for tradition coupled with a zest for modernity.This composition opens with fresh aquatic notes and the verdant melange of Basil and Lavender. South African Moepel Wood at the heart delivers its luxurious floral, balsamic and honey accents, whilst Tobacco is flavoured by the dry notes of Hay Absolute and Bran. Woody intensity and strength in the dry down is provided by the combination of Labdanum, Sandalwood and Cypress. Top Notes: Lavender, Water Notes, Basil, Marigold and Geranium. Heart Notes: Tobacco, Hay, Clary Sage, Moepel Accord and Bran. Base Notes: Sandalwood, Cypress, Musk, Amber and Labdanum.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana The One for Men Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Dolce & Gabbana The One for Men Eau De Parfum (50ml) is an elegant and sensual fragrance, which uses classic notes but with a modern touch.Stronger scented than its toilette counterpart, this EDP is both vibrant and engaging, unleashing a symphony of fresh, herbaceous notes which slowly develop to reveal a spicy, aromatic heart, before drying to reveal a base of woody undertones. The fragrance is housed in an elegant glass bottle which truly showcases the fragrance as the star of the show, topped by a sleek wooden stopper. Top Notes: Grapefruit, Coriander and Basil. Heart Notes: Ginger, Cardamom, and Sweet Orange Blossom. Base Notes: Tobacco, Amber and Cedarwood.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana Pour Femme Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Dolce & Gabbana Pour Femme Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a floral, Mediterranean inspired EDP for women filled with harmonising floral and sweet notes which allows the wearer the experience the full essence of femininity.Inspired by the riches of the Mediterranean, this perfume embodies the very being of the D&G woman - passionate, sensual and maternal. The D&G woman is aware of her strengths, her instincts and the choices she makes to better herself.A single spritz reveals tasteful opening notes, combining sweet hints of Raspberry and Mandarin Orange with soothing Neroli before becoming intertwined with a heart of Jasmine which sensually melts into citrusy Orange Blossom. The parfum rests on a bed of seductive sugary Marshmallow, Vanilla, Heliotrope and Sandalwood. The fragrance is housed in a simple glass bottle, revealing the star of the show within. Top Notes: Raspberry, Neroli and Mandarin Orange. Heart Notes: Orange Blossom and Jasmine. Base Notes: Marshmallow, Vanilla, Sandalwood and Heliotrope.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Eau De Toilette 150ml
listings.description: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Eau De Toilette (150ml) is a bold, woody aromatic EDT for men which is perfect for everyday wear. This perfume conveys the dichotomy of the male psyche - strong yet sensitive, relaxed yet sophisticated.Opening with the sharpness of Grapefruit and White Pepper, the heart counters this with an earthy, woody and nutty blend of Vetiver with Clary Sage. This culminates in the spicy, rich sweetness of Tonka Bean and Cocoa in the base. The fragrance is presented in a distinctive bottle, fashioned in the shape of a bolt of lightning, depicting heroic mental and physical powers. Top Notes: Grapefruit and White Pepper. Heart Notes: Vetiver and Clary Sage. Base Notes: Tonka Bean and Cocoa.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Intense Femme Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Intense Femme Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a luminous and citrus filled EDP for women, inspired by the blue shores and skies of the beautiful Mediterranean. More than just a scent, the nose behind this fragrance carefully selected notes to capture the pure aura Mediterranean, allowing you to escape with a simple spritz.With wondrously sharp and tangy notes, this fragrance opens with citrus hints of Lemon and Granny Smith Apple, following by a floral accentuating heart of Jasmine and Marigold before settling on a musky base of Musk and Amberwood. The parfum is housed in an attractive frosted glass bottle, showcasing the sky blue perfume within to remind you of the clear skies above the seas. Top Notes: Lemon and Granny Smith Apple. Heart Notes: Jasmine and Marigold. Base Notes: Musk and Amberwood.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana Q For Her Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Dolce & Gabbana Q For Her Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a fruity and woody EDP which has been created to make every woman feel like a queen. Refined, feminine and powerful, it seeks to convey regal charisma and fortitude.The composition opens with the sensual scent of sweet and fruity Jasmine melding with the sparkling citrus burst of Lemon and Blood Orange. This leads on to a seductive heart where the complex peppery and balsamic notes from a creamy Heliotrope blend with sweet Cherry. This culminates in a powerful, woody base of Cedarwood and Musk. The elegant bottle reveals the pink femininity of the fragrance within whilst the ornate red and gold, crown-shaped stopper accentuates the idea of the female ruler. Top Notes: Sicilian Lemon, Jasmine and Blood Orange. Heart Notes: Cherry and Heliotrope. Base Notes: Musk and Cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity Air For Men Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Calvin Klein Eternity Air For Men Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a fresh and aromatic fougère EDT that captures the energy and expansiveness of sky and sea. This modern reinterpretation of the classic Eternity signature opens with a bright and invigorating blend of Mandarin Oil, Juniper Berry Oil and the airy Sky of the Sky Accord, creating an uplifting introduction. At the heart, Lavender Oil, crisp Green Apple and Violet Leaves bring a cool, herbaceous freshness that enhances the scent's clean sophistication. As it dries down, a smooth and sensual base of Patchouli Oil, Sea Moss and Ambergris lends depth and lasting warmth, evoking the serenity of the ocean. Exhilarating and effortlessly masculine, this fragrance is ideal for the modern man seeking a scent that's both vibrant and refined. Top Notes: Mandarin Oil, Juniper Berry Oil and Sky of the Sky Accord. Heart Notes: Lavender Oil, Green Apple and Violet Leaves. Base Notes: Patchouli Oil, Sea Moss and Ambergris.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera 212 VIP Men Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Carolina Herrera 212 VIP Men Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a bold, charismatic EDT inspired by the energy and exclusivity of the most unforgettable parties. Created for the man who lives by his own rules and owns the night, this scent embodies confidence, seduction and a rebellious spirit.It opens with the vibrant and daring combination of Vodka Zubrowska and Caviar Lime, delivering a crisp edge that instantly captures attention. At its heart, Hot Ginger and Black Pepper add a spicy, magnetic warmth that energises and excites. The base settles into an intensely masculine trail of King Wood and Amber, leaving a lasting impression that's both sensual and unforgettable. Housed in a sleek, high-shine silver block, the bottle reflects the allure of the night and the unapologetic presence of the man who wears it. Top Notes: Vodka Zubrowska and Caviar Lime. Heart Notes: Hot Ginger and Black Pepper. Base Notes: King Wood and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Van Cleef & Arpels Oud Blanc Eau De Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Van Cleef & Arpels Oud Blanc Eau De Parfum (75ml) is a captivating EDP which evokes an enigmatic allure that unfolds with every breath.It begins with the unexpected richness of a Date accord, offering a sweet, almost resinous warmth that sets the tone for what lies ahead. At the heart, the depth of Oud Accord merges with the opulence of Turkish Rose Absolute and the sacred intensity of Incense, creating a luxurious blend that is both bold and refined. As the scent settles, aldehydic White Musks and the soft embrace of Vanilla Pod emerge, leaving a luminous, smoky trail that lingers in the air like a whispered secret.The Collection Extraordinaire embodies the quest for emotion that has guided Van Cleef & Arpels since its beginnings. This olfactory experience pays tribute to the noble substances and ingredients used in perfumery, exalting them like precious gemstones. Top Notes: Date Accord. Heart Notes: Oud Accord, Turkish Rose Absolute and Incense. Base Notes: Aldehydic White Musks and Vanilla Pod.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Myslf L'Absolu Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent Myslf L'Absolu Parfum (100ml) is a bold, intensified interpretation of the original Myslf scent, crafted for those who seek a deeper, more magnetic fragrance experience.The trail opens with an energising burst of sparkling Ginger Essence and Cardamom, followed by the radiant floral heart of Orange Blossom, rich and expressive. At its base, a sensual fusion of warm, earthy Patchouli creates a long-lasting, enveloping signature that lingers on skin with effortless allure. Encased in a sleek, tone-on-tone metallic mirror bottle, this statement fragrance brings a heightened olfactory contrast, where freshness and depth collide with refined precision. Sustainably minded, Myslf L'Absolu incorporates responsibly sourced natural ingredients. The Patchouli is cultivated in Indonesia through fair trade programmes that support underprivileged local communities, reaffirming YSL Beauty's commitment to ethical luxury. Top Notes: Ginger Essence and Cardamom. Heart Notes: Orange Blossom. Base Notes: Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Afnan Turathi Electric Eau De Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Afnan Turathi Electric Eau De Parfum (90ml) is an aromatic fruity EDP crafted for both women and men, born from the fusion of raw energy and storied heritage. This bold scent embodies a vibrant duality, fresh yet refined, modern yet timeless.It opens with an electrifying burst of zesty Bergamot, iridescent Lavender and juicy Grapefruit, immediately capturing the senses with its crisp clarity. As it unfolds, sleek notes of crisp Apple and the smooth texture of warm Cedarwood emerge, adding depth and contemporary elegance. The fragrance settles into a magnetic base of warm Vanilla, dry Amber and Musk, creating a rich, lingering trail that leaves an unforgettable impression. Designed to channel the spirit of an endless summer, Turathi Electric is as suited for sunlit days as it is for sophisticated evenings. Top Notes: Pear, Mandarin Orange, Pink Grapefruit and Bergamot. Heart Notes: Orange Blossom, Cedarwood and Apple. Base Notes: Vanilla, Musk and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Legend Red Eau De Parfum 200ml
listings.description: Montblanc Legend Red Eau De Parfum (200ml) is a woody, fruity EDP for men which emboldens and empowers the wearer.Elevating the heartbeat with a sensation of speed, the fragrance opens with the citrus energy of Blood Orange and Grapefruit, leading on to an intense, aromatic heart of Clary Sage and Juniper. This culminates in a woody dry down of Mahogany, Cedar, and Tonka Bean. The chic bottle has an intense red, lacquered finish and silver cap engraved with the renowned Montblanc logo. Top Notes: Blood Orange, Grapefruit and Cardamom. Heart Notes: Cedar, Juniper Berries and Clary Sage. Base Notes: Mahogany, Tonka Bean and Atlas Cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Afnan Historic Sahara Extrait De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Afnan Historic Sahara Extrait De Parfum (100ml) is an oriental vanilla fragrance which transports you to the warmth of an endless horizon , a unisex scent inspired by the golden glow of desert landscapes and the allure of ancient journeys.It begins with a captivating blend of Bergamot, Cinnamon and Cardamom, radiant spices which stir the senses and hint at adventure. As the scent evolves, it reveals a heart of Elemi, Vanilla and Sugar, offering a smooth, gourmand richness that conjures the soft heat of sun-drenched sands and the calm of twilight skies. The journey lingers in a sensual base of Musk, Almond, Tonka, Wood, Praline and Ambroxan, a velvety finish that wraps the skin in quiet intensity. Bold yet refined, this fragrance is a tribute to those who move through the world with depth, grace and a touch of mystery. Top Notes: Bergamot, Cinnamon and Cardamom. Heart Notes: Elemi, Vanilla and Sugar. Base Notes: Musk, Almond, Tonka, Wood, Praline and Ambroxan.

listings.rawTitle: Swiss Arabian Passion Of Venice Extrait De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Swiss Arabian Passion Of Venice Extrait De Parfum (100ml) is a premium extrait de parfum that captures the enigmatic allure and timeless elegance of one of the world's most romantic cities. From the very first spray, it unveils a luminous harmony of Green Leaves and vibrant Pink Peppercorn, subtly softened by the depth of Black Pepper, creating an opening that feels both fresh and warmly inviting. As the fragrance unfolds, a heart of Jasmine, Patchouli and Cedarwood emerges, rich and luxurious, evoking the grandeur and mystery of Venice's hidden corners and historic charm. The base lingers with a sensual blend of Musk, Amber, Sandalwood and Vanilla, wrapping the wearer in a soft, lasting impression that speaks of passion, nostalgia, and the artistic soul of a city that has inspired poets for centuries. Passion Of Venice is a memory immortalised, a scent that stirs emotion and brings the spirit of Venice to life with every wear. Top Notes: Green Leaves, Black Pepper and Pink Peppercorn. Heart Notes: Jasmine, Cedarwood and Patchouli. Base Notes: Musk, Amber Dry, Sandalwood and Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Goddess Intense Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Burberry Goddess Intense Eau De Parfum (30ml) is a gourmand woody EDP that builds on the original Goddess with deeper sensuality and strength. Inspired by self-discovery and inner power, the scent captures the radiant warmth of sunset through a richer, smokier blend of notes, fronted by brand ambassador Emma Mackey.The composition opens with luminous Lavender Essence, leading into a signature quartet of vanillas - infusion, caviar, absolute and vanilla wood - that bring warmth, sweetness and depth. Patchouli grounds the fragrance in a soft earthiness, creating a bold yet elegant trail that lingers beautifully on the skin. The bottle features Burberry's heritage-inspired gold medallion and label design. Top Notes: Lavender Essence. Heart Notes: Vanilla infusion, Vanilla caviar, Vanilla absolute and Vanilla wood. Base Notes: Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Swiss Arabian Musk 01 Extrait De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Swiss Arabian Musk 01 Extrait De Parfum (50ml) is a luxurious fragrance crafted for true musk aficionados, blending radiant florals and sensual musks into a refined and modern composition. It opens with the distinctive vibrancy of Elemi Resin, brightened by sparkling Bergamot and warmed by the spicy sweetness of Pink Pepper. A graceful floral heart unfolds with blooming buds of Orange Blossom and Lily, softened by a veil of delicate Musk. As the fragrance settles, rich Tonka, creamy Sandalwood, and golden Vanilla entwine with Musk once more, creating a lasting, silky base that lingers beautifully on the skin. Top Notes: Bergamot, Pink Pepper and Elemi. Heart Notes: Orange Blossom, Lily and Musk. Base Notes: Tonka, Musk, Vanilla and Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Swiss Arabian Rose 01 Eau De Parfum 50ml

listings.description: Creed Aventus Cologne Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a woody, citrus, refreshing and uplifting cologne version of the classic Aventus EDP, complementing the acclaimed cult classic original with an element of modernity whilst retaining its renowned longevity. Depicting a daring, urban-spirited wearer, this uplifting cologne bestows him with alluring style, strength and vigour, implying success and achievement.The composition opens with an aromatic, fruity melange of warming Ginger, zesty Mandarin and spicy Pink Peppercorn. This leads on to a sumptuous heart featuring earthy Patchouli, deeply sweet and creamy Sandalwood and Vetiver. This culminates in a leathery, balsamic drydown base of sensual Styrax, smoky Birch and Musk. Top Notes: Pink Peppercorn, Ginger & Mandarin. Heart Notes: Vetiver, Patchouli and Pineapple. Base notes: Birch, Styrax and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Intense Femme Eau De Parfum 25ml
listings.description: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Intense Femme Eau De Parfum (25ml) is a luminous and citrus-filled EDP for women, inspired by the blue shores and skies of the beautiful Mediterranean. More than just a scent, the nose behind this fragrance carefully selected notes to capture the pure aura Mediterranean, allowing you to escape with a simple spritz. With wondrously sharp and tangy notes, this fragrance opens with citrus hints of Lemon and Granny Smith Apple, following by a floral accentuating heart of Jasmine and Marigold before settling on a musky base of Musk and Amberwood. The parfum is housed in an attractive frosted glass bottle, showcasing the sky blue perfume within to remind you of the clear skies above the seas. Top Notes: Lemon and Granny Smith Apple. Heart Notes: Jasmine and Marigold. Musk and Amberwood.

listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Cool Water for Men Eau De Toilette 200ml
listings.description: Davidoff Cool Water for Men Eau De Toilette (200ml) is the original men's marine fragrance, inspired by the natural freshness of the ocean. The aromatic scent exudes masculine vitality, confidence and sensuality - a timeless classic that was first released in 1988 and remains ever popular.By blending Sea Water with herbaceous and wooden notes, this iconic EDT creates a distinctive scent that is suitable for any man. Cool Water develops on the skin to leave it enveloped in an engaging aroma of male provocativeness. The fragrance comes packaged in an instantly recognisable cool blue glass bottle that alludes to its oceanic origins. Top Notes: Sea Water, Mint, Lavender, Coriander and Rosemary. Heart Notes: Sandalwood, Jasmine, Neroli and Geranium. Base Notes: Musk, Oakmoss, Cedar, Amber and Tobacco.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Eau De Parfum (30ml) is an oriental, floral fragrance for the confident, powerful woman. Sensual and charismatic, this EDP is as audacious as it is sexy, perfectly expressing the duality of the contemporary woman.Like the city of New York, Good Girl is loud, empowering and dares to be different. The sensual perfume opens with top notes of Sweet Almond, before developing into a floral heart of Jasmine and Tuberose before resting on a bed of Cacao and Tonka Bean. The fragrance is housed in an opulent high heel designed bottle; as the old adage goes -if you give a girl the right shoe, she can conquer the world. Top Notes: Almond & Coffee. Heart Notes: Jasmine and Tuberose. Base Notes: Cacao and Tonka Bean.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana The One For Men Eau De Toilette 150ml
listings.description: Dolce & Gabbana The One for Men Eau De Toilette (150ml) is an elegant and sensual fragrance, which uses classic notes but with a modern touch.This EDT is both vibrant and engaging, unleashing a symphony of fresh, herbaceous notes which slowly develop to reveal a spicy, aromatic heart, before drying to reveal a base of woody undertones. The fragrance is housed in an elegant glass bottle which truly showcases the fragrance as the star of the show, topped by a sleek wooden stopper. Top Notes: Grapefruit, Coriander and Basil. Heart Notes: Ginger, Cardamom, and Sweet Orange Blossom. Base Notes: Tobacco, Amber and Cedarwood.

listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Cool Water Intense Eau De Parfum 125ml
listings.description: Davidoff Cool Water Intense Eau De Parfum (125ml) is a more powerful version of the luxury brand's signature men's fragrance, Cool Water - a timeless classic that was first released in 1998. Both are marine scents inspired by the natural freshness of the ocean, although Intense is the first time the makers have revitalised a scent with an ethically-sourced ingredient, the Green Mandarin. The fruit is hand-picked in Brazil as part of a sustainable sourcing partnership with local producers. This men's EDP oriental notes unfold into cooling Coconut Water blended with the sensuality of Amber Accord. The scent comes packaged in Davidoff's iconic glass bottle in a darker shade of blue that hints at its oceanic origins. Top Notes: Green Mandarin. Heart Notes: Coconut Water. Base Notes: Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Diesel Only The Brave Eau De Toilette 125ml
listings.description: Diesel Only The Brave Eau De Toilette (125ml) is a modern men's oriental fragrance that is designed to expresses self-assured determination. The men's scent carries citrus and woody tones that create an invigorating and refreshing aroma - complemented by the iconic, clenched-fist bottle that conveys strength, masculinity and self-confidence.This men's EDT opens with light, fresh citrus notes with a hint of fresh herbs that give way to more sensual florals before ending with the longlasting intensity of warm Amber, Cedar and Leather. The packaging arrives in a plastic-free box. Cruelty-free. Top notes: Mandarin Orange, Lemon, and Coriander. Heart notes: Labdanum, Violet Leaves, and Rosemary. Base notes: Amber, Leather Accord, and Cedar Wood.

listings.rawTitle: DKNY Be Delicious Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: DKNY Be Delicious Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a floral, fruity EDP for women which is light, refreshing, and irresistible.Highlighting the delectable, citrus boldness of the Apple, this perfume serves as an invitation to women to savour life to the full and all it has to offer. The composition combines the scent of apple with a combination of exotic flowers and sensual woods. Top Notes: Cucumber, Grapefruit and Magnolia. Heart Notes: Green Apple, Lily of the Valley, Tuberose, Violet and Rose. Base Notes: Woodsy Notes, Sandalwood and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Elie Saab Girl Of Now Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Elie Saab Girl Of Now Eau De Parfum (30ml) is a floral, gourmand EDP for women which depicts a playful, spontaneous free spirit whose magnetism and positivity embodies a new generation. In the composition, the Elie Saab olfactory signature of Orange Blossom and Patchouli has been enhanced with an Almond note.Opening with an uplifting blend of Pear, Mandarin Orange and freshly-roasted Pistachio, the scent leads on to the Ormond Flower, combining Almond Essence with Orange Flower. This fragrance culminates in a sensual, woody base of Patchouli and Cashmeran with additional Almond notes. Top Notes: Pistachio, Pear and Mandarin Orange. Heart Notes: Almond, Orange Blossom and Magnolia. Base Notes: Almond Milk, Tonka Bean, Cashmeran and Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera 212 Sexy Men Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Carolina Herrera 212 Sexy Men Eau De Toilette (100ml) is an oriental and woody fragrance that encapsulates the essence of the modern man, mirroring the spirited vibe of a cosmopolitan city. This EDT stands out for its sensual, seductive, and somewhat enigmatic aura, perfectly suited for a man whose presence commands attention in the bustling nightlife of Manhattan. With an inherent confidence and a style that resonates with the warm, sensual atmosphere of the city, this fragrance leaves a trail of mystery and allure.The scent opens with the vibrant energy of Mandarin and Bergamot, infused with a hint of Ginger, setting a magnetic, masculine tone. As it unfolds, the heart reveals a blend of Green Pepper, Floral Petal, and Cardamom, adding to its complexity. The base notes anchor the fragrance in warmth and sensuality, combining Sandalwood, Bourbon Vanilla, Musk, Gaiac Wood, and Amber, crafting a memorable and enticing scent. Top Notes: Bergamot, Mandarin, Ginger. Heart Notes: Green Pepper, Floral Petal, Cardamom. Base Notes: Sandalwood, Bourbon Vanilla, Musk, Gaiac Wood, Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Davidoff The Game Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Davidoff The Game Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a seductive, self-confident fragrance for men who believe that life is a game - and the winner takes all! Distinctively masculine, the scent is a charismatic blend of male assuredness and sensuality that is designed to suit any occasion. Created for risk takers, The Game EDT is an irresistibly aromatic, woody fragrance that radiates positivity and ambition. Its assertiveness is created from a unique blend of the finest ingredients sourced from all corners of the planet - inviting you to explore the many intense sensations of life. The Game is housed in a bold bottle made from heavy, black glass embossed with satin-finish silver patterns that reflect the scent's daring declaration of intent. Top notes: Gin Fizz and Juniper Berries. Heart notes: Iris and Precious Woods. Base notes: Refined Blackwood.

listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Cool Water Intense Eau De Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Davidoff Cool Water Intense Eau De Parfum (75ml) is a more powerful version of the luxury brand's signature men's fragrance, Cool Water - a timeless classic that was first released in 1998.
