The fruit is hand-picked in Brazil as part of a sustainable sourcing partnership with local producers. This men's EDP oriental notes unfold into cooling Coconut Water blended with the sensuality of Amber Accord. The scent comes packaged in Davidoff's iconic glass bottle in a darker shade of blue that hints at its oceanic origins. Top Notes: Green Mandarin. Heart Notes: Coconut Water. Base Notes: Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein One Eau De Toilette 200ml
listings.description: Calvin Klein One Eau De Toilette (200ml) was the first fragrance released by the iconic US fashion house for both men and women. Created in 1994, this unisex EDT is a light, relaxed and aromatic fragrance that complements all genders.The fragrance was designed for everyone who is confident in defining...

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana The Only One Eau De Parfum Intense 100ml
listings.description: Dolce & Gabbana The Only One Intense Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an amber floral EDP for women which conveys feminine allure and seductive sensuality with its addictive, hypnotic character based on the contrast between Orange Blossom and Black Vanilla.Opening with notes of juicy Italian Mandarin, crisp Green Apple and honeyed Neroli Essence, the composition leads on to a floral heart where golden Orange Blossom meets with the sensuality of Jasmine Absolute in a heady melange, softly enveloped by creamy Coconut Essence. This culminates in a sweet and woody dry down with notes of dark Vanilla lending an addictive quality, grounded in Cedar and Cashmere woods. The fragrance is housed in a black bottle with elegant gold ring detail and bearing script in a seductive typeface. Top Notes: Neroli, Green Apple and Italian Mandarin. Heart Notes: Jasmine, Coconut and Orange Blossom. Base Notes: Vanilla, Cashmere Wood and Cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana The Only One Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Dolce & Gabbana The Only One Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an Amber Vanilla fragrance for women, one which encapsulates the essence of feminine sophistication and their hypnotising allure.Combing a surprising combination of Violet and Coffee notes, this EDP possesses an enchanting, floral scent offset by intricate notes of Mocha Violet and Vanilla, drawing its appeal. The fragrance opens with notes of fresh Violet, complimented by citrus hints Orange and Bergamot before developing into a floral heart of Coffee, Pear, Iris, Orange Blossom, and Rose. The fragrance then culminates in a sweet base of Caramel, Vanilla and Patchouli, enveloping the senses in its fresh, lavish embrace. Top Notes: Violet, Orange and Bergamot. Heart Notes: Coffee, Pear, Iris, Orange Blossom, and Rose. Base Notes: Caramel, Vanilla and Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: DKNY Golden Delicious Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: DKNY Golden Delicious Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a floral, woody EDP for women which celebrates luxury and splendour with its rich and accentuated aromas of juicy Golden Delicious Apple, accompanied by Orange Blossom and Mirabelle Plum.An opulent floral heart offers a bouquet of White Roses, surrounded with Casablanca Lilies, Lily Of The Valley and Vanilla Orchid, while the base caresses with notes of Musk followed by a sensual woody trail of Sandalwood and Teak. Its flacon is made of glass with a metal cap in gold. Top Notes: Red Apple, African Orange Flower and Plum. Heart Notes: Lily of the Valley, Lily, Orchid and Rose. Base Notes: Sandalwood, Musk and Teak Wood.

listings.rawTitle: Lancome La Vie Est Belle Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Lancome La Vie Est Belle Eau De Parfum (30ml) is a floral EDP for women which has been conceived as an expression of natural beauty, joie de vivre and the enjoyment of simple pleasures.An elegant olfactory signature scent, this fragrance opens with the sparkling citrus flavours of Blackcurrant and Pear. This leads on to a heart which features Iris, surrounded by Orange Blossom and Jasmine. The composition culminates in a warm, gourmand and powdery base characterised by accords of Tonka Bean, Praline, Patchouli and Vanilla. The 'sourire de cristal' (crystal smile) bottle depicts a rounded smile within a crystal square. It is elegantly adorned with a pearlescent grey ribbon on the neck, a symbol of freedom. Top Notes: Pear and Blackberry. Heart Notes: Pallida Iris Concrete, Orange Blossom and Jasmine Sambac Absolutes. Base Notes: Heart Of Patchouli Essence.

listings.rawTitle: Lancome Hypnose Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Lancome Hypnose Eau De Parfum (30ml) is an alluring, woody EDP for women which exudes sensuality and attraction, bewitching those who cross its path. It provides the weapon a woman needs to fascinate the one she desires.Passion Flower intertwines with Vanilla and woody Vetiver to lay a woody, enticing trail for the unsuspecting male. The stunning, multifaceted bottle expertly disperses the light in all direction, creating an alluring glow which is positively hypnotising. Top Notes: Passion Flower. Heart Notes: Vanilla. Base Notes: Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy So Intense Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Marc Jacobs Daisy So Intense Eau De Parfum (30ml) is an amber, floral EDT for women, inspired by the brilliance of Marc Jacobs Daisy.Offering a deeper, more intense twist than its precursor, this fragrance opens with vibrant, sparkling notes of Strawberry and Fresh Pear and Bergamot, mingling with the natural sweetness of Honey in the heart and complimented by floral hints of Jasmine and Rose Bud. The parfum rests on a sweet, musky bed of Vanilla, Musk, Benzoin and Moss. The perfume is housed in a golden opaque bottle, inspired by the golden sweet honey within and stopped with an oversized white flower petal with a golden accent. Top Notes: Strawberry, Pear and Bergamot. Heart Notes: Honey, Jasmine and Rose. Base Notes: Vanilla, Musk, Benzoin and Moss.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Eau De Toilette 30ml
listings.description: Marc Jacobs Daisy Eau De Toilette (30ml) is a floral EDT for women which effectively conveys the joyful, free spirit of the Marc Jacobs woman with their exuberant, unquestioning joie de vivre.This composition opens with a zesty, floral melange with the tender, powdery softness of Violet combining with citrusy sweet Wild Berries. This leads on to a heart of heady Jasmine with its rich, sensual, and musky notes, culminating in an earthy dry down of Sandalwood. The fragrance is presented in a lovely bottle decorated with daisy flowers atop. Top Notes: Wild Berries and White Violet. Heart Notes: Jasmine Infusion. Base Notes: Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Lancome Miracle Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Lancome Miracle Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a sparkling floral and fruity EDP for women which conveys the recurring miracle that is the dawning of a new day.Fresh, dewy notes of Lychee and Freesia herald this natural rebirth, leading to a spicy heart which reverberates with notes of Magnolia, Jasmine, Ginger and Pepper. This culminates in a warm base which envelopes the wearer in the sensual splendour of Amber and Musk. Top Notes: Juicy Lychee, Freesia and Pink Peppercorn. Heart Notes: Peony, Damascena Rose, Delicate Magnolia, Bourbon Pepper and Ginger. Base Notes: Absolute Jasmine, Musk, Patchouli and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo Flower Eau De Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Kenzo Flower Eau De Toilette (50ml) is a sophisticated and subtle, floral fruity EDT for women which conveys the sensuality and elegance of the woman who wears it.This composition reflects the fresh and light characteristics of the Poppy, Kenzo's emblematic red flower. Opening with the combination of zesty Mandarin and spicy Hawthorn, the floral heart of Damascena Rose and Violet exudes femininity. This culminates in a sensual base of creamy Vanilla and Musk. Top Notes: Mandarin Essence and Hawthorn. Heart Notes: Damascena Rose Water and Violet. Base Notes: White Musk and Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau De Toilette 200ml
listings.description: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau De Toilette (200ml) is a fruity floral scent which evokes the spirit of a Sicilian summer. It represents the aroma of sparkling summer days culminating in evocative evenings. They describe a story in which man meets woman, depicting the joy of life and seduction.This sensational EDT combines lively Sicilian Cedar with the freshness of the Granny Smith Apple and the floral allure and spontaneity of the Bluebell, the top note capturing the essence of a sunny Sicilian summer. Feminine and resolute, the freshness of Bamboo is softened with the intensity of Jasmine and the bottom note of White Rose. Profound and true, the scent fuses Citron Wood with sensual Amber and the delicate caress of Musk. Top Notes: Sicilian Lemon, Apple, Cedar and Bellflower. Heart Notes: Bamboo, Jasmine and White Rose. Base Notes: Cedar, Musk and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Pour Homme Eau De Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Pour Homme Eau De Toilette (50ml) is an aromatic, citrus fragrance for men which conjures images of carefree and sensual Mediterranean days, embodying Mediterranean joie de vivre - relaxed, sexy, and playful.This EDT opens with refreshing Bergamot, juicy, sun-drenched Sicilian Mandarin, frozen Grapefruit Peel and aromatic Juniper. In the heart, Sichuan Pepper and sensual Rosewood give strong masculinity and an understated blend of American Musk Wood, Incense and Oak Moss inject innate sexiness. Top Notes: Grapefruit, Bergamot, Sicilian Mandarin and Juniper. Heart Notes: Pepper, Rosemary and Brazilian Rosewood. Base Notes: Musk, Incense and Oakmoss.

listings.rawTitle: Lattafa Angham Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Lattafa Angham Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a refined oriental EDP that weaves together sparkling freshness, sweet indulgence and creamy warmth in perfect harmony.Crafted for those who embody elegance and quiet confidence, this scent opens with a bright, invigorating burst of Mandarin, Ginger and Pink Pepper, creating an energising and radiant first impression. At its heart lies a rich and inviting blend of Praline and Cacao, softened by the aromatic calm of Lavender. This combination brings depth and sensuality, striking a balance between comfort and allure. The base unfolds into a velvety finish, where Vanilla, Amber and Musk leave a lingering trail of sophistication that feels both luxurious and enduring. Versatile and memorable, Angham is ideal for day-to-night wear, from special occasions to everyday elegance. Top Notes: Mandarin, Ginger and Pink Pepper. Heart Notes: Praline, Lavender and Cacao. Base Notes: Musk, Amber and Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Pour Homme Eau De Toilette 200ml
listings.description: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Pour Homme Eau De Toilette (200ml) is an aromatic, citrus fragrance for men which conjures images of carefree and sensual Mediterranean days, embodying Mediterranean joie de vivre - relaxed, sexy, and playful.This EDT opens with refreshing Bergamot, juicy, sun-drenched Sicilian Mandarin, frozen Grapefruit Peel and aromatic Juniper. Top Notes: Grapefruit, Bergamot, Sicilian Mandarin and Juniper. Heart Notes: Pepper, Rosemary and Brazilian Rosewood. Base Notes: Musk, Incense and Oakmoss.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Mitsouko Eau De Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Guerlain Mitsouko Eau De Toilette (75ml) is a daring, passionate fruity-chypre fragrance for women that embodies mystery and elegance in equal measure. Created in homage to a Japanese heroine from a 1909 novel, the name 'Mitsouko' translates as 'mystery', a fitting title for this rich and enigmatic scent. Opening with the luminous brightness of Bergamot, the composition leads into a velvety heart where the ripe sweetness of Peach melds with the romantic florals of Jasmine and Rose. As it settles, a deeply rooted chypre character emerges, layered with earthy Vetiver, warm Spices and mossy tones reminiscent of the forest undergrowth, creating an evocative and refined olfactory signature. Part of the Guerlain Legendary fragrance collection, Mitsouko is presented in the Maison's iconic 'inverted heart' bottle, a timeless glass flacon adored by fragrance connoisseurs. Top Notes: Bergamot. Heart Notes: Peach, Jasmine and Rose. Base Notes: Vetiver, Spices and Notes of the Undergrowth.

listings.rawTitle: Rasasi Hawas Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Rasasi Hawas Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a bold and invigorating fragrance that channels the spirit of modern masculinity with a vibrant fusion of freshness and sensual depth.Perfect for the man who thrives on adventure and lives with purpose, this oriental fresh scent opens with a zesty burst of Bergamot, Lemon and crisp Apple, spiced subtly with Cinnamon to energise the senses. The heart reveals a refined blend of Orange Blossom, Cardamom and juicy Plum, adding a warm yet aromatic complexity. As it settles, a rich base of earthy Patchouli, Grey Amber, Driftwood and Musk creates a lingering, masculine trail with a sensual, marine-like warmth. Ideal for daytime wear, especially in warm weather, Hawas is a dynamic expression of confidence and vitality. Top Notes: Bergamot, Apple, Lemon and Cinnamon. Heart Notes: Orange Blossom, Cardamom and Plum. Base Notes: Patchouli, Grey Amber, Driftwood and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Arabiyat Prestige Nyla Eau De Parfum 80ml
listings.description: Arabiyat Prestige Nyla Eau De Parfum (80ml) is a sophisticated fruity-floral EDP for women, weaving together creamy, tropical sweetness with elegant floral nuances and a warm, woody base.This captivating composition opens with a radiant blend of Fruity Accord, Coconut and Peach Nectar, immediately enveloping the senses in a juicy, sun-kissed freshness. The heart blossoms into a luminous bouquet where delicate Floral Accord is perfectly paired with exotic Tiare Blossoms, adding a graceful depth. As the scent settles, creamy Sandalwood and powdery-soft Heliotrope Blossoms create a smooth, comforting base that lingers on the skin. Perfect for both daytime elegance and evening allure, Nyla is a refined, enchanting fragrance that leaves a lasting impression. Top Notes: Fruity Accord, Coconut and Peach Nectar. Heart Notes: Floral Accord and Tiare Blossoms. Base Notes: Sandalwood and Heliotrope Blossoms.

listings.rawTitle: Lancome La Vie Est Belle Eau De Parfum Gift Set 50ml
listings.description: Lancome La Vie Est Belle Eau De Parfum Gift Set (50ml) is a radiant floral collection that embodies happiness, beauty and the simple joy of life. Perfectly presented for gifting, this set pairs the iconic La Vie Est Belle scent with a matching body lotion for a harmonious fragrance experience.Collection Contains: 1 x Lancome La Vie Est Belle Eau De Parfum (50ml) - a floral EDP for women which conveys contentment with natural beauty and the simple yet joyful pleasure gained from life. Featuring Iris at its heart, the scent opens with a fruity melange of Pear and Blackberry, leading on to a heart of Orange Blossom and Jasmine. The composition culminates in a warm Patchouli base. The crystal smile bottle evokes an exuberant joie de vivre and is adorned with a pearlescent grey ribbon. 1 x Lancome La Vie Est Belle Body Lotion (50ml) - a luxurious, hydrating lotion which absorbs instantly, creating a silky-smooth feeling on the skin, whilst lavishing the body with the floral and enigmatically feminine notes of Lancome La Vie Est Belle.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein CK One Shock For Him Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Calvin Klein CK One Shock For Him Eau De Toilette (100ml) is an amber, spicy EDT for men which depicts an adventurous, unconventional and thrill-seeking character. This overtly masculine fragrance opens with citrusy Clementine, fresh Cucumber and Energy Drink accord. This leads to a heart of Black Pepper, Black Basil and Cardamom, culminating in a woody, masculine dry down blending Tobacco, Musk, Patchouli and Ambrene Wood. Top Notes: Lavender, Clementine and Cucumber. Heart Notes: Cardamom, Pepper, Basil and Osmanthus. Base Notes: Tobacco, Amber, Patchouli, Woodsy Notes and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Khadlaj Island Vanilla Dunes Extrait De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Khadlaj Island Vanilla Dunes Extrait De Parfum (100ml) is a warm, indulgent unisex fragrance that perfectly balances gourmand sweetness with subtle floral and woody nuances.From the first spritz, it envelops you in a velvety blend of Cinnamon, creamy Vanilla, zesty Bergamot and aromatic Cardamom, an inviting and gently spiced opening that feels both comforting and elevated. The heart reveals a smooth fusion of Orange Blossom, Guaiac Wood and rich Bourbon, offering depth and a refined floral-woody warmth. As it dries down, soft Praline, golden Amber and Musk create a sensual, skin-like trail that lingers beautifully, adding lasting elegance. Ideal for evening wear or cooler months, Island Vanilla Dunes is a sophisticated take on sweetness, never overpowering, always enchanting. Top Notes: Cinnamon, Vanilla, Bergamot and Cardamom. Heart Notes: Orange Blossom, Guaiac Wood and Bourbon. Base Notes: Praline, Amber and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Khadlaj Island Extrait De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Khadlaj Island Extrait De Parfum (100ml) is a tropical escape captured in a bottle, evoking the serenity of sunlit beaches, lush greenery and warm, golden horizons.This luxurious fragrance opens with the sparkling brightness of Bergamot, offering a citrusy, sea-breeze freshness that instantly uplifts the senses. At its heart, creamy Coconut is enlivened by the exotic zing of Ginger and the juicy sweetness of Pineapple, creating a vibrant and sun-kissed tropical bouquet. The base unfolds into a smooth and indulgent blend of Amber, Tonka Beans and Sandalwood, adding a warm, creamy finish that lingers beautifully on the skin. Khadlaj Island is a refined yet relaxed scent experience, ideal for both everyday moments and special occasions, offering a sense of effortless elegance and tropical sophistication all year round. Top Notes: Bergamot. Heart Notes: Coconut, Ginger and Pineapple. Base Notes: Amber, Tonka Beans and Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Khadlaj Cloud Candy Extrait De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Khadlaj Cloud Candy Extrait De Parfum (100ml) is a sweet, playful yet refined unisex fragrance that blends fruity brightness with creamy gourmand indulgence.Opening with a juicy burst of Strawberry, Green Tangerine and airy Freesia, it immediately lifts the senses with a fresh, joyful energy. At the heart, the scent softens into a dreamy blend of Fluffy Marshmallow, Coconut and Whipped Cream, evoking the comforting sweetness of a cloud-like dessert. As it settles, a warm base of White Musk, Vanilla, Sugar, Raspberry and Ambroxan creates a soft, addictive finish that clings gently to the skin. Ideal for everyday wear or moments when you want to feel comforted and confident, Cloud Candy is a charming, long-lasting fragrance with universal appeal, perfectly housed in a sleek and modern bottle. listings.rawTitle: Frederic Malle Portrait Of A Lady Eau De Parfum 50ml

Top Notes: Dihydrimyrcenol and Marine Notes. Heart Notes: Violet, Raspberry and Exotic Flavours. Base Notes: Vanillin and Ambroxan.

listings.rawTitle: Frederic Malle Carnal Flower Eau De Parfum 50ml

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Very Good Girl Eau De Parfum 80ml

listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Hot Water Eau De Toilette 110ml

listings.rawTitle: Creed Aventus Eau De Parfum 100ml

listings.description: French Avenue Liquid Brun Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a rich and seductive men's EDP that captures the elegance and warmth of oriental perfumery with a refined, modern touch.It opens with a smooth blend of Cinnamon, Bergamot, Cardamom and Orange Blossom, creating a soft yet spicy introduction. At the heart, Bourbon Vanilla and Elemi add depth and balance, offering a creamy warmth with a hint of resinous brightness. The base unfolds into an indulgent trail of Musk, sweet Praline, smoky Guaiac Wood and Ambroxan, leaving a confident and long-lasting impression. Liquid Brun is a sophisticated statement scent, ideal for evening wear and special occasions. Top Notes: Cinnamon, Bergamot, Cardamom, Orange Blossom. Heart Notes: Bourbon Vanilla, Elemi. Base Notes: Musk, Praline, Ambroxan, Guaiac Wood.

listings.rawTitle: Rayhaan Nocturno Pour Homme Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Rayhaan Nocturno Pour Homme Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a refined and magnetic men's EDP that brings together aromatic freshness, subtle spice and smooth woody depth.It opens with a vibrant blend of Bergamot, cool Mint and sharp Pepper, creating an energising and confident first impression. The heart reveals a sophisticated mix of Lavender and Geranium, lifted by a touch of Pink Pepper to add warmth and elegance. As it dries down, rich Amberwood and crisp Cedar form a polished, long-lasting base that grounds the fragrance in understated strength. Ideal for evening wear or formal occasions, Nocturno is a modern classic with timeless appeal. Top Notes: Bergamot, Mint, Pepper. Heart Notes: Lavender, Geranium, Pink Pepper. Base Notes: Amberwood, Cedar.

listings.rawTitle: French Avenue Ghost Spectre Eau De Parfum 80ml
listings.description: French Avenue Ghost Spectre Eau De Parfum (80ml) is a daring and modern men's EDP that defies convention with its vibrant contrasts and long-lasting depth.The scent opens with a zesty fusion of Lime and Ginger, lifted by sparkling Bergamot and a dash of Pink Pepper for an energetic, attention-grabbing start. At the heart, juicy Blackcurrant blends with spicy Cardamom and elegant Turkish Rose, adding a fresh yet refined character. As it dries down, the base reveals warm notes of Vanilla, Sandalwood, and Cedar, enriched by Benzoin, Amber and Musk for a sensual, lingering finish. Ghost Spectre is designed for those who make a bold impression and value individuality in every detail. Top Notes: Ginger, Bergamot, Pink Pepper and Lime. Heart Notes: Blackcurrant, Cardamom and Turkish Rose. Base Notes: Vanilla, Sandalwood, Benzoin, Cedar, Patchouli, Amber and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: French Avenue Azzure Aoud Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: French Avenue Azzure Aoud Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a bold and luxurious unisex EDP that delivers a warm, spicy elixir of depth and distinction.Opening with a striking blend of Saffron, Passion Fruit and Rose, the scent immediately captivates with a fusion of heat and sweetness. At its heart, rich Oud, earthy Patchouli and smooth Benzoin create a resinous core that exudes strength and sensuality. The base unfolds with refined Leather, creamy Vanilla and deep Woody Notes, resulting in a long-lasting, elegant trail. Perfect for cooler evenings or making a statement year-round, Azzure Aoud wraps the skin in sophisticated warmth with a distinctive edge. Top Notes: Saffron, Passion Fruit and Rose. Heart Notes: Oud, Benzoin and Patchouli. Base Notes: Leather, Woody Notes and Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: French Avenue Vulcan Feu Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: French Avenue Vulcan Feu Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a bold and fiery men's fragrance that channels raw volcanic energy through a dynamic blend of fruit, spice and smouldering woods.It opens with a striking burst of Mango, Red Berries and Lemon, sharpened by the heat of Ginger for an electrifying introduction. The heart transitions into a warm, woody accord where sweet Coumarin and delicate Jasmine meet the strength of Cedar. In the base, Musk, Amber and Oud are joined by earthy Cypriol Oil to deliver a smoky, long-lasting dry-down that radiates confidence and intensity. Vulcan Feu is designed for those who make a powerful impression and embrace their inner fire. Top Notes: Mango, Ginger, Lemon and Red Berries. Heart Notes: Coumarin, Jasmine and Cedar. Base Notes: Musk, Amber, Agarwood (Oud) and Cypriol Oil.

listings.rawTitle: Sospiro Erba Leather Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Sospiro Erba Leather Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a bold and refined men's EDP that blends zesty citrus, smooth woods and rich leather for a confident and luxurious scent.It opens with a vibrant burst of Bergamot, Lemon and juicy Passion Fruit, delivering an energising and slightly exotic introduction. The heart reveals a sensual blend of creamy Sandalwood, elegant Jasmine and deep Leathery Notes, adding warmth and sophistication. As it settles, the base unfolds with Amber, Vetiver and intensified Leather, leaving a smoky, long-lasting trail. Erba Leather is a striking composition with a masculine edge, perfect for those who favour bold elegance. Top Notes: Bergamot, Lemon and Passion Fruit. Heart Notes: Jasmine, Sandalwood and Leathery Notes. Base Notes: Amber, Leathery Notes and Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: French Avenue Aether Extrait De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: French Avenue Aether Extrait De Parfum (100ml) is a confident and contemporary men's fragrance that blends freshness with bold woody depth.It opens with a vibrant mix of Green Apple, Mandarin, Orange and Bergamot, delivering a zesty, energetic introduction. The heart reveals a textured combination of Petitgrain, smooth Cashmere, Cedar and soft Violet, adding warmth and complexity. As it settles, the base unveils earthy Oak Moss, sensual Musk and rich Amber Wood, creating a long-lasting, modern trail. Aether is a charismatic scent designed for those who lead with presence and thrive in the moment, offering a powerful yet refined signature. Top Notes: Green Apple, Mandarin, Orange and Bergamot. Heart Notes: Petitgrain, Cashmere, Cedar and Violet. Base Notes: Oak Moss, Musk and Amber Wood.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Si Eau De Parfum Refill 100ml
listings.description: Giorgio Armani Si Eau De Parfum Refill (100ml) is a timeless floral perfume for the resolute yet graceful woman who is sufficiently self-assured to say 'Si' to the values which best define them. The fragrance conveys the contemporary femininity of Giorgio Armani.This EDP exudes the scent of freshly-laundered sheets drying off in the summer breeze, soft and warm with a hint of sophisticated, creamy sweetness. Intense, voluptuous, and deep, it combines the elegance of Freesia with the delightful honey tones of Rose De Mai Absolute to lend it a certain distinction. The lasting, sensual notes of Oakmoss and Patchouli add captivating softness to this modern chypre. The gold ring which encircles the neck of the Armani Si bottle serves as a symbol of eternity, a perfect wedding, engagement, or anniversary icon. Top Notes: Blackcurrant Liqueur. Heart Notes: Rose de Mai Absolute and Freesia. Base Notes: Patchouli and Oakmoss.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Terre D'Hermes Eau Intense Vetiver Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Hermes Terre D'Hermes Eau Intense Vetiver Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a luminous, woody fragrance for men, presenting a new dimension of the iconic Terre d'Hermes. This scent captures the essence of Vetiver in a blend that is both intense and vibrant, with the freshness of Green Bergamot and the spicy edge of Sichuan Pepper adding layers of complexity.This EDP encapsulates the spirit of Terre, with its core Vetiver note achieving a unique balance - transforming the original woody and mineral signature into a woody and vegetal harmony. The design of the bottle incorporates Hermes' attention to detail and craftsmanship: the cap adopts the warm brown of sun-tanned leather, and the base features an 'H' in a deeper shade of orange, while the metal shoulders of the bottle reflect and intensify the light. The intricate details, such as the iconic saddle nail and the sliding spray cover, are inspired by a travel vanity case bottle from the Emile Hermes Museum. This attention to detail and commitment to heritage make the Terre d'Hermes Eau Intense Vetiver bottle a masterpiece of design, as compelling as the fragrance itself. Top Notes: Green Bergamot and Citrus. Heart Notes: Sichuan Pepper. Base Notes: Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Nautica Voyage Eau De Toilette 200ml
listings.description: Nautica Voyage Eau De Toilette (200ml) is a woody aquatic EDT for men of an active and romantic nature, men who live their life according to their own set of values eschewing convention.Reminiscent of a fresh, salty sea breeze fragranced with scents of coastal herbs and woods, the composition matches a man's natural instinct to measure his strength against the raw power of Nature. It opens with the crisp, green notes of Green Leaves and Apples, leading on to dewy, tender Mimosa in the heart together with an aquatic note of Lotus. The fragrance culminates in a woody base, comprising Cedar, Oakmoss, Musk and Amber. Top Notes: Apple and Green Leaves. Heart Notes: Lotus and Mimosa. Base Notes: Musk, Cedar, Oakmoss and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Forever Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Forever Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a limited edition floral, woody musk EDP for women which celebrates the 20th anniversary of Narciso Rodriguez For Her, an iconic fragrance.The composition opens with an overtly floral melange of hybrid Frangipani, spicy and zesty Gardenia and sensual Jasmine. This leads on to a sophisticated heart melding fragrant notes of apricot-peachy Osmanthus, feminine Tuberose and Orange Flower. The scent culminates in an earthy, woody base of Patchouli and Musk. For Her Forever has been housed in the same shaped flacon as the original, iconic Narciso Rodriguez For Her Eau de Toilette with the bottle reproduced in ombre style, graduating from black to pale pink. Top Notes: Frangipani, Gardenia and Jasmine. Heart Notes: Osmanthus, Tuberose and African Orange Flower. Base Notes: Musk and Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Obsession for Men Eau De Toilette 125ml
listings.description: Calvin Klein Obsession for Men Eau De Toilette (125ml) is an oriental fragrance for men with a high scent longevity which captures the pure essence of masculinity.Potent, powerful, and provocative, it is a compelling, intense blend of botanicals, spices, and rare woods. Driven by passion, this EDT exudes the determination...

listings.rawTitle: Creed Royal Oud Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Creed Royal Oud Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a woody, rich and refined unisex EDP which bestows an air of sophistication and elegance on the wearer. Refined and opulent, the olfactory composition is centred around Oud, a seductive scent believed to have spiritual and therapeutic benefits for the soul.Combining only the finest ingredients from around the world, Royal Oud opens with a refreshing citrus twist of Lime and Bergamot, warmed by the complex spicy, woody and balsamic aspects of Galbanum and Pink Pepper. This leads to a heart of boldness and opulence with the invigorating, spicy notes of Clove and Cardamom in an intriguing melange with balsamic Cedarwood and musky Angelica Seed. The warm and distinctive finish sees luxurious Oud embraced by rich, earthy ingredients including majestic Frankincense, velvety Ambroxan and smoky Guaiac Wood. Top Notes: Pink Pepper, Lime, Galbanum and Bergamot. Heart Notes: Angelica Seed, Cedarwood, Cardamom and Clove. Base Notes: Musk, Ambroxan, Frankincense, Guaiac Wood and Oud.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera 212 NYC Men Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Carolina Herrera 212 NYC Men Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a lively, energetic, and elegant fragrance tailored to resonate with the modern man's style. Drawing its essence from the bustling streets of New York City, this EDT speaks to the contemporary gentleman navigating the urban jungle. The scent starts with refreshing and light floral notes, masterfully blended by renowned perfumer Alberto Morillas. These initial notes harmoniously fuse with the sensual depth of the base notes, creating a sophisticated olfactory experience. The touch of metallic in the Gardenia accentuates the modernity of this metropolitan fragrance. Top Notes: Orange Blossom, Mandarin and Bergamot. Heart Notes: Gardenia, Camelia, Iris and Lily of the Valley. Base Notes: Sandalwood and White Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Clinique Happy Heart Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Clinique Happy Heart Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a women's floral fragrance of joy, blending a wealth of flowers, a hint of warmth and a deepening of emotions. Joyful and sunny, this fresh spring-summer scent is recommended for daytime wear.The fragrance opens with the uplifting sparkle of Mandarin Orange and...

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Very Good Girl Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Carolina Herrera Very Good Girl Eau De Parfum (50ml) is part of the illustrious collection of women's fragrances from the iconic fashion house. The flirtatious and sophisticated women's scent embodies the modern woman, with an aroma that is equal parts playful and elegant. This EDP is a surprising olfactive journey, taking the essence of playfully mischievous Red Currant and exotic Lychee, leading to a seductive heart of Rose. The fragrance concludes with Vetiver and Vanilla Bourbon base notes, providing a surprising and contemporary finish that captures the essence of passion, sophistication, and beauty. Very Good Girl comes packaged in the iconic Good Girl Stiletto, conquering new heights with a stunning red-lacquered interior - a signature house shade and symbol of passion and beauty. Top Notes: Red Currant and Lychee. Heart Notes: Rose and Lilly. Base Notes: Vanilla Bourbon and Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Women Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Calvin Klein Women Eau De Parfum (100ml) is the very definition of femininity. Sensual and luminous, this fresh and complex fragrance accentuates the female spirit, meant to empower and embody woman who wears it.The composition promises a floral and woody experience, developing layers of beauty and expressive individualism. It opens with slightly spiced notes of Eucalyptus, Black Pepper and Citruses, before revealing a heart of Orange Blossom, Magnolia and Jasmine Absolute. This dries down into a woody base of Alaskan Cedar, Olibanum and Ambrox. This EDP is presented in an innovative yet simple, asymmetrical bottle signed by Anne Collier, as her personality and achievements were a partial inspiration for this uniquely feminine fragrance. Top Notes: Eucalyptus, Black Pepper, and Citruses. Heart Notes: Orange Blossom, Magnolia, and Jasmine Absolute. Base Notes: Alaskan Cedar, Olibanum, and Ambrox.

listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Cool Water for Women Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Davidoff Cool Water for Women Eau De Toilette (100ml) is the women's version of the brand's signature aquatic scent, which is inspired by the rippling waves of the ocean. The fresh, floral fragrance exudes natural beauty and confident sensuality with a distinct feminine flair. This revitalising EDT blends the clean and fresh notes of the original men's Cool Water with zesty citruses, a bouquet of florals and seductive wood undertones. Launched in 1996, Cool Water for Women comes packaged in a translucent blue glass bottle accented with silver rings that give the impression of waves rolling over azure seas. Top notes: Pineapple, Watermelon, Quince, Blackcurrant and Lemon. Heart notes: Honey, Jasmine, Water Lily, Lotus and Rose. Base notes: Sandalwood, Musk, Vetiver and Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Clinique Happy Cologne Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Clinique Happy Cologne Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a crisp, cool and refreshing fragrance for men, recommended for daytime wear. Fresh and invigorating, it is an easy choice for the man who likes his scent clean, modern and quietly distinctive.Its character comes from an original marine note of Oyster, blended...

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Eau De Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Eau De Toilette (50ml) is a bold, woody aromatic EDT for men which is perfect for everyday wear. This perfume conveys the dichotomy of the male psyche - strong yet sensitive, relaxed yet sophisticated.Opening with the sharpness of Grapefruit and White Pepper, the heart counters this with an earthy, woody and nutty blend of Vetiver with Clary Sage. This culminates in the spicy, rich sweetness of Tonka Bean and Cocoa in the base. The fragrance is presented in a distinctive bottle, fashioned in the shape of a bolt of lightning, depicting heroic mental and physical powers. Top Notes: Grapefruit and White Pepper. Heart Notes: Vetiver and Clary Sage. Base Notes: Tonka Bean and Cocoa.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Viking Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Creed Viking Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a bold, exhilarating EDP which encapsulates the powerful spirit of boundless exploration, symbolising a fearless voyage undertaken with unshakeable perseverance.Viking reflects the spirit and determination of the skilled Viking seamen of the ninth century who crafted powerful longships to transport them on their journey to conquer. Iceland, the land of fire and ice, volcanos and glaciers, perfectly embodies the inspiration behind this fiery men's fragrance. Spicy, fougere and aromatic, the composition combines the fresh citrus notes of Calabrian Bergamot and Sicilian Lemon with Pink Peppercorn, Bulgarian Rose and Peppermint. Woody notes of Indian Sandalwood and Haitian Vetiver in the base complete this masculine scent. Top Notes: Bergamot, Lemon, Orange, Peppermint, Pink Peppercorn & Absinthe. Heart Notes: Allspice, Clove, Jasmine, Lavender, Orris Butter, Bulgarian Rose. Base Notes: Cedarwood, Tonka Bean, Vetiver, White Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Cool Water for Men Eau De Toilette 125ml
listings.description: Davidoff Cool Water for Men Eau De Toilette (125ml) is the original men's marine fragrance, inspired by the natural freshness of the ocean. The aromatic scent exudes masculine vitality, confidence and sensuality - a timeless classic that was first released in 1988 and remains ever popular. By blending Sea Water with herbaceous and wooden notes, this iconic EDT creates a distinctive scent that is suitable for any man. Cool Water develops on the skin to leave it enveloped in an engaging aroma of male provocativeness. The fragrance comes packaged in an instantly recognisable cool blue glass bottle that alludes to its oceanic origins. Top notes: Sea Water, Mint, Lavender, Coriander and Rosemary. Heart notes: Sandalwood, Jasmine, Neroli and Geranium. Base notes: Musk, Oakmoss, Cedar, Amber and Tobacco.

listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Cool Water for Men Eau De Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Davidoff Cool Water for Men Eau De Toilette (75ml) is the original men's marine fragrance, inspired by the natural freshness of the ocean. Cool Water develops on the skin to leave it enveloped in an engaging aroma of male provocativeness. Heart notes: Sandalwood, Jasmine, Neroli and Geranium. Base notes: Musk, Oakmoss, Cedar, Amber and Tobacco.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Aventus Cologne Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Creed Aventus Cologne Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a woody, citrus, refreshing and uplifting cologne version of the classic Aventus EDP, complementing the acclaimed cult classic original with an element of modernity whilst retaining its renowned longevity. Depicting a daring, urban-spirited wearer, this uplifting cologne bestows him with alluring style, strength and vigour, implying success and achievement.The composition opens with an aromatic, fruity melange of warming Ginger, zesty Mandarin and spicy Pink Peppercorn. This leads on to a sumptuous heart featuring earthy Patchouli, deeply sweet and creamy Sandalwood and Vetiver. This culminates in a leathery, balsamic drydown base of sensual Styrax, smoky Birch and Musk. Top Notes: Pink Peppercorn, Ginger & Mandarin. Heart Notes: Vetiver, Patchouli and Pineapple. Base notes: Birch, Styrax and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Cool Water for Men Eau De Toilette 40ml
listings.description: Davidoff Cool Water for Men Eau De Toilette (40ml) is the original men's marine fragrance, inspired by the natural freshness of the ocean. The aromatic scent exudes masculine vitality, confidence and sensuality - a timeless classic that was first released in 1988 and remains ever popular.By blending Sea Water with herbaceous and wooden notes, this iconic EDT creates a distinctive scent that is suitable for any man. Cool Water develops on the skin to leave it enveloped in an engaging aroma of male provocativeness. listings.rawTitle: Cacharel Noa Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Cacharel Noa Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a modern yet timeless floral women's fragrance that was created to capture the inner peace and tranquillity of women. An infusion of rare woods and delicate flowers combine to produce a distinctly feminine scent that is designed to promote calmness and satisfaction.This women's EDT opens with fresh florals that seamlessly blend into more herbaceous notes before ending with sensual undertones. Noa comes packaged in an attractive, clear glass bottle with silver finishing. Cruelty-free. Top notes: Plum, Freesia, Peach, Peony, and White Musk. Heart notes: Lily, Jasmine, Ylang-Ylang, Lily of the Valley, and Rose. Base notes: Sandalwood, Tonka Bean, Vanilla, Coffee, Incense, and Cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Man Ice Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Jimmy Choo Man Ice Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a woody, aromatic fragrance for men which exudes moody masculinity, innate confidence, and effortless attitude, set against the softer spirit of his passion and humour.Dangerously seductive and sophisticated, this EDT has been designed for the contemporary man who lives life on the edge. Top Notes: Citron, Bergamot and Mandarin Orange. Heart Notes: Apple, Cedar, Vetiver and Patchouli. Base Notes: Ambroxan, Musk and Moss.

listings.rawTitle: Lanvin Eclat D'Arpege Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Lanvin Eclat D'Arpege Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a fruity floral EDP for women with a light and sparkling, sophisticated composition, perfect for summer wear.This composition opens with a fruity floral melange of fresh Sicilian Lemon Leaf and powdery Green Lilac. This leads to an overtly floral heart of Wisteria Blossom, Peony and Peach Blossom softened by vegetal Green Tea. It culminates in a sensual woody base of Cedar, Amber and Musk. Top Notes: Lemon Leaf and Green Lilac. Heart Notes: Osmanthus, Peach Blossom, Peony, Wisteria and Green Tea. Base Notes: Cedar, Amber and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Marc Jacobs Daisy Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a floral EDT for women which effectively conveys the joyful, free spirit of the Marc Jacobs woman with their exuberant, unquestioning joie de vivre.This composition opens with a zesty, floral melange with the tender, powdery softness of Violet combining with citrusy sweet Wild Berries. This leads on to a heart of heady Jasmine with its rich, sensual, and musky notes, culminating in an earthy dry down of Sandalwood. The fragrance is presented in a lovely bottle decorated with daisy flowers atop. Top Notes: Wild Berries and White Violet. Heart Notes: Jasmine Infusion. Base Notes: Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo Flower Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Kenzo Flower Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an amber floral EDP for women which was created for casual everyday wear. Conceived to reflect the association between nature and urban environments, emotions and high-paced modern city life, the composition centres around three basic notes.The floral note emanates from Parma Violet, wild Hawthorn, Cassis and Bulgarian Rose. Voluptuous Vanilla and White Musk lend a powdery note, whilst Opoponax brings a gentle woody touch. Top Notes: Bulgarian Rose, Hawthorn, Black Currant and Mandarin Orange. Heart Notes: Parma Violet, Rose, Opoponax and Jasmine. Base Notes: Vanilla, White Musk and Incense.

listings.rawTitle: Karl Lagerfeld Bois De Yuzu Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Karl Lagerfeld Bois De Yuzu Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a woody citrus EDT for men which celebrates masculine virility with its inclusion of Yuzu Wood.The composition opens with a citrus blend of Mandarin, Bergamot and Grapefruit, sharpened by the contrasting olfactory notes of Ginger. This leads to an aromatic heart with the richly sweet herbaceousness of Clary Sage combining with Yuzu Wood, a two-sided material with both fruity and woody aspects. This culminates in a warm and woody base with notes of Papyrus and Moss emphasising the overtly masculine theme. The liquid is housed in a translucent khaki bottle with a transparent cap tinted by a dark green insert. The stylish black box features a leather-like texture with a khaki band displaying the featured ingredient. Top Notes: Ginger, Bergamot, Grapefruit, Mandarin Orange, Mint and Rosemary. Heart Note: Yuzu and Clary Sage. Base Notes: Moss and Papyrus.

listings.rawTitle: Rayhaan Ocean Rush Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Rayhaan Ocean Rush Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an invigorating and dynamic men's EDP that captures the boundless energy of the sea and the spirit of purpose-driven ambition.It opens with a burst of Green Mandarin and Bergamot, fused with the marine freshness of Cascalone and Aquazone, evoking oceanic power and clarity. The heart introduces a wild aromatic blend of Lavender, Rosemary, Lentisk and Cypress, delivering a herbal freshness with a refined, masculine edge. As it settles, mineral Amber, earthy Patchouli and soft Musk create a clean, confident base that lingers on the skin. Top Notes: Bergamot, Mandarin (Green), Cascalone and Aquazone. Heart Notes: Lavender, Lentisk (Gum Mastic), Rosemary and Cypress. Base Notes: Musk, Patchouli and Amber (Mineral).

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Paradise Garden Eau De Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Paradise Garden Eau De Parfum (75ml) is a woody, green aquatic EDP for men that whisks the senses away to a lush, tropical escape.Opening with an invigorating burst of Green Notes, watery accords, Mint and Ginger, the composition immediately evokes the vibrancy of paradise. At its heart, creamy Coconut and lush Green Fig are delicately laced with a hint of Salt, creating a sensuous, sun-kissed warmth. The base unveils the golden richness of Tonka Bean and Sandalwood, delivering a lasting impression of refined masculinity and tropical allure. Encased in an emerald-green glass bottle with intricate vine embroidery, the design draws inspiration from Jean Paul Gaultier's 2010/11 Autumn-Winter collection. A single embroidered leaf discreetly conceals the bottle's sculpted form, adding an element of seductive charm. Top Notes: Green Notes, Watery Notes, Mint and Ginger. Heart Notes: Coconut, Fig and Salt. Base Notes: Tonka Bean and Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Lattafa Eclaire Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Lattafa Eclaire Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a floral fruity gourmand EDP which is a true indulgence for the senses.It opens with an irresistible swirl of Caramel, Milk and Sugar, melting together in a creamy symphony which is both comforting and luxurious. As the scent unfolds, golden Honey drapes itself over delicate white flowers, adding an elegant glow to the composition. The richness deepens into a luscious base of velvety Vanilla, nutty Praline and soft Musk, creating a trail which lingers like a whispered promise of indulgence. Sweet yet sophisticated, this fragrance is a perfect balance of gourmand delight and refined elegance, making it an enchanting companion for both day and evening wear. Top Notes: Caramel, Milk and Sugar. Heart Notes: Honey and White Flowers. Base Notes: Vanilla, Praline and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Rayhaan Imperia Intense Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Rayhaan Imperia Intense Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a bold evolution of its predecessor, a more powerful, more daring expression designed for men who thrive on standing out.From the very first spray, the EDP ignites with vibrant Star Anise, fused with the crisp freshness of Cypress, the fiery spark of Pepper and the juicy brightness of Tangerine. As it settles, the heart reveals a rich, smoky swirl of Incense balanced by the aromatic softness of Lavender and Orange Blossom, grounded by the earthy depth of Vetiver. The dry-down is warm and sensual, layering Cashmere Wood, creamy Vanilla and soft Musk over the timeless elegance of Sandalwood. Top Notes: Star Anise, Cypress, Pepper and Tangerine. Heart Notes: Incense, Lavender, Orange Blossom and Vetiver. Base Notes: Cashmere Wood, Vanilla, Musk and Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Paradise Garden Eau De Parfum 125ml
listings.description: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Paradise Garden Eau De Parfum (125ml) is a woody, green aquatic EDP for men that whisks the senses away to a lush, tropical escape.Opening with an invigorating burst of Green Notes, watery accords, Mint and Ginger, the composition immediately evokes the vibrancy of paradise. At its heart, creamy Coconut and lush Green Fig are delicately laced with a hint of Salt, creating a sensuous, sun-kissed warmth. The base unveils the golden richness of Tonka Bean and Sandalwood, delivering a lasting impression of refined masculinity and tropical allure. Encased in an emerald-green glass bottle with intricate vine embroidery, the design draws inspiration from Jean Paul Gaultier's 2010/11 Autumn-Winter collection. A single embroidered leaf discreetly conceals the bottle's sculpted form, adding an element of seductive charm. Top Notes: Green Notes, Watery Notes, Mint and Ginger. Heart Notes: Coconut, Fig and Salt. Base Notes: Tonka Bean and Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Zimaya Modhesh Aura Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Zimaya Modhesh Aura Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an oriental woody EDP for men that embodies confidence, sophistication and refined masculinity.Opening with a fresh burst of Lavender, Mint, Bergamot and Woody accords, it delivers an energising first impression that is both invigorating and modern. At its heart, a distinctive blend of Cardamom, Dry Amber, Benzoin and a hint of Pineapple introduces a rich, spicy-sweet complexity, striking a perfect balance between elegance and boldness. The fragrance gently settles into a smooth, enduring base of Tonka Bean, Vanilla and Musk, offering a warm, creamy trail that lingers with effortless charm. Crafted for the man who commands attention through subtle strength and timeless presence. Top Notes: Woody, Lavender, Bergamot and Mint. Heart Notes: Cardamom, Dry Amber, Benzoin and Pineapple. Base Notes: Tonka Bean, Vanilla and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana Devotion Intense Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Dolce & Gabbana Devotion Eau De Parfum Intense (100ml) is a radiant gourmand EDP that encapsulates the house's signature passion for Italian elegance and artisanal craft.This intense reinterpretation of the original Devotion unfurls with the indulgent warmth of Hazelnut, evoking a sense of comforting richness from the very first spritz. At its heart, luminous Orange Blossom blooms with floral brightness, adding a vibrant contrast that uplifts the composition. The scent settles into a smooth and enveloping base of sensual Vanilla, wrapping the skin in sweetness and sophistication. Balancing freshness with depth, and delicacy with intensity, this fragrance is a glowing tribute to Mediterranean beauty, modern yet timeless, familiar yet enchantingly new. Presented in a striking amber-toned bottle adorned with Dolce & Gabbana's iconic Sacred Heart emblem, it is a celebration of love, devotion and the art of perfumery. Top Notes: Hazelnut. Heart Notes: Orange Blossom. Base Notes: Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Centaurus Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Creed Centaurus Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a powerful and radiant woody amber EDP inspired by one of the largest constellations in the night sky.Designed to evoke the celestial brilliance of stars, this universal scent blazes open with vibrant plumes of incandescent Tobacco lit by fiery Pink Pepper, Cinnamon and spicy Cardamom. As the fragrance unfolds, a luminous heart of Sandalwood, Geranium, Jasmine, Heliotrope and Patchouli emerges, softening the intensity with floral and creamy warmth. The base settles into a deep, sensual trail of Benzoin, Tolu Balm, Tonka Bean, Ambroxan and rich Bourbon Vanilla from Madagascar, wrapping the wearer in an enduring and star-charged embrace that captivates long into the night. Top Notes: Cardamom, Cinnamon, Tobacco and Pink Pepper. Heart Notes: Geranium, Sandalwood, Heliotrope, Jasmine and Patchouli. Base Notes: Benzoin, Tolu Balm, Tonka Bean, Ambroxan and Bourbon Vanilla from Madagascar.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Queen Of Silk Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Creed Queen of Silk Eau De Parfum (30ml) is a luminous floral amber EDP that captures the luxurious softness and exquisite sheen of silk, celebrating its historic elegance and sensuality.This refined composition opens with the delicate allure of Chinese Osmanthus and Magnolia, accented by a golden thread of Saffron, creating a radiant yet warm introduction. At the heart, creamy Tuberose is entwined with the exotic sweetness of Passion Fruit, while Agarwood and earthy Javanese Patchouli add a deep, resinous complexity. The fragrance settles into an opulent base where Madagascan Vanilla, smoky Incense and Myrrh are layered with Ambroxan, Musk and Chinese Cedarwood, leaving a smouldering trail that is both captivating and timeless. A scent of sophistication and faraway splendour, Queen of Silk is a fragrant homage to one of history's most treasured fabrics. Top Notes: Osmanthus, Magnolia and Saffron. Heart Notes: Tuberose, Passion Fruit, Agarwood and Javanese Patchouli. Base Notes: Vanilla from Madagascar, Incense, Myrrh, Ambroxan, Chinese Cedarwood and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Childs Farm Fragrance-Free Oat Derma Bath Milk 250ml

Offering up to 12 hours of hydration in just one use, this gentle emollient bath milk transforms bath time into a comforting ritual for even the most delicate or eczema-prone skin. Free from sulphates. Dermatologist and paediatrician approved. Cruelty-free & vegan-friendly.

listings.rawTitle: Childs Farm Fragrance-Free Baby All Over Balm 50ml
listings.description: Childs Farm Baby All Over Balm Fragrance Free (50ml) is a gentle, nourishing balm created to care for even the most delicate newborn skin. listings.rawTitle: Childs Farm Fragrance-Free Kids Body Moisturiser 200ml

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity Reflections Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Calvin Klein Eternity Reflections Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a vibrant, tropical floral EDP that captures the carefree spirit of summer romance. listings.rawTitle: Childs Farm Fragrance-Free Oat Derma Face Cream 50ml

listings.rawTitle: Childs Farm Fragrance-Free Oat Derma Shampoo 250ml

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity For Men Eau De Toilette 30ml

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has A Gun Not A Perfume Eau De Parfum 50ml

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo Amour Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Kenzo Amour Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an enchanting, spellbinding floral fragrance with undertones of exotic Woods which lends and undeniably romantic atmosphere to this already warm and embracing EDP.Launched in 2006, this fragrance features delicate notes Rice and White Tea, gradually unfolding into a floral heart of Frangipani, Cherry Blossom and Heliotrope. listings.rawTitle: Kenzo Flower Eau De Toilette 30ml

listings.rawTitle: Joop Homme Aftershave Splash 75ml

listings.rawTitle: Lattafa Ramz Lattafa Silver Eau De Parfum 100ml

listings.rawTitle: Makeup Revolution Timeless Eau De Toilette 100ml

listings.rawTitle: Lancome Tresor Eau De Parfum 30ml

listings.rawTitle: Lancome La Vie Est Belle Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Lancome La Vie Est Belle Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a floral EDP for women which has been conceived as an expression of natural beauty, joie de vivre and the enjoyment of simple pleasures.An elegant olfactory signature scent, this fragrance opens with the sparkling citrus flavours of Blackcurrant and Pear. listings.rawTitle: Lattafa Qaed Al Fursan Eau De Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Lattafa Qaed Al Fursan Eau De Parfum (90ml) is an oriental fruity woody aromatic unisex EDP which provides a timeless, irresistible scent experience.Opening with a fruity floral melange of Wild Berries, Apple, Birch, Oriental Woodsy Notes and Bergamot, the composition moves on to a heart where the prolonged floral indulgence of Rose and Jasmine meets the earthiness of Patchouli and additional Woodsy Notes. listings.rawTitle: Lancome Magie Noire Eau De Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Lancome Magie Noire Eau De Toilette (75ml) is a floral EDT for women which casts a magic spell with its captivating love potion, enticing its victim into a passionate union.Opening with a floral and fruity melange of Bulgarian Rose, Raspberry and Bergamot, it leads on to an alluring heart combining Myrrh and Incense with sensual Ylang Ylang and opulent Jasmine. This culminates in a warm and sophisticated drydown with the velvety, comforting notes of Amber and Patchouli. Top Notes: Galbanum, Cassis, Cassia, Hiacynth, Bulgarian Rose, Raspberry and Bergamot. Base Notes: Oakmoss, Spices, Civet, Incense, Patchouli, Amber, Myrrh, Sandalwood, Vetiver and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Lattafa Fakhar Lattafa Man Eau De Parfum 100ml

listings.rawTitle: Lattafa Badee Al Oud Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Lattafa Badee Al Oud Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an oriental, woody and spicy unisex EDP which enchants with refreshing Bergamot and the tart olfactory notes of Blackcurrant.The composition opens with the fruity floral blend of refreshing Bergamot and zesty Blackcurrant, warmed with the added spice of Pink Peppercorn. listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Eau De Parfum 60ml
listings.description: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Eau De Parfum (60ml) is a powerful, oriental and floral EDP which explodes with joy and finishes with a seductive twist, generating excitement and anticipation. Heart Notes: Red Spider Lily and Jasmine Sambac. Base Notes: Vanilla and Benzoin.

listings.rawTitle: Lattafa Ana Abiyedh Rouge Eau De Parfum 60ml

listings.rawTitle: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Noir Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Noir Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a rich interpretation of the signature Viva la Juicy scent, this floral, fruity fragrance embodies the woman who is dangerous in a good way. listings.rawTitle: Penhaligon's Best Seller Scent Library 10 x 2ml
listings.description: Penhaligon's Best Seller Scent Library (10 x 2ml) is a distinguished fragrance discovery set that brings together ten of the house's most celebrated scents in a refined and travel-friendly collection.Perfect for those seeking to explore Penhaligon's diverse olfactory world, this set features everything from airy florals and classic citrus to deep, evocative woods and spices. Whether as an introduction to the brand or a thoughtful gift, it offers a sensorial journey through elegance, charm and timeless British perfumery.Collection Contains: 1 x Penhaligon's Luna Eau De Toilette (2ml) - a luminous floral fragrance with bright citrus and a soft musky base, inspired by moonlight's graceful glow. 1 x Penhaligon's Empressa Eau De Toilette (2ml) - a radiant, feminine scent with sparkling fruits and sensual amber undertones. 1 x Penhaligon's Endymion Concentré (2ml) - a deeper interpretation of the original, blending aromatic spices with suede and incense. 1 x Penhaligon's Halfeti Eau De Parfum (2ml) - a rich, opulent fragrance combining Turkish rose, spices and smoky woods. 1 x Penhaligon's The Favourite Eau De Parfum (2ml) - a powdery floral fragrance of mimosa, musk and sandalwood with regal elegance. 1 x Penhaligon's The Coveted Duchess Rose Eau De Parfum (2ml) - a whimsical blend of youthful rose and warm musks with a mischievous twist. 1 x Penhaligon's Lord George Eau De Parfum (2ml) - a bold and masculine blend of amber, brandy and shaving soap accords. 1 x Penhaligon's Blenheim Bouquet Eau De Toilette (2ml) - a timeless citrus aromatic scent of lemon, lavender and pine. 1 x Penhaligon's Juniper Sling Eau De Toilette (2ml) - a crisp, spirited blend of gin, juniper berries and black pepper inspired by London Dry Gin. 1 x Penhaligon's Quercus Eau De Cologne (2ml) - a fresh and lively citrus fragrance with mossy woods and spices.

listings.rawTitle: Penhaligon's The Coveted Duchess Rose Eau De Parfum 75ml

listings.rawTitle: Penhaligon's A Kiss Of Bliss Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Penhaligon's A Kiss of Bliss Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a radiant floral EDP that celebrates the joy of indulgence and the elegance of unfiltered emotion.The composition opens with a luminous blend of fresh citrus accords and delicate florals, casting a sparkling aura of vitality and grace. Heart Notes: Tuberose and Jasmine. Base Notes: Sandalwood and Musks.

listings.rawTitle: Penhaligon's Portraits Scent Library 10 x 2ml
listings.description: Penhaligon's Portraits Scent Library (10 x 2ml) is a captivating fragrance discovery set that showcases ten characterful scents from the iconic Portraits collection, each inspired by an eccentric member of a fictional aristocratic family.This finely curated ensemble invites the wearer to explore a world of scandal, seduction and British wit, with each fragrance revealing a distinct personality, from daring rebels and mysterious outsiders to elegant dames and distinguished gentlemen. As the scent settles, it unveils a deep, sensual base of marine notes, soft Amber and Musk, grounded in warm woods to evoke the essence of ocean breezes and wide-open horizons. Pacific is a confident, clean signature scent for those who lead with conviction. Top Notes: Bergamot, Lemon, Tangerine and Cardamom. Heart Notes: Lavender, Laurel and Cypress. Base Notes: Woody, Marine, Amber and Musky.

listings.rawTitle: Rayhaan Lion Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Rayhaan Lion Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an irresistibly bold EDP crafted for the confident, modern man.It ignites the senses with a crisp opening of Pear, Lavender, Mint and Bergamot, a refreshing burst which commands attention from the very first spray. As it settles, the heart reveals a smooth and spicy blend of Cinnamon, Clary Sage and Cumin, evoking depth and quiet power. Finally, it lingers on the skin with a rich and sensual base of Vanilla, Amber, Patchouli and Cedar, leaving behind a trail of warmth and sophistication. Lion is a tribute to strength, charm and undeniable appeal, a fragrance as magnetic and timeless as the man who wears it. Top Notes: Pear, Lavender, Mint and Bergamot. Heart Notes: Cinnamon, Clary Sage and Cumin. Base Notes: Vanilla, Amber, Patchouli and Cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Rayhaan Pretty In Pink Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Rayhaan Pretty In Pink Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a romantic and refined EDP that celebrates modern femininity with a touch of timeless elegance.It opens with the fresh, juicy note of Cassis, offering a vibrant and slightly tart introduction that instantly captivates. At its heart, delicate May Rose and soft Freesia bloom in harmony, creating a floral bouquet that feels graceful and effortlessly chic. The dry-down reveals a warm, sensual base of creamy Vanilla, earthy Patchouli, smooth woody notes and the subtle musk of Ambroxan, leaving behind a trail that is both tender and alluring. Pretty In Pink is a graceful balance of strength and softness, an elegant signature for the modern muse. Top Notes: Cassis. Heart Notes: May Rose and Freesia. Base Notes: Vanilla, Patchouli, Woody Notes and Ambroxan.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana Devotion Intense Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Dolce & Gabbana Devotion Eau De Parfum Intense (30ml) is a radiant gourmand EDP that encapsulates the house's signature passion for Italian elegance and artisanal craft.This intense reinterpretation of the original Devotion unfurls with the indulgent warmth of Hazelnut, evoking a sense of comforting richness from the very first spritz. At its heart, luminous Orange Blossom blooms with floral brightness, adding a vibrant contrast that uplifts the composition. The scent settles into a smooth and enveloping base of sensual Vanilla, wrapping the skin in sweetness and sophistication. Balancing freshness with depth, and delicacy with intensity, this fragrance is a glowing tribute to Mediterranean beauty, modern yet timeless, familiar yet enchantingly new. Presented in a striking amber-toned bottle adorned with Dolce & Gabbana's iconic Sacred Heart emblem, it is a celebration of love, devotion and the art of perfumery. Top Notes: Hazelnut. Heart Notes: Orange Blossom. Base Notes: Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Rayhaan Imperia Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Rayhaan Imperia Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a regal and commanding men's EDP inspired by the grandeur of ancient Rome, crafted for the modern conqueror.It opens with the crisp zest of Italian Bergamot, the juicy freshness of Green Apple and a cool touch of Mint, lifted by the resinous sparkle of Elemi. The heart blends floral elegance with earthy richness, Jasmine and Rose harmonise with deep Indonesian Patchouli and creamy Sandalwood to evoke refined strength and timeless charisma. As it dries down, a base of Oakmoss, sensual Musk, warm Amber and Virginian Cedar leaves a majestic trail, embodying victory and legacy. Imperia is a bold declaration of power and prestige. Top Notes: Italian Bergamot, Apple, Mint and Elemi. Heart Notes: Jasmine, Rose, Patchouli and Sandalwood. Base Notes: Oakmoss, Musk, Amber and Virginian Cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Lattafa Teriaq Intense Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Lattafa Teriaq Intense Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a fragrance which boldly defies convention, unapologetically unique in its daring blend of luxurious, raw intensity.Crafted by master perfumer Quentin Bisch, this oriental spicy EDP ignites the senses with an intoxicating mix of warm, creamy notes. The scent opens with a sparkling touch of Saffron and Bergamot, creating a bright yet complex introduction. At its heart, rich Plum Liquor and the warmth of Cinnamon blend together in a seductive dance, enveloping the wearer in their sweet, spicy embrace. As the fragrance settles, deep Amber, Tonka Bean and Benzoin form a rich, smooth base which lingers with a velvety warmth, leaving behind an aura of irresistible allure. With every note, Teriaq Intense reveals a raw, sensual sophistication, making it an unforgettable experience for both women and men. Top Notes: Saffron and Bergamot. Heart Notes: Plum Liquor and Cinnamon. Base Notes: Amber, Tonka Bean and Benzoin.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentleman Society Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Givenchy Gentleman Society Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a woody, floral, aromatic fragrance for men which redefines the characteristics of modern masculinity with a wild Narcissus flower at its heart.Long-wearing, deep and multifaceted, the EDP opens with the crisp, green, aromatic notes of Sage and the comforting, seductive, spiciness of Cardamom. This leads on to a heart where the rich florality of Wild Narcissus contrasts with the earthy woodiness of a quartet of Vetiver variants, harvested in France, Haiti, Madagascar and Uruguay. This culminates in a sensuous, woody base with creamy Vanilla combining with the addictive essences of Sandalwood and Cedarwood. Gentleman Society is housed in the iconic bottle of Givenchy men's fragrances with a 4G monogram in gleaming silver metal adorning the black lacquered finish. Top Notes: Sage and Cardamom. Heart Notes: Absolute of Narcissus, Essence of Vetiver (Haiti), CO2 Vetiver Extract (Haiti), Essence of Vetiver (Uruguay) and Organic Essence of Vetiver (Madagascar). Base Notes: Cedarwood, Sandalwood and Tasuki Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Delphinus Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Creed Delphinus Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a cosmic woody amber EDP that captures the radiant allure of the Delphinus constellation, once a guiding light for travellers and dreamers.This universal scent opens with a luminous blend of Black Pepper, Pink Pepper and smoky Incense, creating a magnetic and mysterious introduction. Almond adds a soft, nutty brightness that leads into a floral heart of Heliotrope, Orchid and the opulent shimmer of Orris Butter - known as the blue gold of perfumery. As the scent deepens, sensual Patchouli, rich Tonka Bean and velvety Bourbon Vanilla from Madagascar unfold over a warm base of Amberwood and Leather Accord, conjuring the comforting glow of a starlit sky and a trail of celestial elegance. Top Notes: Black Pepper, Incense, Almond and Pink Pepper. Heart Notes: Heliotrope, Orchid and Orris Butter. Base Notes: Patchouli, Tonka Bean, Amberwood, Leather Accord and Bourbon Vanilla from Madagascar.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Ever So Fresh Eau De Parfum 125ml
listings.description: Marc Jacobs Daisy Ever So Fresh Eau De Parfum (125ml) is a vibrant, long-lasting EDP that brings a fresh burst of energy to the iconic Daisy line.The composition opens with an exhilarating medley of Mandarin Essence, succulent Mango and sweet Pineapple, creating an immediate sense of sunshine and joy. This radiant opening gives way to a soft floral heart of Rosewater and Orange Blossom Essence, lending a delicate elegance and airy brightness that dances on the skin. As the fragrance settles, the warmth of Cashmere Woods emerges, grounding the scent in a smooth, cocooning base that lingers with sensual ease. Airy yet energetic, Daisy Ever So Fresh captures the spirit of spontaneity and carefree charm, an ode to youthful freedom and sunny optimism. Top Notes: Mandarin Essence, Mango and Pineapple. Heart Notes: Rosewater and Orange Blossom Essence. Base Notes: Cashmere Woods.

listings.rawTitle: Sol De Janeiro Doce De Leite Cheirosa '71 Fragrance Mist 90ml
listings.description: Sol De Janeiro Doce De Leite Cheirosa '71 Fragrance Mist (90ml) is an irresistible amber gourmand body mist that wraps the skin and hair in a deliciously decadent scent. The base leaves a cosy, lingering impression of Tonka Bean and Coconut Blossom, enveloping you in a velvety trail reminiscent of sun-warmed skin and sweet summer moments.
