Heart Notes: Laotian Oud, Benzoin from Siam. Base Notes: Vanilla and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Oud Silk Mood Eau De Parfum 70ml
listings.description: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Oud Silk Mood Eau De Parfum (70ml) is an airy yet sensual EDP that intertwines the richness of oud with the delicate fluidity of silk.This elegant composition opens with the crisp, floral brightness of Bulgarian Rose, balanced by the fresh, herbaceous touch of Blue Chamomile. At its heart, the deep, smoky intensity of Laotian Oud unfolds, adding a captivating depth, while the scent settles into a refined base of Papyrus and warm Amber, creating a sophisticated and long-lasting trail. A harmonious blend of strength and softness, Oud Silk Mood is a fragrance of effortless allure. Top Notes: Bulgarian Rose and Blue Chamomile. Heart Notes: Laotian Oud. Base Notes: Papyrus and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Oud Silk Mood Extrait De Parfum 70ml
listings.description: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Oud Silk Mood Extrait De Parfum (70ml) is an intensified, more opulent interpretation of the original Oud Silk Mood, blending the deep richness of oud with the fluid elegance of silk.This exquisite fragrance opens with the luminous floralcy of Bulgarian Rose, softened by the fresh, herbaceous nuance of Blue Chamomile. At its heart, the smoky depth of Laotian Oud takes centre stage, weaving an irresistible contrast between strength and delicacy. The scent unfolds into a refined base of earthy Papyrus and warm Amber, leaving a long-lasting, sensual trail that is both airy and enveloping. Top Notes: Bulgarian Rose and Blue Chamomile. Heart Notes: Laotian Oud. Base Notes: Papyrus and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Oud Satin Mood Scented Hair Mist 70ml
listings.description: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Oud Satin Mood Scented Hair Mist (70ml) is a lightweight yet indulgent mist that delicately scents the hair with the luxurious and velvety aura of Oud Satin Mood.Infused with the powdery elegance of Violet and the deep floral richness of Bulgarian Rose, this mist enhances every movement with an irresistible trail. The sensual heart of Laotian Oud and resinous Benzoin from Siam adds depth and warmth, while the smooth embrace of Vanilla and radiant Amber ensures a refined, long-lasting presence. Designed to be gentle on hair, this mist offers an elegant way to enjoy the opulence of Oud Satin Mood daily

listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Polo 67 Eau De Parfum 125ml
listings.description: Ralph Lauren Polo 67 Eau De Parfum (125ml) is a bold, sophisticated men's EDP which ignites the senses with an exhilarating blend of freshness and sensual warmth.Opening with a vibrant burst of Green Mandarin and Bergamot, elevated by the subtle spice of Cardamom, this composition awakens the spirit with citrus energy. At its heart, sun-ripened Pineapple meets the nutty warmth of Sesame Seed, balanced by aromatic notes of Cypress and Lavandin which bring a refined, herbal depth. As it settles, the base unveils a smoky blend of earthy Vetiver and rugged Cedarwood, wrapped in the smooth, resinous warmth of Benzoin, leaving behind a powerful and captivating trail. Top Notes: Green Mandarin, Bergamot and Cardamom. Heart Notes: Pineapple, Sesame Seed, Cypress and Lavandin. Base Notes: Vetiver, Cedarwood and Benzoin.

listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Polo 67 Eau De Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Ralph Lauren Polo 67 Eau De Parfum (75ml) is a bold, sophisticated men's EDP which ignites the senses with an exhilarating blend of freshness and sensual warmth.Opening with a vibrant burst of Green Mandarin and Bergamot, elevated by the subtle spice of Cardamom, this composition awakens the spirit with citrus energy. At its heart, sun-ripened Pineapple meets the nutty warmth of Sesame Seed, balanced by aromatic notes of Cypress and Lavandin which bring a refined, herbal depth. As it settles, the base unveils a smoky blend of earthy Vetiver and rugged Cedarwood, wrapped in the smooth, resinous warmth of Benzoin, leaving behind a powerful and captivating trail. Top Notes: Green Mandarin, Bergamot and Cardamom. Heart Notes: Pineapple, Sesame Seed, Cypress and Lavandin. Base Notes: Vetiver, Cedarwood and Benzoin.

listings.rawTitle: Zimaya Tiramisu Caramel Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Zimaya Tiramisu Caramel Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a decadent oriental EDP for both women and men that envelops the senses in a luxurious blend of sweetness, warmth and sophistication.Opening with a golden burst of rich Caramel, it instantly sets a tone of indulgence. The heart introduces a luscious fusion of Honey and Coumarin, intertwined with subtly aromatic woody notes that bring a comforting depth to the composition. As it settles, the base unfolds with the creamy richness of Vanilla Bean Extract, elegantly warmed by a smooth Whiskey Accord and the soft sensuality of Musk. Top Note: Caramel. Heart Notes: Honey, Coumarin and Woody Notes. Base Notes: Vanilla, Whiskey and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Zimaya Tiramisu Coco Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Zimaya Tiramisu Coco Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an oriental unisex EDP that captures the decadent allure of the iconic Italian dessert in olfactory form.Opening with a rich blend of Amaretto and Coffee, this gourmand composition instantly entices the senses with its indulgent, aromatic warmth. The heart reveals a delicious trio of Ice Cream, Biscuit and creamy Vanilla, evoking the comfort and sweetness of a freshly layered tiramisu. As it settles, the base notes of Brown Sugar, Amber and more Vanilla unfold to create a lingering, velvety trail that envelops the skin in cosy sophistication. Perfect for lovers of dessert-inspired scents, this eau de parfum is a refined yet comforting fragrance ideal for cooler seasons and intimate moments. Top Notes: Amaretto and Coffee. Heart Notes: Ice Cream, Biscuit and Vanilla. Base Notes: Vanilla, Brown Sugar and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Stephane Humbert Lucas God of Fire Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Stephane Humbert Lucas God of Fire Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a bold, fiery composition inspired by the power and mystique of the Aztec God of Fire.Crafted for those with unshakable presence, this unisex fragrance opens with a luminous burst of Mango, Lemon, Pink Berries and Ginger, an exhilarating introduction that ignites the senses. The heart pulses with the intrigue of Blue Coumarin and Jasmine, grounded by dry woody nuances that add depth and sophistication. In the base, a smouldering blend of Oud, Nagarmotha, Musk and Amber embodies the raw strength and grandeur of its mythical muse. A fragrance of contrasts, radiant yet shadowy, fresh yet smouldering, it commands attention with every wear. Top Notes: Mango, Lemon, Pink Berries and Ginger. Heart Notes: Blue Coumarin, Jasmine and Dry Woods. Base Notes: Oud, Nagarmotha, Musk and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Stephane Humbert Lucas Pink Boa Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Stephane Humbert Lucas Pink Boa Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a bold and whimsical EDP that captures the electric energy of a Parisian cabaret.Inspired by the glamour of the Champs Élysées, this captivating scent opens with an unexpected twist of Rosemary, zesty Bergamot and juicy Blackcurrant, evoking the anticipation of a performer preparing to take the stage. The heart of the fragrance reveals a dazzling blend of cold Vodka Accord, ripe Raspberry and aromatic Basil, reminiscent of backstage indulgence and the flutter of a fuchsia feather boa. As it settles, a seductive base of Patchouli, Amber, Olibanum and Musk creates a warm, smoky trail that lingers like the final note of a mesmerising performance. Top Notes: Rosemary, Bergamot and Blackcurrant. Heart Notes: Vodka, Raspberry and Basil. Base Notes: Patchouli, Amber, Olibanum and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Stephane Humbert Lucas Venom Incarnat Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Stephane Humbert Lucas Venom Incarnat Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a provocative and sensual fragrance, designed to embody the essence of temptation and desire.This daring composition opens with an irresistibly sweet and juicy fusion of Blackberry, Strawberry, Wild Strawberry and Caramel, evoking the thrill of forbidden indulgence. At its heart, notes of tart Raspberry blend with warm Cinnamon and the dry elegance of Virginia Cedar, creating a tension between sweetness and spice. The base unveils a rich and seductive blend of Tonka Bean, Black Vanilla, earthy Patchouli and supple Russian Leather, leaving behind a dark, velvety trail that lingers like a whispered promise. Top Notes: Blackberry, Strawberry, Wild Strawberry and Caramel. Heart Notes: Raspberry, Virginia Cedar and Cinnamon. Base Notes: Tonka Bean, Black Vanilla, Patchouli and Russian Leather.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Fico Di Amalfi Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Acqua Di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Fico Di Amalfi Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a fresh and fruity EDT for men and women, which exudes a revitalising fragrance which continuously surprises just like the stunning landscape of the Amalfi coast. This fragrance is characterised by its fruity notes of Bergamot, Lemon, Grapefruit and Cedar Wood. At its heart, notes of Fig come together with Pink Pepper scents and Jasmine Petals accords while the base of this fragrance is rounded off with harmonious accents of Fig, Cedar Wood and Benzoin. Top Notes: Italian Lemon, Italian Bergamot and Grapefruit. Heart Notes: Fig Nectar, Pink Pepper and Jasmine Petals. Base Notes: Fig Wood, Cedarwood and Benzoin.

listings.rawTitle: Initio Addictive Vibration Eau De Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Initio Addictive Vibration Eau De Parfum (90ml) is a floral EDP where instinct intertwines with elegance, offering a hypnotic experience that pulses with sensuality and emotional connection.Opening with the luminous freshness of Apple Blossom and Orange Blossom, this radiant composition captures the effervescence of white florals in full bloom. A golden touch of rich Honey flows through the heart, lending warmth and sweetness, while creamy Vanilla Orchid deepens the fragrance with its indulgent, velvety charm. As it evolves, a gentle wave of Musk emerges, soft yet magnetically alluring, leaving a lingering impression that is both intimate and unforgettable. Top Notes: Apple Blossom and Orange Blossom. Heart Notes: Honey and Vanilla Orchid. Base Notes: Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Initio Atomic Rose Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Initio Atomic Rose Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a fiercely romantic floral EDP that detonates with raw emotion and carnal allure, offering an untamed portrayal of love at its most intense.The journey begins with a radiant spark of Pink Pepper and Bergamot, a tantalising prelude that sets the stage for an opulent heart where Bulgarian and Turkish Roses bloom in exquisite abundance. Their full-bodied richness is lifted by the luminous clarity of Egyptian Jasmine, forming a seductive floral core that is both bold and beguiling. As the fragrance unfolds, creamy Madagascar Vanilla and the airy brightness of Hedione weave through the composition, enveloping the senses in a hypnotic trail of warmth and obsession. Top Notes: Pink Pepper and Bergamot. Heart Notes: Bulgarian Rose, Turkish Rose and Egyptian Jasmine. Base Notes: Madagascar Vanilla and Hedione.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Queen Of Silk Eau De Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Creed Queen of Silk Eau De Parfum (75ml) is a luminous floral amber EDP that captures the luxurious softness and exquisite sheen of silk, celebrating its historic elegance and sensuality.This refined composition opens with the delicate allure of Chinese Osmanthus and Magnolia, accented by a golden thread of Saffron, creating a radiant yet warm introduction. At the heart, creamy Tuberose is entwined with the exotic sweetness of Passion Fruit, while Agarwood and earthy Javanese Patchouli add a deep, resinous complexity. The fragrance settles into an opulent base where Madagascan Vanilla, smoky Incense and Myrrh are layered with Ambroxan, Musk and Chinese Cedarwood, leaving a smouldering trail that is both captivating and timeless. A scent of sophistication and faraway splendour, Queen of Silk is a fragrant homage to one of history's most treasured fabrics. Top Notes: Osmanthus, Magnolia and Saffron. Heart Notes: Tuberose, Passion Fruit, Agarwood and Javanese Patchouli. Base Notes: Vanilla from Madagascar, Incense, Myrrh, Ambroxan, Chinese Cedarwood and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Crivelli Oud Maracuja Extrait De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Maison Crivelli Oud Maracujá Extrait De Parfum (50ml) is a bold and exotic woody extrait that takes the senses on a thrilling olfactory expedition, where vibrant tropical fruits collide with the primal richness of Oud.Inspired by the surreal experience of tasting passion fruit in the heart of an ancient forest, this unisex fragrance opens with an unexpected burst of juicy Passionfruit and ripe fruity notes, lifted by the opulence of Saffron and the floral elegance of Turkish Rose. This luminous opening gives way to a powerful heart where earthy Agarwood (Oud), Indonesian Patchouli Leaf and resinous Benzoin converge, creating an immersive atmosphere of warmth and mystique. In the base, smoky Akigalawood, deep Leather and golden Amber are softened by a sensual blend of Vanilla and Labdanum, lending a lingering trail of fiery depth and sweet comfort. Oud Maracujá is a daring, unforgettable scent that captures the contrast between untamed nature and refined ritual, a vivid journey etched in rich woods, glowing resins and lush fruits. Top Notes: Passionfruit, Fruity Notes, Saffron and Turkish Rose. Heart Notes: Agarwood (Oud), Indonesian Patchouli Leaf and Benzoin. Base Notes: Leather, Akigalawood, Amber, Vanilla and Labdanum.

listings.rawTitle: Initio Narcotic Delight Eau De Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Initio Narcotic Delight Eau De Parfum (90ml) is a hedonistic floral gourmand EDP that embodies pure indulgence and sensual abandon, drawing the senses into a whirlwind of temptation and intoxication.At the heart of this provocative composition lies the rich, erogenous warmth of Vanilla Bean, instantly igniting desire with its velvety allure. A tantalising twist of Pink and Black Pepper adds a crackling vibrancy, heightening the tension and excitement. As the scent deepens, a lavish pour of Cognac envelops the blend in a golden haze of heady warmth, blurred further by the bold emergence of juicy Cherry and the smoky allure of fine cigar swirls. Magnetic and addictive, Narcotic Delight is an olfactory embodiment of unrestrained pleasure, leaving a seductive trail that lingers on the skin and resonates in the soul. Top Notes: Vanilla Bean. Heart Notes: Black and Pink Pepper. Base Notes: Cognac.

listings.rawTitle: Katy Perry Killer Queen Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Katy Perry Killer Queen Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a signature fragrance from international pop sensation Katy Perry.Killer Queen is a floral fragrance for women that has been described as playful, sophisticated and powerful. Packaged in a red jewel-shaped bottle with a crowned golden top that comes with its own mounting pedestal. Top Notes: Wild Berry, Dark Plum and Bergamot. Heart Notes: Red Velvet Flower, Rainbow Plumeria and Natural Jasmine Sambac. Base Botes: Cashmere, Natural Patchouli Heat and Liquid Praline.

listings.rawTitle: DKNY Be Delicious 100% Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: DKNY Be Delicious 100% Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a vibrant floral EDP for women that celebrates freshness, individuality and the playful spirit of New York.This joyful scent opens with juicy notes of sophisticated Apples and Blackcurrant Buds (Cassis), offering a bright, fruity burst that feels instantly energising. At the heart, delicate Magnolia blooms with soft femininity, adding a floral elegance to the composition. The fragrance settles into a smooth, sensual base of creamy Sandalwood, grounding the brightness with a warm, lasting trail. Fresh, juicy and utterly delicious, this perfume is ideal for modern women who embrace confidence and creativity. Top Notes: Apple and Blackcurrant Buds (Cassis). Heart Notes: Magnolia. Base Notes: Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Crivelli Ambre Chromatique Extrait De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Maison Crivelli Ambre Chromatique Extrait De Parfum (50ml) is a unique and captivating unisex fragrance inspired by an adventurous trek through vibrant, multicoloured jungles in search of Benzoin resins.This scent weaves together a beautiful contrast of bright, resinous facets and a deep, warm Amber accord, evoking the essence of a journey through nature's most vivid landscapes. The fragrance begins with an invigorating burst of Incense and Pink Pepper, leading into the heart of Davana and Osmanthus, which add a floral, slightly spicy dimension. As it settles, the base reveals rich notes of Benzoin, Bourbon Vanilla and Amber, creating an enveloping, woody warmth. With touches of sharp flower and sun feather, this fragrance balances dry, resinous elements with liqueur-like softness, offering an opulent, sensual, and truly unforgettable experience. Top Notes: Incense and Pink Pepper. Heart Notes: Davana and Osmanthus. Base Notes: Benzoin, Bourbon Vanilla and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Roberto Cavalli Paradiso Azzurro Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Roberto Cavalli Paradiso Azzurro Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a fresh floral EDP for women, inspired by the serene elegance of the Italian Riviera. Like a soft Mediterranean breeze, this radiant scent captures the essence of coastal glamour with a composition that balances airy lightness and refined sophistication. It opens with a sparkling burst of citrusy Bergamot, uplifted by herbaceous notes of Lavender that lend a calming, sun-drenched warmth reminiscent of golden shores and crystal-clear waters. At the heart, luminous Jasmine blooms in full splendour, weaving a floral tapestry that evokes sensual femininity. The fragrance settles into a luxurious base of velvety Cashmere, delivering a comforting warmth and depth that lingers like the memory of a perfect summer escape. Top Notes: Bergamot and Lavender. Heart Notes: Jasmine. Base Notes: Cashmere Wood.

listings.rawTitle: Initio Rehab Extrait De Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Initio Rehab Extrait De Parfum (90ml) is a woody aromatic fragrance that offers a profound reset for the senses, embodying a stripped-back elegance where purity meets depth.This refined composition opens with a luminous duo of Bergamot and Black Pepper, igniting the mind with freshness and spice, gently softened by the soothing presence of Lavender. Subtle hints of Spice weave through the heart, where robust Cedarwood, earthy Vetiver and textured Patchouli provide grounding and warmth. As the fragrance settles, a deeply comforting base of creamy Sandalwood, enveloping Musk and smoky Guaiac Wood unfolds, creating a lasting impression of serenity and introspection. Balancing delicate nuance with enduring strength, this scent evokes clarity, tranquillity and inner harmony. Top Notes: Lavender and Bergamot. Heart Notes: Cedarwood, Vetiver and Patchouli. Base Notes: Sandalwood, Musk and Guaiac Wood.

listings.rawTitle: Abercrombie & Fitch Fierce Eau De Cologne Gift Set 100ml
listings.description: Abercrombie & Fitch Fierce Eau De Cologne Gift Set (100ml) is a masculine fragrance duo featuring the iconic Fierce Eau De Cologne in a 100ml bottle, complemented by a convenient 10ml travel spray, perfect for scenting on the go.Collection Contains: 1 x Abercrombie & Fitch Fierce Eau De Cologne (100ml) - a timeless, woody aromatic EDC for men which captures the essence of adventure and confidence. It opens with an invigorating burst of Fir, Lemon and Orange, intertwined with the crispness of Petitgrain and the refreshing whisper of sea notes. As the fragrance unfolds, a heart of aromatic Rosemary blends seamlessly with delicate florals, including Jasmine, Lily-of-the-Valley and Rose, creating a harmonious bouquet. The drydown reveals a sensual base, where the earthy richness of Vetiver and Oakmoss meets the smooth elegance of Brazilian Rosewood and creamy Sandalwood. 1 x Abercrombie & Fitch Fierce Eau De Cologne Travel Spray (10ml)

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty For Him Eau De Toilette 150ml
listings.description: Gucci Guilty For Him Eau De Toilette (150ml) is a woody, aromatic fougere EDT for men with a seductive, provocative composition which depicts a charismatic alpha male wearer, an irresistible magnet for his admirers.The fragrance opens with a fruity melange blending Lavender with zesty Lemon, leading on to a heart brimming over with the appealing scents of African Orange Blossom. It culminates in an earthy, woody and sensual base combining warm accords of Cedar, Patchouli and creamy Vanilla. The fragrance is housed in a luxurious, masculine bottle crafted from cold metal and heavy glass, making an impression of masculinity and luxury. The centre of the bottle is adorned with a metallic Gucci sign, transparent to reveal the contents. Top Notes: Lavender and Amalfi Lemon. Heart Note: African Orange Flower. Base Notes: Virginia Cedar, Patchouli and Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Initio Musk Therapy Extrait De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Initio Musk Therapy Extrait De Parfum (50ml) is a woody floral musk fragrance designed as a sensorial escape into emotional well-being, offering a therapeutic experience that blurs the lines between fragrance and feeling.This opulent composition harmonises velvety White Musk and Pink Musk with the creamy depth of White Sandalwood, forming an irresistibly soft, skin-like cocoon. A radiant flourish of White Magnolia awakens the senses with its delicate, euphoric bloom, while luscious Blackcurrant adds a burst of fruit-forward vibrancy. Uplifting top notes of Bergamot and Mandarin lend a citrus clarity that refreshes the mind and spirit, making this fragrance a natural mood enhancer that soothes, uplifts and restores balance with every breath. Top Notes: Bergamot and Mandarin. Heart Notes: White Magnolia and Blackcurrant. Base Note: White Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Initio Oud For Greatness Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Initio Oud For Greatness Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a powerful EDP exuding raw power and majestic intensity.The natural essence of Oud wood is elevated to perfection, its dark, resinous depths woven into a composition that is both bold and hypnotic. Strikingly natural yet luxuriously textured, this Oud is treated with an almost untamed beauty, its richness accentuated by the warmth of Saffron and the spiced allure of Nutmeg. A whisper of Lavender introduces an unexpected freshness, balancing the opulence with a breath of airiness. Beneath it all, Patchouli and Musk linger in the background, their presence subtle yet essential, allowing the Oud to take centre stage in all its grandeur. Inspired by sacred geometry, this fragrance channels energy, confidence, and the pursuit of greatness, making every dream feel within reach. Top Notes: Saffron, Nutmeg and Lavender. Heart Notes: Agarwood (Oud). Base Notes: Patchouli and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Crivelli Oud Stallion Extrait De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Maison Crivelli Oud Stallion Extrait De Parfum (50ml) is an exhilarating woody oriental fragrance that captures the raw strength and refined elegance of a high-stakes horse race.With a striking opening of fiery Saffron, warm Cardamom and spicy Indonesian Nutmeg, the scent charges forward with intensity and anticipation. At the heart gallops a dynamic fusion of floral and animalic notes, rich Osmanthus, opulent Jasmine and Turkish Rose, blending sensuality with motion in a composition that mirrors the beauty and power of a stallion at full stride. As the fragrance deepens, the commanding presence of Oud and smoky Leather emerges, layered with earthy Cedar, resinous Patchouli and the sweet, comforting depth of Tonka Bean. The result is a bold, addictive extrait that balances spicy heat and floral elegance with smoky warmth and rugged sophistication. Oud Stallion is a fearless expression of contrast - untamed yet polished, powerful yet alluring. Top Notes: Saffron, Cardamom and Indonesian Nutmeg. Heart Notes: Osmanthus, Jasmine and Turkish Rose. Base Notes: Agarwood (Oud), Leather, Cedar, Tonka and Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Obsessed For Men Eau De Toilette 125ml
listings.description: Calvin Klein Obsessed For Men Eau De Toilette (125ml) is a long-lasting woody, oriental EDT for men which challenges tradition and reimagines masculinity with its notes of fresh Cedar Leaves and Warm Amber combined with rich, addictive Black Vanilla.It blurs the lines between masculine and feminine, memory and desire, the past and present. Top Notes: Sichuan Pepper, Grapefruit, Cardamom, Lavender and Lemon. Heart Notes: Leather, Cedar, Labdanum, Pineapple and Geranium. Base Notes: Ambroxan, Black Vanilla Husk, Patchouli, Cinnamon and Amberwood.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Obsession Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Calvin Klein Obsession Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a classic oriental and woody fragrance for women. This EDP was first released by the iconic fashion house in 1985, with a young Kate Moss memorably pictured as the face of the fragrance.Calvin Klein's best-selling perfume, which is also available in a men's version, has a warming, Far-Eastern scent derived from an infusion of green accords, rich spices and sensual powdery ingredients. Packaged in a distinctive ovular bottle, it is recommended for wear as an evening fragrance or for special occasions. Top Notes: Mandarin Orange, Vanilla, Peach, Basil, Bergamot and Lemon. Heart Notes: Sandalwood, Spices, Coriander, Orange Blossom, Jasmine, Oakmoss, Cedar and Rose. Base Notes: Amber, Musk, Civet, Vanilla, Vetiver and Incense.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Crivelli Patchouli Magnetik Extrait De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Maison Crivelli Patchouli Magnetik Extrait De Parfum (50ml) is an intoxicating unisex extrait that captures the raw thrill of riding through tropical patchouli fields during a summer storm.A striking blend of nature's wild beauty and smooth refinement, the scent opens with the sweet juiciness of White Peach and the creamy intensity of Gardenia, evoking lush petals drenched in rain. At its heart, the earthy richness of Patchouli is magnified by the velvety smoothness of Sandalwood, creating a magnetic tension between rugged depth and soft, milky elegance. A whisper of wild Frangipani lends a romantic tropical nuance, hinting at paradise veiled by storm clouds. As the fragrance settles, it unleashes the enveloping warmth of Benzoin and Vanilla. Bold yet serene, Patchouli Magnetik is a sensorial adventure, blending elemental power with sophisticated sensuality. Top Notes: White Peach and Gardenia. Heart Notes: Patchouli and Sandalwood. Base Notes: Benzoin and Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Crivelli Hibiscus Mahajad Extrait De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Maison Crivelli Hibiscus Mahajád Extrait De Parfum (50ml) is an opulent amber floral fragrance that captures the dazzling contrast of delicate florals and rich, textured warmth.Inspired by the sensory wonder of tasting hibiscus tea amidst the vibrancy of a gemstone market, this unisex extrait unfolds with glowing notes of ruby-red Rose and the exotic tartness of Hibiscus, conjuring a vivid impression of shimmering colour and flavour. A refreshing wave of Mint, Crushed Pomegranate and juicy Blackcurrant introduces brightness, while Rose Damascena Orpur absolute and finely carved Leather create an elegant, sensual heart. The warmth deepens into a luxurious base of Madagascan Vanilla, smooth Amber, Ambrette Seed and a gentle touch of Cinnamon, wrapped in the delicate sweetness of Vanilla Orchid. Spearmint Orpur adds a final crisp clarity to this radiant creation. Richly layered and endlessly intriguing, Hibiscus Mahajád is an exquisite celebration of floral freshness and indulgent depth. Top Notes: Vanilla and Amber. Heart Notes: Rose Damascena and Leather. Base Notes: Spearmint, Cassis, Ambrette Seed and Cinnamon.

listings.rawTitle: Initio Side Effect Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Initio Side Effect Eau De Parfum (50ml) is an oriental EDP that embodies raw seduction and hypnotic allure, enveloping the senses in an intoxicating cloud of temptation. Opening with a bold fusion of Tobacco, Lavender, Rum and Cinnamon, the scent immediately ignites desire with its deep, spiced warmth and sultry sweetness. At its heart, rich notes of Oud, smoky Agarwood, and creamy Vanilla Bean intertwine with Saffron and Nutmeg, creating a complex and magnetic blend that teeters between intensity and elegance. Hedione amplifies the composition with its radiant sensuality, casting an irresistible aura that clings to the skin. As the fragrance settles, earthy Patchouli and velvety Musk lend a lingering depth and sophistication. Top Notes: Tobacco, Lavender, Rum and Cinnamon. Heart Notes: Oud, Agarwood, Saffron, Nutmeg and Vanilla Bean. Base Notes: Patchouli and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Lattafa Yara Tous Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Lattafa Yara Tous Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a sweet tropical gourmand EDP that encapsulates exotic charm and sensual indulgence in a captivating blend of creamy warmth and fruity vibrancy.The scent opens with a lush trio of Musk, Vanilla and Coconut, enveloping the senses in a rich, creamy sweetness that immediately feels comforting and enchanting. As it develops, the heart introduces a velvety layer of Sandalwood, Sugar and Marshmallow, evoking a soft, fluffy sweetness that adds both warmth and depth. In the dry down, a burst of juicy Tropical Fruits and ripe Mango emerges, lending a fresh and uplifting twist that perfectly balances the composition's sugary allure. Delightfully addictive and effortlessly charming, Yara Tous is a fragrant escape into a paradise of sweetness and sun-kissed elegance. Top Notes: Musk, Vanilla and Coconut. Heart Notes: Sandalwood, Sugar and Marshmallow. Base Notes: Tropical Fruits and Mango.

listings.rawTitle: Lattafa Bade'e Al Oud Sublime Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Lattafa Bade'e Al Oud Sublime Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a unisex EDP that radiates luxury, depth, and charm. This sophisticated scent opens with an irresistibly sweet and fruity medley of Litchi, Rose, and Apple, creating an uplifting and enticing first impression. At its heart, the perfume blossoms into a delicate yet rich composition of Jasmine and Plum, lending floral sensuality and luscious warmth. As the fragrance settles, earthy Moss, comforting Vanilla, and intense Patchouli anchor the composition, resulting in a perfectly balanced, long-lasting scent that leaves a memorable trail. Encased in a striking red bottle, this aromatic Oudh creation from Lattafa is ideal for those who seek a distinctive and opulent perfume experience. Cruelty-free & vegan-friendly. listings.rawTitle: Lattafa Fakhar Extrait Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Lattafa Fakhar Extrait Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a floral amber EDP for men that strikes a captivating balance between radiant freshness, opulent florals and smooth, warm woods. listings.rawTitle: Lattafa Ameer Al Oudh Intense Oud Eau De Parfum 100ml

At its heart, floral hints of Geranium intertwine with resinous Labdanum and rich Woody Notes, creating a warm, smoky atmosphere evocative of glowing embers and cosy evenings by the fire. The scent reaches its full majesty in the base, where deep, resinous Oud is softened by sweet Vanilla and smoothed with supple Leather, delivering a powerful, luxurious trail that clings to the skin for hours. Top Notes: Saffron and Nutmeg. Heart Notes: Geranium, Woody Notes and Labdanum. Base Notes: Oud, Vanilla and Leather.

listings.rawTitle: Penhaligon's Luna Eau De Toilette 30ml
listings.description: Penhaligon's Luna Eau De Toilette (30ml) is a radiant, celestial fragrance inspired by the moon's soft glow and mystical charm.This elegant composition opens with an effervescent blend of zesty Lemon and sparkling Bergamot, illuminating the senses with a crisp, invigorating freshness. At its heart lies the delicate beauty of Jasmine, unfolding gracefully like moonlight dancing across still waters. The scent is anchored by a gentle, sensual base of Musk and Ambergris, which adds warmth and a whisper of intrigue to the luminous bouquet. Serene, refined and dreamlike, Luna captures the tranquil elegance of nightfall in a fragrance that lingers like a silvery echo beneath the stars. Top Notes: Lemon and Bergamot. Heart Notes: Jasmine. Base Notes: Musk and Ambergris.

listings.rawTitle: Penhaligon's Halfeti Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Penhaligon's Halfeti Eau De Parfum (30ml) is a luxurious woody floral EDP that draws its inspiration from the ancient spice-laden trade routes and the enigmatic allure of the Turkish town of Halfeti.The scent opens with a refreshing surge of Bergamot and zesty Grapefruit, offering a vibrant prelude to the richness that follows. At its heart, the opulence of Turkish Rose is elevated by exotic Spices and the golden warmth of Saffron, creating a hypnotic floral-spiced accord. As the fragrance deepens, a smoky, sensual base of Oud, supple Leather and resinous Amber emerges, leaving a bold, lingering trail that radiates power and mystery. Darkly romantic and irresistibly refined, Halfeti is a masterful blend of seduction, sophistication and timeless elegance. Top Notes: Bergamot and Grapefruit. Heart Notes: Turkish Rose, Saffron and Spices. Base Notes: Oud, Leather and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Penhaligon's Endymion Eau De Cologne 100ml

The fragrance then unfurls into a sensual base of smooth Leather, smoky Incense and resinous Myrrh, leaving behind a distinguished and enduring trail. Top Notes: Bergamot and Lavender. Heart Notes: Nutmeg and Coffee. Base Notes: Leather, Incense and Myrrh.

listings.rawTitle: Penhaligon's Halfeti Leather Eau De Parfum 100ml

Heart Notes: Turkish Rose, Saffron and Spices. Base Notes: Leather, Oud and Patchouli.

Top Notes: Rose and Bitter Almond. Heart Notes: Cherry, Vetiver and Jasmine. Base Notes: Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Oakmoss and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Eau De Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Eau De Toilette (75ml) is a floral fruity amber EDT fragrance for men which pays tribute to the mythical figure that has forever inspired Jean Paul Gaultier - the sailor.Conveying an unconventional vision of masculinity, this scent opens with the freshness of Mint and the spicy character of Cardamom, leading on to a heart of enticing Cinnamon, citrusy Orange Blossom and delicate, powdery Lavender. The torso-shaped bottle displays assertive masculine attributes and its transparent glass reveals the shape of the emblematic garment of the Jean Paul Gaultier man's wardrobe - the sailor's shirt, a symbol of freedom and seduction. Top Notes: Mint, Artemesia, Cardamom and Bergamot. Heart Notes: Lavender, Orange Blossom, Cinnamon and Cumin. Base Notes: Sandalwood, Vanilla, Cedar, Tonka Bean and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau D'issey Pour Homme Eau De Toilette 40ml
listings.description: Issey Miyake L'Eau D'Issey Pour Homme Eau De Toilette (40ml) is a refreshingly invigorating men's fragrance that was launched in 1994 as the brand's signature scent. The truly timeless fragrance is both delicate and masculine - a classic aroma that radiates power and prestige.The scent opens with fresh herb and citrus notes that give way to exotic spices and light floral accents before leaving a lasting impression with warm, woody tones. L'Eau D'Issey is a subtle yet sophisticated scent that is equally manly as it is modest. Packaged in the iconic Issey Miyake bottle inspired by waterfalls - with slender, frosted glass widening at the base. Top notes: Yuzu, Cypress, Coriander, Mandarin, Clary Sage and Fresh Verbena. Heart notes: Blue Water Lily, Nutmeg, Saffron, Bourbon Geranium and Ceylonese Cinnamon. Base notes: Tobacco Amber, Musk, Indian Sandalwood, Haitian Vetiver and Cypriol.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Intense Le Parfum Eau De Parfum 125ml
listings.description: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Intense Le Parfum Eau De Parfum (125ml) sets a commanding presence, ready to navigate the high seas of fragrance with elegance and vigour. The flacon, garbed in a stately black and gold officer's jacket, embodies the power and style of the fragrance within, heralding a new chapter in the Le Male saga. Embarking on a sensory voyage with the spicy allure of Cardamom in its top notes, the parfum sails through the crisp waves of Lavender and Iris at its heart. Anchoring this olfactory expedition, the robust and addictive Vanilla base note casts a long-lasting trail, marking the passage of a leader. It's a fragrance that promises a journey of contrasts, charting a course through fresh and oriental scents to leave an indelible impression of a charismatic officer at the helm. Top Notes: Cardamom. Heart Notes: Lavender and Iris. Base Notes: Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss The Scent Aftershave Lotion Spray 100ml
listings.description: Hugo Boss The Scent For Men Aftershave Lotion Spray (100ml) is a spicy, masculine fragrance for the BOSS Man who enjoys the challenge of seduction, building upon his passions and experiences to prolong and savour every moment. This aftershave engages all five of his senses, creating an inviting fragrance that all women want to be in the presence of.Exquisite notes of spicy Ginger and Citruses unfold to reveal a heart of exotic Maninka and floral Lavender. The fragrance rests and a full-bodied bed of rich Leathers and Woody notes, creating an air of masculine depth and enigma. Top Notes: Ginger, Bergamot and Mandarin Orange. Heart Notes: Maninka and Lavender. Base Notes: Leather and Woody Notes.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Blossom Eau De Parfum 40ml
listings.description: Jimmy Choo Blossom Eau De Parfum (40ml) is a floral fragrance which is sparkling and vivacious, the sip of a first cocktail, the clinking of glasses with the girls, the sexy soundtrack on the dance floor.This EDP opens with bright and sparkling top notes of Red Berries, blended with a citrus cocktail. A delicate heart of Sweet Pea and Rose complements rich and sensual base notes of White Musk and Sandalwood. Top Note: Red Berries. Heart Notes: Sweet Pea and Rose. Base Notes: White Musk and Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Le Parfum Him Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Le Parfum Him Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an intense, charismatic EDP that radiates confidence and masculinity. This bold fragrance is a theatrical masterpiece, designed to captivate and leave the audience yearning for more.Starting with the invigorating top note of Geranium, Scandal Pour Homme immediately grabs attention. The heart of the fragrance features a sensual Tonka Bean, adding a provocative and smooth contrast. As it settles, the deep and robust base note of Sandalwood ensures a lasting, triumphant impression. The perfume is housed in a captivating, blacked-out bottle, adorned with a flamboyant gold crown that amplifies its 'King of the Ring' status. Top Notes: Geranium. Heart Notes: Tonka Bean. Base Notes: Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau D'Issey Pour Femme Eau De Parfum Refill 75ml
listings.description: Issey Miyake L'Eau D'Issey Pour Femme Eau De Parfum Refill (75ml) is a sensual, floral EDP for women which is both distinctive and timeless.Evoking a drop of fresh, crystal-clear water on a woman's skin, this sunny, aquatic scent is enhanced by a bouquet of sweet, sun kissed flowers and a woody trail. The slender bottle depicts the shape of a drop of water. Top Notes: Rose and Lotus. Heart Notes: Lily and Sun Drenched Flowers. Base Notes: Precious Woods.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Man Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Jimmy Choo Man Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a woody, aromatic fragrance for men. Man Eau De Toilette was the first male fragrance released by the iconic fashion house Jimmy Choo, and remains a classic fragrance to this day.Top notes of Lavender and Mandarin are complimented by fruity notes of Honeydew Melon. The scent develops into a spicy heart of Pink Pepper and Geranium softened by a sweet hint of Pineapple Leaf. Finally, the fragrance reveals a bed of long-lasting Patchouli, Suede and Ambery Wood. The fragrance is housed in a simplistic, steel grey bottle which emanates quiet sophistication. Top Notes: Lavender, Mandarin and Honeydew Melon. Heart Notes: Pink Pepper, Geranium, and Pineapple Leaf. Base Notes: Patchouli, Suede and Ambery Woods.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss In Motion Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Hugo Boss In Motion Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a pure oriental scent made up of a blend of spicy essential oils and refreshing yet manly woody notes. This EDT is an energetic and sensual fragrance, ideal for all-occasion wear.The fragrance opens with fruity top noes of Mandarin, Orange, Basil, Violet Leaf and Bergamot, before developing into a warming and particularly spicy heart of Nutmeg, Cinnamon, Pink Pepper and Cardamom. It then slowly dries to reveal a trailing scent of Sandalwood, Musk and Vetiver. Top Notes: Mandarin, Orange, Basil, Violet Leaf and Bergamot. Heart Notes: Nutmeg, Cinnamon, Pink Pepper and Cardamom. Base Notes: Sandalwood, Musk and Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Flash Eau De Parfum 60ml
listings.description: Jimmy Choo Flash Eau De Parfum (60ml) is a floral and slightly fruity EDP for women, launched in 2013. It was created as a fragrance which accentuates delicate white flower notes - an ultra-feminine blend created for the refined extrovert. A master of making an entrance, this delightful fragrance is her perfect accessory. Her presence captivates, her scent invigorates.Top notes encompass bright Strawberry blended with sweet Tangerine and Pink Pepper. The heat is a vast bouquet of white florals, composing Tuberose, Jasmine and White Lily. This culminates in a strong base of Heliotrope and Blond Wood. Top Notes: Strawberry, Tangerine and Pink Pepper. Heart Notes: Tuberose, Jasmine, and White Lily. Base Notes: Heliotrope and Blond Wood.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Flash Eau De Parfum 100ml

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Eau De Parfum 40ml
listings.description: Jimmy Choo Eau De Parfum (40ml) is a modern, fruity EDP with warm, rich, woody depths. It is a fragrance inspired by modern women - strong, empowered, beautiful, seductive, and alluring with a mysterious sense of confident sexuality.Opening with luminous green top notes full of glittering radiance, the heart of rich and exotic Tiger Orchid lends a creamy seductiveness to the fragrance. Lingering sensual base notes of Sweet Toffee mingle with Indonesian Patchouli to leave a subtle, sensual memory on the skin. The amber bottle was inspired by Venetian Murano glass, whilst a snakeskin design decorates the outer box. Top Notes: Sweet Italian Orange. Heart Notes: Tiger Orchid. Base Notes: Sweet Toffee and Indonesian Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Just Different Eau De Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Hugo Boss Just Different Eau De Toilette (75ml) is an invigorating, fruity fragrance for the man who takes inspiration from everything around him, seeing the world from a different perspective.Refreshing Mint Leaves open the composition, leading to a heart of Freesia and Basil. This culminates in a base composed of Cashmeran and musky, woody spices. This EDT is presented in a sleek black flask with a strapped-on cap, ideal for men on the move. Top Notes: Mint and Granny Smith Apple. Heart Notes: Basil, Freesia and Coriander. Base Notes: Cashmeran, Patchouli, Olibanum and Labdanum.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo L'Eau Eau De Toilette 40ml
listings.description: Jimmy Choo L'Eau Eau De Toilette (40ml) combines floral, fresh, and musky notes, softly caressing the skin with a delicate breath which evokes a powerful, radiant femininity.L'Eau has a floral and fruity heart which exposes the essence of the delicious Hibiscus flower, softly blended with sweet fruity notes partnered with a woody depth. This EDT evokes a seductive sweetness and glowing sensuality captured in an irresistible design. Top Notes: Hibiscus Flower and Bergamot. Heart Notes: Nectarine and Peony. Base Notes: Cedarwood and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Floral Eau De Toilette 90ml
listings.description: Jimmy Choo Floral Eau De Toilette (90ml) is a floral, fruity, and musky EDT which gracefully evokes the pleasures of springtime in the city, parks and pavements alive as Nature explodes into bloom.The texture of each flower petal is almost tangible, subtle yet luminous, sophisticated yet urban, a radiant expression of femininity and a symphony of floral, fruity and musky notes. The slender, cocoon-shaped bottle is dressed in a subtle pale green lacquer, topped with a matching cube-shaped cap with modernist silver edging. Top Notes: Bergamot and Nectarine. Heart Notes: Magnolia and Sweet Pea. Base Notes: Ambroxan and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Illicit Flower Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Jimmy Choo Illicit Flower Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a flirtatious EDT for a mischievous and mesmerising woman.Adding a new twist to the original Rose accord that intuitively exudes an air of femininity, juicy Apricot and zesty Mandarin have been crushed over the floral heart notes of Grapefruit Flower and Jasmine to create a fresh, sparkling scent which springs off the skin and into the atmosphere. The bottle has been engraved like a jewel with many facets, making it a work of art in itself. The square silver cap adds a modern touch to the bottle. Top Notes: Apricot, Mandarin and Freesia. Heart Notes: Grapefruit Flower, Jasmine, Rose and Musk. Base Notes: Cashmeran and Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Rose Passion Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Jimmy Choo Rose Passion Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a floral EDP for women which depicts a free-spirited woman living and loving life on her own terms.Opening with the rich exotic fragrant combination of Frangipani and Jasmine, the composition leads on to a heart where the freshness of Coconut Milk meets the heady seduction of Orchids. This culminates in a seductive, earthy and woody base of Vanilla and Sandalwood. The pink, jewel-like bottle reflects the character of the wearer with its sense of playfulness, overt glamour, empowerment and allure. Top Notes: Frangipani and Jasmine. Heart Notes: Coconut Milk and Orchid. Base Notes: Vanilla and Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Classique Eau De Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Jean Paul Gaultier Classique Eau De Toilette (50ml) stands as one of the most iconic fragrances of all time, truly reflecting the multifaceted beauty of femininity. This classic and popular EDT for women is not only revered for its Jean Paul Gaultier signature bottle but also for its beautiful amber scent. The reassuring floral ambery note of Orange Blossom harmoniously blends with the powerful yet aromatic fragrance of Ginger, softened by the inclusion of sweet, earthy Vanilla, creating a divine and timeless scent perfect for everyday use.The bottle is a celebration of female beauty, characterised by generous curves that are as unexpected as they are attractive. An ode to feminine allure, it features the quintessential item in Jean Paul Gaultier's female wardrobe - the corset, a symbol of seduction and extreme sensuality, etched on the transparent glass, enhancing the experience of the perfume with a touch of elegance and seduction. Top Notes: Rose & Anise. Heart Notes: Orange Blossom & Ginger. Base Notes: Vanilla & Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Eau De Toilette 60ml
listings.description: Jimmy Choo Eau De Toilette (60ml) is a modern, fruity, floral fragrance with sensual woody depths, evoking a dazzling aura of glittering femininity. Glamorous in attitude, confident, intelligent and with a sense of fashion and fun, the EDT opens with bursts of fresh Ginger, Pear and Green Accords. Exotic Tiger Orchid lends creamy tones to the heart, complimented by Tea Rose for a seductive and floral aura. The base consists of Vibrant Woods - helping to develop a long-lasting and distinct aroma. Top Notes: Pear, Green Accords, and Ginger. Heart Notes: Tea Rose and Exotic Tiger Orchid. Base Notes: Vibrant Woods.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has A Gun Ego Stratis Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Juliette Has A Gun Ego Stratis Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a fresh aquatic citrus EDP that celebrates fluidity, individuality and self-expression. Designed as a contemporary twist on the classic cologne, it blurs the boundaries between feminine and masculine, creating a scent that feels light, modern and effortlessly confident.The composition opens with a sparkling cocktail of Bergamot, Mandarin and Lemon Essences, bursting with invigorating brightness. At its heart, Neroli, Calone and Blueberry form an airy marine accord, evoking sea spray and open horizons. The dry-down reveals a clean, sensual base of Cedarwood, Ambroxan and Musk, leaving a refined, lasting freshness on the skin. Ego Stratis is an ode to freedom and identity, perfect for those who embrace every side of themselves. Top Notes: Bergamot Essence, Mandarin Essence and Lemon Essence. Heart Notes: Neroli Essence, Calone and Blueberry. Base Notes: Cedar Essence, Ambroxan and Musks.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein One Shock For Her Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Calvin Klein One Shock For Her Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a bold and captivating EDT for women.It opens with a vibrant bouquet of Passion Flower, Pink Peony, and Jewelled Poppy Flower, creating an alluring first impression. The heart intensifies with notes of Blackberry, Jasmine, and Narcisse Flower, enhanced by a rich Liquid Chocolate Accord. The fragrance finishes with warm Amber, sweet Vanillin, earthy Patchouli, and soft Musk, leaving an addictive and magnetic trail. Top Notes: Passion Flower, Pink Peony and Jewelled Poppy Flower. Heart Notes: Blackberry, Jasmine, Narcisse Flower and Liquid Chocolate Accord. Base Notes: Amber, Vanillin, Patchouli and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Neroli Portofino Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Tom Ford Neroli Portofino Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a sparkling citrus aromatic EDP for men and women which takes its inspiration from the opulence and glamour of Portofino, a luxury resort town on the Italian Riviera.Conveying the invigorating cool breezes, sparkling waters and lush foliage of the Italian Mediterranean, the composition features zesty citrus oils, fragrant floralcy and amber undertones to leave an effervescent impression. Neroli's delicious harmony of floral and citrus sits firmly at the heart of the composition which opens with the zest of Mandarin, Lemon and Bergamot. Aromatic Lavender and Orange Flower blend with Tunisian Neroli in the heart before the scent culminates in the pungency of Rosemary warmed by exotic Musk. The fragrant liquid is housed in a translucent turquoise glass bottle which portrays the azure Mediterranean waters off the coast of Portofino. Top Notes: Italian Bergamot, Winter Yellow Mandarin and Sicilian Lemon. Heart Notes: Tunisian Neroli, Orange Flower and Lavender. Base Notes: Amber and Rosemary.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Oud Wood Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Tom Ford Oud Wood Eau De Parfum (30ml) is a vibrant oriental woody EDP for men which overwhelms the senses with the dark, earthy sensuality of its rare Oud notes.Combining exotic woods and spices in a distinctive, earthy composition, the scent opens with the warm sensuality of Rosewood and Cardamom, leading on to a smoky melange of precious Oud notes, Sandalwood and Vetiver. Complexity is added in the form of multifaceted, warm and spicy Tonka Bean and exotic Amber. Seductive and intoxicating, this fragrance perfectly conveys the enigmatic confidence of Tom Ford man. The fragrant liquid of Oud Wood is housed in a smoked grey bottle which took its inspiration from the architectural lines of a chess piece. Top Notes: Rosewood and Cardamom. Heart Notes: Oud, Sandalwood and Vetiver. Base Notes: Tonka Bean and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Perfect Elixir Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Marc Jacobs Perfect Elixir Eau De Parfum (30ml) reimagines the original Perfect eau de parfum with a luxurious and comforting blend of sweet and opulent aromas. Designed to inspire positivity and self-love, this captivating EDP celebrates the idea of being perfect just as you are.The scent opens with the vibrant sweetness of Purple Rhubarb, complemented by the delicate floral charm of Orange Blossom. As it evolves, rich Amber Woods and earthy Patchouli add depth and sophistication, while creamy Vanilla Bean Extract provides a luscious and indulgent finish. The bottle, crafted from soft pink-hued glass, combines modern elegance with youthful whimsy. Its curved rectangular shape is topped with a playful cap adorned with eclectic trinkets, reflecting the spirit of individuality and charm. Top Notes: Purple Rhubarb. Heart Notes: Orange Blossom. Base Notes: Amber Woods, Patchouli and Vanilla Bean Extract.

listings.rawTitle: Dior Sauvage Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Dior Sauvage Eau De Parfum (30ml) is inspired by the desert at twilight, a magical hour when the coolness of the night meets the warmth of the desert air, creating profound, captivating scents. This fragrance captures the essence of that moment, a time when the sky is set ablaze and wild instincts are unleashed.Sauvage EDP opens with the vibrant freshness of Calabrian Bergamot, offering a whirlwind of juicy, spicy zest that radiates energy. This is followed by the deep sensuality of Papua New Guinean Vanilla Extract, an irresistibly smoky and virile note that adds complexity and warmth. Together, they create a noble and powerful trail that lingers, embodying the raw beauty of nature. Top Notes: Calabrian Bergamot. Heart Notes: Spicy Facets. Base Notes: Papua New Guinean Vanilla Extract.

listings.rawTitle: Dior Miss Dior Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Dior Miss Dior Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a vibrant floral fragrance that embodies optimism and elegance, reflecting the very essence of Miss Dior.This sparkling scent is composed like a bouquet of countless flowers, radiating with luminous colours. At its heart, an iridescent Centifolia Rose is crafted to shine amidst a myriad of fresh floral notes, while a base of Tender Woods adds warmth and sophistication. Presented with the iconic Miss Dior couture bow, an artisanal creation that transforms each embroidered ribbon into a unique piece of haute couture, this fragrance is a tribute to timeless elegance. Top Notes: Floral Bouquet. Heart Notes: Centifolia Rose. Base Notes: Tender Woods.

listings.rawTitle: Dior J'adore Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Dior J'adore Eau De Parfum (100ml) is the quintessential feminine floral fragrance crafted as a luxurious bouquet of the most exquisite flowers sourced from around the world.The composition opens with the elegant and fruity floral notes of Ylang-Ylang Essence from the Comoros, adding a radiant and original touch. At its heart lies the essence of Damask Rose, harvested from Turkey, which blooms with its rich, soft sweetness. listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Tobacco Vanille Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Tom Ford Tobacco Vanille Eau De Parfum (50ml) is an oriental spicy EDP for women and men which seeks to replicate the classic, warm aromas which emanate within the typical London private members club.Opening with an iconic combination of Spicy Notes and heady Tobacco Leaf, the composition moves on to a heart where the creamy sensuality of Vanilla, Cacao and Tonka Bean meets the delicacy of Tobacco Blossom. This culminates powerfully in the base with Dried Fruits joining Woody Notes to accentuate the opulence. Top Notes: Tobacco Leaf and Spicy Notes. Heart Notes: Vanilla, Cacao, Tonka Bean and Tobacco Blossom. Base Notes: Dried Fruits and Woody Notes.

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Fabulous Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Tom Ford Fabulous Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a sophisticated leather EDP for men and women with an intoxicating melange of charming, debonair aromatic notes and deep Leather chords. The composition opens with the fusion of vibrant Clary Sage and fragrant Lavender which commands the attention. This leads on to a rich heart introducing Leather to the mix, infused with Bitter Almond and sensual Vanilla and intensified by floral Orris Accord. This culminates in a base where the Leather notes are augmented whilst Tonka Bean, Amber undertones and White Woods generate a warm glow. Top Notes: Lavender and Clary Sage. Heart Notes: Leather, Bitter Almond, Vanilla and Orris. Base Notes: Leather, Tonka Bean, Cashmeran, White Woods and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Valentina Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Valentino Valentina Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an oriental floral EDP for women with a composition which captures the spirit of modern femininity, bold, free, and unapologetically playful. This leads on to a heart of Geranium, warm Cinnamon, soothing Lavender and luxurious Agarwood, the melange lending a textured complexity, balancing freshness with richness. This culminates in base notes of Guaiac Wood, sensual Vanilla and the intriguing sweetness of Cypriol creating a lingering and irresistible allure. The fragrant liquid is housed in an elegant, midnight blue bottle which reflects the refinement and sophistication of its composition. It is decorated with a coat of arms depicting the sculpture of horses commissioned for the Chateau de Marly in 1743 by Louis XV. Top Notes: Bergamot, Grapefruit and Apple. Heart Notes: Geranium, Cinnamon, Lavender and Agarwood Base Notes: Cypriol, Guaiac Wood, Patchouli and Vanilla.

Top Notes: Rhubarb, Lychee and Bergamot Essence. Heart Notes: Damascena Rose and Vanilla. Base Notes: Cashmeran, Musk and Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Parfums de Marly Haltane Eau De Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Parfums de Marly Haltane Eau De Parfum (75ml) is a woody aromatic EDP for men which exudes a masterful blend of radiance and shadow, embodying the elegance of 18th-century French perfume traditions with a contemporary twist.The composition opens with a dazzling burst of Bergamot, Lavender and Clary Sage, evoking a refreshing and herbal top accord which is both invigorating and refined. This brightness gives way to an opulent heart where the warmth of Cedarwood and the indulgent sweetness of Praline embrace the rich depth of Oudwood, elevated by a touch of Saffron. The base unfolds with a sensual and enduring blend of Patchouli, Vetiver and Musk, grounded by the richness of Leather and the natural elegance of Agarwood. This final veil of contrasts leaves an unforgettable imprint, enveloping the wearer in luminous refinement and timeless sophistication. The fragrant liquid is housed in an elegant sage green bottle which reflects the refinement and sophistication of its composition. It is decorated with a coat of arms depicting the sculpture of horses commissioned for the Chateau de Marly in 1743 by Louis XV. Top Notes: Bergamot, Lavender and Clary Sage. Heart Notes: Saffron, Cedarwood, Praline and Oudwood. Base Notes: Patchouli, Vetiver, Musk, Leather and Natural Agarwood.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss The Scent For Her Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Hugo Boss The Scent For Her Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a symphony of seduction, crafted meticulously under the artistic direction of Jason Wu. Designed to evoke a hidden seductive power that envelops the wearer in a captivating allure, it narrates a tale of attraction, seduction, and addictive passion through its irresistibly potent combination of ingredients. Representing the powerful yet distinctly feminine BOSS woman, this fragrance offers a journey from initial attraction to an undeniable addiction.At first contact, your senses are greeted by a head-turning duo of Honeyed Peach and Freesia, setting a delicate yet enticing prelude to the rich narrative that unfolds. The journey into seduction deepens with the warm and sophisticated heart note of Osmanthus Flower, revealing a hidden power beneath its initial light allure. This elegantly intertwines with a darker, headier quality, driving the perfume's innate seductive prowess. As the narrative reaches its climax, the perfume unveils a base note of roasted Cocoa, offering an addictive boost that arouses the senses even further. This final note seals the captivating story, leaving an irresistible trail that symbolizes a powerful connection, a chemistry that sees both the wearer and the one she seduces succumbing to the potent allure of BOSS The Scent For Her. Top Notes: Honeyed Peach and Freesia Bloom. Heart Notes: Osmanthus Flower. Base Notes: Roasted Cocoa.

Top Notes: Lily of the Valley, Bergamot and Lemon. Heart Notes: Green Notes, Rose, Jasmine, Black Currant and Peach. Base Notes: Akigalawood and White Musk.

The base lingers with opulent notes of Madagascar Vanilla Caviar, velvety Brown Sugar, Tonka Bean and resinous Benzoin. Top Notes: Buttery Toffee and Arabica Coffee. Heart Notes: Walnut Pastry, Date Milk, Vanilla and Cardamom. Base Notes: Madagascar Vanilla Caviar, Brown Sugar, Benzoin, Tonka Bean, Musk and Woods.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Insolence Eau De Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Guerlain Insolence Eau De Toilette (75ml) is a floral oriental EDT which embodies the essence of bold femininity and unyielding passion. Designed for the woman who embraces spontaneity, radiates confidence, and moves through life with the poise of a conqueror, this fragrance becomes her signature of irresistible allure. Floral, fruity and powdery, Insolence is a symphony of captivating notes where the wild sweetness of Strawberry mingles with an intoxicating overdose of Violet, the sensual elegance of Iris and the luminous warmth of Orange Blossom. The iconic 'inverted heart' bottle is a work of art, adorned with graceful Art Nouveau scrolls which underline its romantic spirit. The avant-garde stopper, shaped like a hollowed heart, mirrors the delicate yet bold nature of the fragrance itself. Top Notes: Violet. Heart Notes: Iris, Red Fruits and Orange Blossom. Base Notes: Tonka Bean, Vanilla and Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentleman Reserve Privee Eau De Parfum 60ml
listings.description: Givenchy Gentleman Reserve Privee Eau De Parfum (60ml) is an amber vanilla fragrance inspired by the exquisite notes of whiskey. Designed for the sophisticated man, this EDP represents timeless elegance, blending sophisticated floral notes with the richness of amber for a refined and captivating finish.The scent opens with the refreshing aroma of Bergamot, offering a sweet yet spicy introduction that invigorates the senses. As the fragrance unfolds, it reveals a heart of Iris and Chestnut, contributing to its depth and intensity. The base notes are enveloped in Amber and smoky Whisky, leaving an intoxicating and memorable scent trail. Top Notes: Bergamot. Heart Notes: Iris and Chestnut. Base Notes: Whisky, Amber and Woods.

listings.rawTitle: Swiss Arabian Shaghaf Tobacco 01 Extrait De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Swiss Arabian Shaghaf Tobacco Eau De Parfum (75ml) is an oriental woody EDP which has been created for those who seek an intoxicating sillage and a scent experience like no other.The composition opens with a modern twist on Tobacco, made sweeter and irresistibly inviting by luscious top notes of Plum, Apple and Honey. These are complemented by a smooth blend of spicy Pink Pepper and warm Labdanum, creating a vibrant opening which captivates the senses. As it unfolds, the heart reveals a sophisticated blend of Amber, Ylang Ylang and Patchouli, adding depth and an exotic allure to the composition. Finally, the base delivers a rich and opulent finish, with the warm embrace of Musk, Cashmere, Honey, Vanilla, Sandalwood and Tobacco, leaving a lingering impression of elegance and sensuality. Top Notes: Plum, Apple, Cumin, Pink Pepper and Liquorice. Heart Notes: Labdanum, Amber, Ylang Ylang and Patchouli. Base Notes: Musk, Cashmere, Honey, Vanilla, Sandalwood and Tobacco.

listings.rawTitle: Swiss Arabian Shaghaf Oud Ahmar Eau De Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Swiss Arabian Shaghaf Oud Ahmar Eau De Parfum (75ml) is a warm, woody, and ambery gourmand EDP created to captivate and enchant. More than simply a scent, this is an experience which lingers in the memory, a statement of elegance and a journey of sensory indulgence.The fragrance opens with a burst of radiance, combining sparkling Bergamot and crisp Green Notes to evoke the serenity of a tranquil dawn. At its heart lies a melange of fruits with succulent Melon, juicy Apple and luscious Pineapple infusing the composition with a carefree, joyous vibrancy. As it settles, Shaghaf Oud Ahmar reveals a sumptuous base of golden Vanilla, exquisite woods and soft powdery Musks, creating an unforgettable signature which exudes sophistication and refined elegance. Top Notes: Bergamot, Iris, Freesia, Melon and Peach. Heart Notes: Tonka, Amber, Apple and Rose. Base Notes: Cedarwood, Sandalwood, Amber, Vanilla, Powdery Musk and Oud.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Le Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Le Parfum (50ml) offers a bold and enigmatic fragrance experience designed for the modern man.This unique scent opens with the energising zest of Grapefruit and the electrifying notes of Hemp, setting a dynamic tone. The heart layers in aromatic Geranium and spicy Black Pepper, adding a complex and seductive twist. Anchoring the fragrance, the base unfolds with the warm sensuality of Leather and the earthy depth of Vetiver, creating a lasting impression. This fragrance is an invitation to embrace the unexpected and celebrate the multifaceted nature of masculinity. Top Notes: Grapefruit and Hemp. Heart Notes: Geranium and Black Pepper. Base Notes: Leather and Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Cobalt Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Cobalt Eau De Parfum (100ml) captures the essence of modern masculinity with an electrifying new twist, reflecting the dual nature inherent in every Bad Boy fragrance. Celebrating the bond of brotherhood and the strength symbolised by the vibrant hue of cobalt, this fragrance is a dynamic blend of energy and elegance.It opens with fresh, aromatic Pink Pepper, leading into a masculine heart of Geranium. The base unfolds with a unique Truffle Accord, enriched with smoky Oakwood, ethically sourced Vetiver, and seductive Cedarwood, creating a complex and invigorating scent that embodies confidence and the belief that anything is possible with trusted friends by your side. Top Notes: Pink Pepper. Heart Notes: Geranium. Base Notes: Truffle Accord, Oakwood, Vetiver and Cedarwood.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Pour Femme Eau De Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Lacoste Pour Femme Eau De Parfum (90ml) is a floral woody EDP that captures the free spirit and elegance of modern women.The scent opens with the fresh vibrancy of Freesia, accented by the warm spice of Black Pepper. At its heart, a feminine floral bouquet of Jasmine, Heliotrope, and Rose adds a touch of softness and allure. The base completes the composition with the rich warmth of Cedarwood and Suede, offering structure and sophistication. Presented in a sleek, slender bottle symbolising contemporary femininity, this fragrance is a timeless tribute to grace and strength. Top Notes: Freesia, Black Pepper. Heart Notes: Jasmine, Heliotrope, Rose. Base Notes: Cedarwood, Suede.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste L.12.12 Blanc Men Eau De Toilette 175ml
listings.description: Lacoste L.12.12 Blanc Men Eau De Toilette (175ml) is a clean, refreshing fragrance that embodies modern masculinity and energy.This EDT opens with the invigorating citrus brightness of Grapefruit, paired with the warm spice of Cardamom. At its heart, a captivating blend of Ylang Ylang and Tuberose adds a touch of sweetness and allure. The scent concludes with the refined combination of Vetiver and Suede, creating a smooth and elegant finish. Top Notes: Grapefruit and Cardamom. Heart Notes: Ylang Ylang and Tuberose. Base Notes: Vetiver and Suede.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Le Parfum 100ml
