Base Notes: Leather and Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Parfums de Marly Layton Eau De Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Parfums de Marly Layton Eau De Parfum (75ml) is an amber fougere EDP for men which constitutes a celebration of timeless elegance and contemporary flair, designed for those who live boldly and leave a lasting impression.The composition opens with a burst of tangy Bergamot, crisp Apple and aromatic Lavender, setting the stage for a fresh yet refined introduction. The heart blooms with a harmonious blend of Jasmine, velvety Violet and elegant Geranium, embodying a chic and chivalrous spirit. This lingering melange deepens into a luxurious base of creamy Vanilla, spiced Pepper and earthy Patchouli, enhanced by the rich warmth of Guaiac Wood. A hint of caramelised Coffee adds a surprising touch of intrigue, making Layton both distinguished and irresistibly addictive. The fragrant liquid is housed in an elegant midnight blue bottle which reflects the refinement and sophistication of its composition. It is decorated with a coat of arms depicting the sculpture of horses commissioned for the Chateau de Marly in 1743 by Louis XV. Top Notes: Apple, Bergamot and Lavender. Heart Notes: Jasmine, Violet and Geranium. Base Notes: Vanilla, Pepper, Guaiac Wood and Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden White Tea Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Elizabeth Arden White Tea Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a refined EDP inspired by the simple joys and quiet pleasures of life. This deeper concentration of the beloved White Tea scent is crafted by master perfumers using exquisite ingredients and enhanced with VivaScentz technology, which harmonises key White Tea notes...

listings.rawTitle: Parfums de Marly Valaya Eau De Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Parfums de Marly Valaya Eau De Parfum (75ml) is a floral, musky, woody EDP for women which is an ode to the sensation of soft cotton brushing against the skin. Radiant yet delicately enveloping, this timeless blend of contrasts and subtleties immerses you in its ethereal embrace.The composition unveils a luminous opening with the zesty brilliance of Bergamot, Mandarin and the delicate sweetness of White Peach. This leads on to a heart where a bouquet of white flowers, Orange Blossom and aquatic Nympheal, melds seamlessly with earthy Vetiver, creating a sophisticated and balanced floral core. This culminates in a sensual and modern base where creamy Musk, warm Ambrofix and the spicy elegance of Akigalawood form a captivating trail. Top Notes: Bergamot, Mandarin and White Peach. Heart Notes: Orange Flower, Nympheal and Vetiver. Base Notes: Akigalawood, Ambrofix and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Parfums de Marly Delina Eau De Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Parfums de Marly Delina Eau De Parfum (75ml) is a floral rose, woody EDP for women comprising a harmonious blend of bright, floral, and woody accords, perfect for the modern sophisticate who appreciates both elegance and edge.The composition opens with a sparkling medley of Rhubarb, Lychee and Bergamot Essence, offering a tart and juicy freshness which instantly intrigues. As the scent evolves, the creamy sweetness of Vanilla interlaces with radiant Rose, evoking a luxurious sensuality. At its heart, the scent unfurls a lavish bouquet of Damascena Rose, Lily of the Valley and Peony, creating a delicate yet powerful floral statement. This culminates with depth and mystery in the base with the warmth of Cashmeran, the powdery softness of Musk and the earthy richness of Vetiver. Cedarwood and a touch of Incense lend a smoky, woody finish, making this fragrance as unforgettable as it is irresistible. The fragrant liquid is housed in an elegant light pink bottle with fabric neck tassel which reflects the refinement and sophistication of its composition. Top Notes: Rhubarb, Lychee and Bergamot Essence. Heart Notes: Damascena Rose and Vanilla. Base Notes: Cashmeran, Musk and Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Boss Femme Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Hugo Boss Boss Femme Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a gentle, ultra-feminine women's fragrance that envelopes you in a silky veil of elegance. As part of the iconic fashion house's extensive collection of scents, this women's EDP was designed to underline sensuality and emphasise natural charm with an aroma that's suitable for day wear or spring and summer months.The refreshingly radiant scent opens with fruit notes that blend seamlessly into delicate florals before ending with bold musk and woody tones. The fragrance is packaged in a distinctly feminine pink bottle with an elaborately spaced clear top. Top Notes: Freesia, Tangerine and Blackcurrant. Heart Notes: Lily, Jasmine and Bulgarian Rose. Base Notes: Amber, Lemon Tree and Apricot.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Bottled Eau De Parfum 200ml
listings.description: Hugo Boss Bottled Eau De Parfum (200ml) redefines the essence of modern masculinity.Bold and unabashed, this EDP captivates from the outset with enticing notes of crisp Apple, zesty Bergamot, and vibrant Black Pepper. These initial scents exude confidence and a genuine sense of self, inviting you to manifest your true identity. Journeying to its heart, the perfume reveals a warm embrace of Chestnut, invigorating Cardamom, and spirited Cinnamon, painting an image of comfort and steadfastness, striking a harmonious chord between strength and dependability. Every spritz serves as a testament to the multifaceted layers of human nature, urging one to embrace them all. The scent, crafted from natural ingredients, promises a robust and commanding presence. Encased in a timeless bottle, it stands as an undeniable focal point in any setting. Top Notes: Apple, Bergamot, Black Pepper. Heart Notes: Chestnut, Cardamom, Cinnamon. Base Notes: Vetiver, Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Bottled Eau De Toilette 30ml
listings.description: Hugo Boss Bottled Eau De Toilette (30ml) encapsulates the luxury brand's original fragrance that encourages modern men to express themselves through their actions. The men's scent carries elegant, woody accords of the classic fragrance that reflect confidence, versatility and a distinctive contrast of aromas.The men's fragrance remains as relevant and contemporary now as it was when first launched as a symbol of masculinity 20 years ago. Comes packaged in an iconic bottle embossed with the brand's name and bookended by matte metal. Top Notes: Apple, Lemon Bergamot, Oakmoss and Plum. Heart Notes: Geranium, Cinnamon, Carnation and Mahogany. Base Notes: Cedar, Vetiver, Vanilla, Olive Tree and Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss The Scent for Her Le Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Hugo Boss The Scent for Her Le Parfum (50ml) channels the essence of powerful attraction, redefining the iconic ambery signature of the Boss The Scent. This intense reinterpretation awakens the senses with a provocative blend of Orange Blossom and Vetiver Accord, crafting an irresistible alchemy of attraction.The fragrance starts with a fiery spark of Pink Peppercorn, which contrasts beautifully with the central note of Orange Blossom, setting a passionate stage for the unfolding narrative. The warmth of Vetiver merges seamlessly with the airy notes of Akigalawood in the base, enhancing the fragrance's inherent sensuality and depth. Encased in a jewel-shaped bottle adorned with elegant plum lacquering and a light-reflecting cap in precious rose gold, Hugo Boss The Scent for Her Le Parfum is presented in a deep plum box, elevating the act of seduction to a new dimension. Top Notes: Pink Pepper. Heart Notes: Orange Blossom. Base Notes: Vetiver, Akigalawood.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Signature Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Montblanc Signature Eau De Parfum (30ml) is an amber, floral EDP for women, reflecting creativity and a holiday spirit. It effectively contrasts opulent and sensual Vanilla with the clean characteristic of White Musk.The fresh fruity opening of Clementine at the top combines sensually with a floral heart of Magnolia and Ylang Ylang. The opalescent bottle with gold detail and white lacquering on the inside pays tribute to the iconic inkwell, part of Montblanc's heritage. Top Notes: Clementine. Heart Notes: Ylang-Ylang, Magnolia and Peony. Base Notes: Vanilla, White Musk and Benzoin.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Blush Elixir Eau De Parfum 80ml
listings.description: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Blush Elixir Eau De Parfum (80ml) elevates the iconic series with a bold reinterpretation housed in the signature high-heel bottle. This intensified version of the beloved Good Girl Blush fragrance delves deeper into the essence of femininity with a more sensual approach. It opens with the bright, zesty notes of Bergamot and Mandarin, immediately captivating the senses. This vibrant start transitions into a heart of Ylang Ylang and a bouquet of Roses, weaving a narrative of passion and seduction. The base notes of Vanilla and Patchouli bring back the signature allure of the Good Girl collection, enveloping the scent in an air of mystery and elegance. The sophisticated pink stiletto bottle now features a daring black gradient and a striking gold high heel, adding a touch of glamour to any dressing table. Top Notes: Bergamot and Mandarin. Heart Notes: Ylang Ylang and Rose. Base Notes: Vanilla and Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne One Million Parfum 200ml
listings.description: Paco Rabanne 1 Million Parfum (200ml) is a floral leather men's fragrance that captures the essence of sun-drenched charm, pushing boundaries and playing with the senses. Intensely masculine, this parfum contrasts the duality of salty notes with the warmth of Leather. The amber heat enhances its sensuality, reminiscent of skin that's been kissed by the sun. 1 Million Parfum is not just addictive but also bold, exaggerated, and designed for those who dare to stand out in the crowd.The fragrance plays between the salty pulse of Salty Tuberose, Ambroxan, and Cashmeran, leading to the leathery opulence of Sun-drenched Leather and Citrus Resin. Housed in a 1 Million ingot bottle with extreme lines cut from glass and gold, it epitomises opulence and audacity. The golden hue shines with extreme radiance, capturing light and making its presence known, a true emblem sculpted in metal. Top Notes: Salty Tuberose, Ambroxan and Cashmeran. Heart Notes: Sun-drenched Leather and Citrus Resin. Base Notes: Amber Heat.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Invictus Victory Elixir Parfum Intense 100ml
listings.description: Paco Rabanne Invictus Victory Elixir Parfum Intense (100ml) embodies the ultimate expression of triumph, presenting a fragrance that speaks to those who push beyond their limits. This scent is for the bold and victorious, where intensity meets refinement. Invictus Victory Elixir is the essence of power magnified, a blend of spicy woods and sharp freshness.The olfactory journey begins with an invigorating burst of Fresh Aromatic Lavandin, energised by the crisp spiciness of Green Cardamom and Black Pepper. This vibrant introduction transitions smoothly into an intense heart, where rich Incense intertwines with earthy Indonesian Patchouli, creating a mysterious and masculine core. The journey concludes with a luxurious base where sweet Madagascan Vanilla Bean melds with the rich warmth of Tonka Bean Liqueur, leaving a lasting impression of opulent victory. The bottle itself is a celebration of victory, with its distinctive golden V emblem and trophy-inspired design, crowned with a lacquered finish that captures the richness of the elixir within. The prestigious vessel reflects both the power and prestige of the fragrance it contains. Top Notes: Fresh Aromatic Lavandin, Green Cardamom and Black Pepper. Heart Notes: Incense and Indonesian Patchouli. Base Notes: Madagascan Vanilla Bean and Tonka Bean Liqueur.

listings.rawTitle: Dior Pure Poison Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Dior Pure Poison Eau De Parfum (100ml) embodies the essence of seduction in its purest and most irresistible form. This enigmatic and captivating fragrance is a modern-day potion that unveils the seductress within and explores the duality of its ingredients, creating a delicate yet daring alchemy that is both sincere and mysterious.The composition begins with a sweet freshness of Calabrian Bergamot, a radiant citrus note derived from the cold expression of peel from southern Italy. This leads to the opulent heart of Orange Blossom, extracted from the flowers of the bitter orange tree, alongside Neroli, enhancing the fragrance with its rich, amber-scented floralcy. The journey culminates with a base of synthetic White Musk, providing a clean, skin-like backdrop that complements and reveals the depth of Pure Poison. Top Notes: Calabrian Bergamot. Heart Notes: Orange Blossom and Jasmine. Base Notes: White Musk, Amber and Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Olympea Eau De Parfum 80ml

listings.rawTitle: Dior Poison Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Dior Poison Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a floral ambery EDT for women with a sultry, seductive character, at once provocative and mysterious. It seeks to help women assert their femininity with confidence. The exceptional composition of this fragrance combines rich, spicy, floral and ambery notes with the sensual accords of Honey and Musk.The opening to this scent features aromatic Coriander with its fresh, peppery and zesty notes adding a captivating, mysterious aura. Tuberose in the heart brings highly fragrant floralcy whilst the base centres on the velvety, balsamic notes of Opoponax, a resinous gum sourced from a tree which grows in Africa and the Middle East. This variant of Myrrh lends the fragrance an enchanting mystery. Top Notes: Coriander and Wild Berries. Heart Notes: Orange Honey and Tuberose. Base Notes: Opopanax.

listings.rawTitle: Dior Hypnotic Poison Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Dior Hypnotic Poison Eau De Parfum (50ml) is an ambery EDP for women, inheriting the legacy of the enigmatic Poison series with a resolutely heady and bewitching aura. This scent is a magnet for desires, characterized by its intense, opulent fusion of contrasting elements that captivate and indulge the senses. At its core, Bitter Almond and lush Jasmine Sambac intertwine with the creamy, spicy warmth of Vanilla and the subtle eroticism of sensual Musks. The composition begins with the alluring sweetness of Venezuelan Tonka Beans, freshly picked and transformed into a powdery heart note that infuses the fragrance with its rich, warm aroma. The journey continues through a floral heart of Jasmine, symbolising softness and a staple in perfumery for its standalone, delicate fragrance. This leads to a voluptuous base where Vanilla, known for its sensual and spicy undertones, unfolds its soft blossoms. Top Notes: Tonka Bean. Heart Notes: Jasmine Sambac. Base Notes: Vanilla, Bitter Almond and Musk.

This leads on to a heart of Sandalwood before captivating with its base of mysterious Leather. The fragrant liquid is housed in the iconic 1 Million gold bar bottle with red accents mirroring crown jewels. Top Notes: Oud. Heart Notes: Sandalwood. Base Notes: Leather.

listings.rawTitle: Dior Miss Dior Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Dior Miss Dior Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a timeless green chypre floral fragrance and the very first creation by Christian Dior, embodying the perfection of the couturier's mark. Top Notes: Galbanum. Heart Notes: Sambac Jasmine and Grasse Rose Absolute. Base Notes: Patchouli Essence.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Invictus Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Paco Rabanne Invictus Parfum (50ml) is an aromatic, woody and intense fragrance for men which conveys an ascent to greatness with an epic hero reaching divine heights and creating his own legend.Fresh Lavender opens the composition, clashing with sensual Black Soap before the scent concludes with addictive Sandalwood in a deified olfactory elixir. The fragrant liquid is housed in the iconic Invictus bottle enhanced with a stronger, V-shaped silhouette and gold cap. Top Notes: Lavender. Heart Notes: Black Soap. Base Notes: Sandalwood.

Heart Notes: Leather, Black Pepper, Woody, Vetiver, Spices. Base Notes: Tonka Bean, Patchouli, Incense and Ebony Tree.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Boss Ma Vie Pour Femme Eau De Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Hugo Boss Boss Ma Vie Pour Femme Eau De Parfum (75ml) was inspired by the independent spirit of a woman as she pauses to indulge in the simple moments in life. In this moment, she is at her most captivating, exuding a glow of femininity and confidence.This EDP has been created around the Cactus Blossom, aiming to reinvent and modernise floral green notes with a delicate pink twist. Exceptional ingredients were carefully balanced, blending the green freshness of the Cactus Blossom with refined pink floral notes to enhance the composition's vivid luminosity. The addition of Cedarwood softly grounded the perfume without losing its captivating clarity. The result celebrates strength and femininity. Top Notes: Cactus Blossom. Heart Notes: Pink Floral Bouquet and Rose Bud. Base Notes: Cedarwood.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Twilly D'Hermes Eau De Parfum 85ml
listings.description: Hermes Twilly D'Hermes Eau De Parfum (85ml) encapsulates the essence of Hermes girls in a daring, vibrant fragrance, intertwining striking Ginger with sensual Tuberose in an artful blend that effortlessly radiates a floral, spicy, and oriental EDP. Christine Nagel, inspired by the free, bold, and connected young women, who live with a playful mischievousness and irreverent spirit, crafted Twilly d'Hermes. Observing their lives and their capability to challenge expectations, swim against prevailing currents, and invent a brand new tempo, Nagel composed a fragrance that mingles Ginger, Tuberose, and Sandalwood in a new, exhilarating way. These elements are combined distinctively to unfurl as a searing spice, a disconcerting attraction, and a revelation of the carnal. Each bottle is adorned with a hand-tied silk ribbon in a final flash of wit, ensuring every piece is uniquely charming. Top Notes: Ginger. Heart Notes: Tuberose. Base Notes: Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Twilly D'Hermes Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Hermes Twilly D'Hermes Eau De Parfum (50ml) encapsulates the essence of Hermes girls in a daring, vibrant fragrance, intertwining striking Ginger with sensual Tuberose in an artful blend that effortlessly radiates a floral, spicy, and oriental EDP.Christine Nagel, inspired by the free, bold, and connected young women, who live with a playful mischievousness and irreverent spirit, crafted Twilly d'Hermes. Observing their lives and their capability to challenge expectations, swim against prevailing currents, and invent a brand new tempo, Nagel composed a fragrance that mingles Ginger, Tuberose, and Sandalwood in a new, exhilarating way. These elements are combined distinctively to unfurl as a searing spice, a disconcerting attraction, and a revelation of the carnal. Each bottle is adorned with a hand-tied silk ribbon in a final flash of wit, ensuring every piece is uniquely charming. Top Notes: Ginger. Heart Notes: Tuberose. Base Notes: Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Iced Eau De Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Hugo Boss Iced Eau De Toilette (75ml) is an invigorating, woody and aromatic EDT which combines boundless energy and icy freshness in a scent which is perfect for the modern man.The invigorating top notes of Iced Mint Leaves stimulate the senses, while the scent of Wild Tea enlivens mind and spirit. This culminates in an intensely masculine base with the aromatic root of Indian Vetiver. A sleek chrome bottle with innovative strapped-on cap personifies the vibrant, icy freshness within. Top Notes: Iced Mint. Heart Notes: Frozen Wild Tea. Base Notes: Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau D'Issey Pour Femme Eau De Parfum 25ml
listings.description: Issey Miyake L'Eau D'Issey Pour Femme Eau De Parfum (25ml) is a sensual, floral EDP for women which is both distinctive and timeless.Evoking a drop of fresh, crystal-clear water on a woman's skin, this sunny, aquatic scent is enhanced by a bouquet of sweet, sun-kissed flowers and a woody trail. The slender bottle depicts the shape of a drop of water. Top Notes: Rose and Lotus. Heart Notes: Lily and Sun Drenched Flowers. Base Notes: Precious Woods.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Extreme Man Eau De Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Hugo Boss Man Extreme Eau De Parfum Spray (75ml) is a revitalised version of the iconic fashion house's original men's fragrance, released back in 1995. Distinguished by its unmistakably male scent, this men's Eau De Parfum carries a powerful blend that combines crisp top notes, herbal heart notes, and earthy base undertones.From the recognisably unique strapped bottle, Man Extreme is a bold and fresh scent that exudes confident masculinity - and regularly features in men's top fragrances lists. Top notes: Green Apple, Mint and Basil. Heart notes: Carnation and Sage. Base notes: Cedar Wood, Patchouli and Fir Resin.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Orange Woman Eau De Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Hugo Boss Woman Eau De Toilette (50ml) is a clean, fresh, and contemporary women's fragrance from the iconic fashion house's extensive collection of scents. This women's EDT was released in 2009, with actress Siena Miller as the brand's ambassador.Formulated as a fun and playful scent with a seductive edge, the oriental and spicy fragrance is suitable for everyday wear - evoking an eternally carefree attitude. Opening with notes of fresh fruit and herbs that blend with a heart of African Orange Flowers before leaving a lasting impression with woody undertones. Orange comes distinctly packaged in a glass column bottle with cube-like design and gentle orange colour. Top Notes: Red Apple, Bergamot and White Peach. Heart Notes: Incense, African Orange Flowers, Plum and Cinnamon. Base Notes: Sandalwood, Olive Tree and Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Bottled Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Hugo Boss Bottled Eau De Parfum (100ml) redefines the essence of modern masculinity.Bold and unabashed, this EDP captivates from the outset with enticing notes of crisp Apple, zesty Bergamot, and vibrant Black Pepper. These initial scents exude confidence and a genuine sense of self, inviting you to manifest your true identity. Journeying to its heart, the perfume reveals a warm embrace of Chestnut, invigorating Cardamom, and spirited Cinnamon, painting an image of comfort and steadfastness, striking a harmonious chord between strength and dependability. Every spritz serves as a testament to the multifaceted layers of human nature, urging one to embrace them all. The scent, crafted from natural ingredients, promises a robust and commanding presence. Encased in a timeless bottle, it stands as an undeniable focal point in any setting. Top Notes: Apple, Bergamot, Black Pepper. Heart Notes: Chestnut, Cardamom, Cinnamon. Base Notes: Vetiver, Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Jeans For Him Eau De Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Hugo Boss Jeans For Him Eau De Toilette (75ml) is a bold and breezy EDT, capturing the essence of fashion with its invigorating, multi-seasonal fragrance.This fragrance opens with fresh facets of Grapefruit and Lime, enriched by the cool breeze of Peppermint and the spicy touch of Juniper Berries. These initial notes magnetise the senses with irresistible energy from the first spritz. The heart unfolds into warm, woody layers, anchored by Sandalwood and Vetiver, creating a long-lasting trail that exudes confidence and style. The fragrance is housed in a matte denim flask, accented with the iconic red and black Hugo logo, reminiscent of Hugo Boss's classic jeans. Top Notes: Grapefruit and Lime. Heart Notes: Peppermint and Juniper. Base Notes: Sandalwood, Vetiver and Cedarwood.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty For Her Eau De Toilette 90ml
listings.description: Gucci Guilty For Her Eau De Toilette (90ml) is an amber floral EDT for women which depicts freedom and unconventional love with its notion of genuine liberation whilst radiating warmth and grace. The composition features a light, fresh Lilac Petal within a sparkling citrus opening followed by the signature fougere accord of Geranium and a trail of rich and sensual Amber notes and Patchouli.The scent opens with the flamboyant rush of Mandarin Orange and audacious Pink Pepper. This leads on to an alluring concoction in the heart where heady Lilac and Geranium meet the succulence of Peach, Raspberry and Blackcurrant for a beguiling touch of femininity. This culminates in a voluptuous base with Amber combining with earthy Patchouli, the hallmark of Gucci fragrances. The soft pink fragrance is housed in Gucci's signature tall and slender bottle with rose gold details. Its design replicates the silhouette of the corresponding men's fragrance, reflecting the equal standing of the sexes. Top Notes: Pink Pepper and Mandarin Orange. Heart Notes: Lilac, Peach, Jasmine, Raspberry, Geranium and Blackcurrant. Base Notes: White Musk, Amber, Patchouli and Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Mon Guerlain Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Guerlain Mon Guerlain Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an amber woody EDP for women which evokes a life lived full of experiences, enhanced by success and expertise, and resulting in a generosity of spirit. The composition opens with an overtly floral melange of French Lavender, grown in sunny Provence, with Bergamot, and leads on to a similarly floral heart of powdery Iris, Rose and Jasmine Sambac. This culminates in a complex, multifaceted base with the refreshing audacity of Vanilla Tahitensis blending with the earthiness of Sandalwood, Patchouli and Liquorice. The fragrant liquid is housed in a bottle enhanced by a luxurious glass weight and golden adornment, depicting femininity. Top Notes: Lavender and Bergamot. Heart Notes: Iris, Jasmine Sambac and Rose. Base Notes: Tahitian Vanilla, Coumarin, Australian Sandalwood, Liquorice, Benzoin and Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Bottled Unlimited Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Hugo Boss Bottled Unlimited Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a modern, energising fragrance for men, combining Mint, Pineapple and Evergreen Cistus.It reflects success in all areas of life, celebrating the boundless burst of fresh energy and the exhilarating confidence boost of achievement. The notes capture invigorating freshness, enduring energy and aromatic masculinity. Top Notes: Mint, Iced Violet Leaves and Grapefruit. Heart notes: Pineapple, Rose and Cinnamon. Base Notes: Cistus, Sandalwood and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Woman Extreme Eau De Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Hugo Boss Woman Extreme Eau De Parfum Spray (75ml) is an intensely floral women's fragrance with oriental scented undertones. The timeless perfume was released in 2006 and remains characterised by its revitalising freshness that embodies feminine confidence.The composition of the fragrance is an infusion of refreshing Black Tea with a bouquet of delicate flowers and fruit-laden accords. It's a sensual and sophisticated women's fragrance that captures both modern boldness and classic elegance - complimented by the subtle pink hue and circular bottle packaging. Top notes: Himalayan Grass and Boysenberry. Heart notes: Black Tea and Jasmine. Base notes: Osmanthus.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Woman Eau De Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Hugo Boss Woman Eau De Parfum (90ml) is an oriental woody EDP for women which is both captivating and feminine.The scent opens with an uplifting melange of Crispy Apple and Bergamot. The composition leads on to a subtle heart with White Flower, Plum and Orange Blossom generating a carefree, light-hearted and joyous feel. This culminates in depth and intensity in the base where earthy Sandalwood and creamy Vanilla generate sensuality. Top Notes: Crispy Apple and Bergamot. Heart Notes: Orange Flowers and Plums. Base Notes: Creamy Vanilla and Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Fever Eau De Parfum 60ml
listings.description: Jimmy Choo Fever Eau De Parfum (60ml) is an addictive, floral scent for a woman who is effortlessly seductive and in charge of her destiny.It opens with the rich yet vivid juicy sweetness of Plum, which is blended with the fresh rosy accents of Lychee and contrasts with the subtle bitter tones of Grapefruit. At its heart, the powdered roundness of Heliotrope mingles with exotic Vanilla Orchid and ultra-feminine Jasmine. It then evolves with base notes of creamy Sandalwood, the balsamic warmth of Benzoin and the roasted Almond facets of Tonka Bean, giving the fragrance its carnal velvet sensuality. Top Notes: Black Plum Nectar, Lychee and Grapefruit. Heart Notes: Heliotrope, Vanilla Orchid and Jasmine. Base Notes: Roasted Tonka Bean, Benzoin and Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Eau De Toilette 125ml
listings.description: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Eau De Toilette (125ml) is a woody aromatic EDT for men which radiates seductive, masculine sensuality with its elixir of temptation and attraction. The composition opens with the zesty freshness of Bergamot augmented by the vitality of Geranium, leading on to a heart of Coconut Woods which sees the wearer set sail for tropical destinations. The sweet addictiveness of Tonka Bean in the base commits him to the mercy of the four winds. The fragrant liquid is housed in a sexy bottle depicting a dream male physique with its slender figure and prominent muscles clad in a single vine leaf. Top Notes: Bergamot. Heart Notes: Coconut Woods. Base Notes: Tonka Bean.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Bottled Aftershave Splash 100ml
listings.description: Hugo Boss Bottled Aftershave Splash (100ml) is a fresh, fruity, and slightly spicy aftershave that has celebrated ten years of success since its launch. This masculine, inviting fragrance features bold top notes of Apple, pleasantly complimented by a spiced heart of Geranium and Cinnamon. The aftershave settles on a bed of sensual woods like Cedar, Vetiver, Olive Tree and Sandalwood. A signature scent for any modern, sophisticated man. This splash is formulated to hydrate your skin and prevent damage caused by shaving. Top Notes: Apple. Heart Notes: Geranium and Cinnamon. Base Notes: Cedar, Vetiver, Vanilla, Olive Tree and Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Guy Laroche Fidji Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Guy Laroche Fidji Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a feminine, exotic and evocative, floral EDT for women which takes its inspiration from the beautiful islands of the South Pacific. Its olfactory composition evokes the warm fragrant breezes of a tropical island full of flowers.This fragrance opens with a vibrant melange of floral components including balsamic Galbanum, sweet and powdery Hyacinth, Iris and Tuberose. This leads on to a heart which continues the floral aspect with Jasmine and Violet but introduces an element of spice with Cloves and Orris Root. This culminates in a woody drydown typical of those tropical forests with earthy Patchouli and Oakmoss meeting Sandalwood, Musk and Amber. Top Notes: Hyacinth, Galbanum, Iris, Bergamot, Lemon and Tuberose. Heart Notes: Aldehydes, Jasmine, Ylang-Ylang, Cloves, Orris Root, Violet, Spicy Notes and Rose. Base Notes: Oakmoss, Vetiver, Sandalwood, Resins, Musk, Amber and Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Shalimar Eau De Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Guerlain Shalimar Eau De Parfum (90ml) is an amber, spicy EDP for women with a voluptuous, sensual character, depicting a wearer with a touch of impertinence, unafraid to experience the forbidden. The composition opens with a zesty citrus melange including Bergamot, Lemon, Cedar and Mandarin Orange. This leads on to a warming heart filled with notes of Iris, Jasmine and Rose. The woody, earthy base comprising creamy Vanilla, Leather, Sandalwood, balsam notes and Tonka Beans implies power and sensuality. The fragrant liquid is housed in a bottle with arabesque designs evoking the basins of the Shalimar gardens. The fan-shaped stopper depicts the extravagant beauty of the garden's fountains. Top Notes: Citruses, Bergamot, Lemon, Cedar and Mandarin Orange. Heart Notes: Iris, Patchouli, Vetiver, Jasmine and Rose. Base Notes: Vanilla, Incense, Leather, Opoponax, Civet, Sandalwood, Tonka Bean and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Dior Fahrenheit Aftershave Lotion 100ml
listings.description: Dior Fahrenheit Aftershave Lotion (100ml) is a refreshing aftershave lotion which leaves the skin refreshed, comfortably smooth and lightly scented with the warm, subtle notes of Fahrenheit. This oriental spicy fragrance for men exudes a sensual vibrancy, creating a subtle masculinity and enigmatic attraction. The addictive composition melds extreme olfactory accords with floralcy meeting Leather and Woods, enhanced by Bourbon Vanilla Absolute. Opening with the exotic top note of Sicilian Mandarin in combination with aromatic Liquorice and musky Suede, the composition moves on to a heart featuring the green, slightly flowery notes of sensual Violet. This culminates in a base characterised by the exotic, smoky aspect of Leather. This culminates in the sweet, spicy accord of warm, creamy Bourbon Vanilla. Top Notes: Suede, Liquorice and Sicilian Mandarin. Heart Notes: Violet Leaf, Rum, Coriander and Cumin. Base Note: Leather.

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Black Phantom Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Kilian Black Phantom Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a dark gourmand fragrance masterfully crafted to evoke mystery and indulgence.The scent opens with a rich Rum accord from Martinique, leading to an intense heart of fresh roasted Coffee beans. The composition deepens with a unique Cyanide accord, while the base notes reveal a sweet blend of Sugar Cane and creamy Sandalwood, complemented by earthy Vetiver essence, creating an intoxicating blend that balances darkness with sweetness. Top Notes: Rum Accord. Heart Notes: Coffee and Cyanide Accord. Base Notes: Sugar Cane, Sandalwood and Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Dior Poison Eau De Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Dior Poison Eau De Toilette (50ml) is a floral ambery EDT for women with a sultry, seductive character, at once provocative and mysterious. It seeks to help women assert their femininity with confidence. The exceptional composition of this fragrance combines rich, spicy, floral and ambery notes with the sensual accords of Honey and Musk.The opening to this scent features aromatic Coriander with its fresh, peppery and zesty notes adding a captivating, mysterious aura. Tuberose in the heart brings highly fragrant floralcy whilst the base centres on the velvety, balsamic notes of Opoponax, a resinous gum sourced from a tree which grows in Africa and the Middle East. This variant of Myrrh lends the fragrance an enchanting mystery. Top Notes: Coriander and Wild Berries. Heart Notes: Orange Honey and Tuberose. Base Notes: Opopanax.

listings.rawTitle: Dior Hypnotic Poison Eau De Toilette 30ml
listings.description: Dior Hypnotic Poison Eau De Toilette (30ml) is an ambery EDT for women with a magnetic, bewitching character, bathing the skin in a mysterious, sultry and irresistible scent. This captivating scent features a refreshing heart of Jasmine Sambac elevated by notes of bitter Almond and creamy, sensual Vanilla.Opening with the fruity zest of Apricot and Plum, the composition moves on to a heart featuring the soft and delicate notes of Jasmine Sambac in unison with the floralcy of Rose, Tuberose and Lily Of the Valley. Notes of Almond add a touch of bitterness to the base whilst voluptuous and sensual Vanilla unfurls its soft blossoms. Top Notes: Apricot, Plum and Coconut. Heart Notes: Tuberose, Jasmine, Lily-Of-The-Valley, Rose, Brazilian Rosewood and Caraway. Base Notes: Sandalwood, Almond, Vanilla and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Dior Hypnotic Poison Eau De Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Dior Hypnotic Poison Eau De Toilette (50ml) is an ambery EDT for women with a magnetic, bewitching character, bathing the skin in a mysterious, sultry and irresistible scent. This captivating scent features a refreshing heart of Jasmine Sambac elevated by notes of bitter Almond and creamy, sensual Vanilla.Opening with the fruity zest of Apricot and Plum, the composition moves on to a heart featuring the soft and delicate notes of Jasmine Sambac in unison with the floralcy of Rose, Tuberose and Lily Of the Valley. Notes of Almond add a touch of bitterness to the base whilst voluptuous and sensual Vanilla unfurls its soft blossoms. Top Notes: Apricot, Plum and Coconut. Heart Notes: Tuberose, Jasmine, Lily-Of-The-Valley, Rose, Brazilian Rosewood and Caraway. Base Notes: Sandalwood, Almond, Vanilla and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Woman In Gold Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Kilian Woman In Gold Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a luminous floral EDP masterfully crafted by perfumer Calice Becker.The scent opens with a bright and sparkling Bergamot, leading to an opulent heart where Rose reveals its many facets, from fresh and dewy to rich and sophisticated. The base notes unfold with a generous dose of Vanilla Absolute, beautifully enhanced by Tonka Bean and an exclusive Akigalawood molecule, creating a textured and brilliant composition that perfectly balances brightness with warmth and depth. Top Notes: Bergamot. Heart Notes: Rose. Base Notes: Vanilla Absolute, Tonka Bean and Akigalawood.

listings.rawTitle: Miller Harris Scherzo Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Miller Harris Scherzo Eau De Parfum (50ml) is an intensely vibrant fragrance that captures the heady glamour of the 1930s French Riviera.Inspired by F. Scott Fitzgerald's 'Tender is the Night,' this bestselling unisex EDP opens with sweet Tangerine and the intoxicating purple richness of Davana, which adds a subtle liquor twist. The heart unfolds to reveal a stunning floral bouquet of dark red Rose, ethereal Peony, sunny yellow Narcissus, and crisp white Pittosporum, while sacred Olibanum adds depth and sophistication. The base notes create a mesmerising finish through the interplay of earthy Patchouli, warm Vanilla, and precious Oudh, with a delicate sprinkling of sweetness that evokes the enchanting display of a confectioner's window, making this a truly modern classic in the Miller Harris collection. Cruelty-free & vegan-friendly. Top Notes: Tangerine and Davana. Heart Notes: Olibanum, Narcissus, Pittosporum, Dark Rose and Peony. Base Notes: Patchouli, Vanilla, Oudh and Sweet Notes.

listings.rawTitle: Miller Harris Rose Silence Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Miller Harris Rose Silence Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an elegant composition centred around the pristine beauty of Turkish Rose Absolute.A sweet resonance of fruits elevates the delicate rose petals, with tangy Blackcurrant and juicy Mandarin providing a bright, contemporary opening. The heart unfolds to reveal the pure essence of freshly picked rose blooms, while the base notes of Patchouli and Cashmere Musk create an impression of warm skin beneath soft fabric. This sophisticated fragrance captures the serene beauty of a singular rose, where the delicate sensation of cashmere merges with a garment of fresh petals, creating an intimate and refined olfactory experience that gently caresses the skin. Cruelty-free & vegan-friendly. Top Notes: Mandarin and Blackcurrant. Heart Notes: Turkish Rose Absolute. Base Notes: Patchouli and Cashmere Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Rolling In Love Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Kilian Rolling In Love Eau De Parfum (50ml) is an intimate EDP scent masterfully crafted by perfumer Pascal Gaurin. The scent opens with an inviting accord of creamy Almond Milk and sensual Ambrette Seeds, leading to a sophisticated heart of powdery Iris that adds refinement and elegance to the composition. The base notes reveal a tender blend of Musk that creates a soft, addictive cocoon that melds beautifully with the skin, resulting in a monochromatic yet multi-textured fragrance that captures the essence of pure emotion. Top Notes: Almond Milk and Ambrette Seeds. Heart Notes: Iris. Base Notes: Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Angels Share Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Kilian Angels Share Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a warm gourmand EDP masterfully crafted by perfumer Benoit Lapouza.The scent opens with a rich Cognac Oil accord, complemented by warm Cinnamon Essence and Oak Absolute. The heart unfolds with a gourmand blend of sweet Hazelnut and Tonka Bean Absolute, while the base notes reveal a delicious combination of creamy Sandalwood, sweet Praline, and Vanilla, creating an intoxicating composition that pays tribute to the finest French cognac-making heritage. Top Notes: Cognac Oil, Cinnamon Essencea and Oak Absolute. Heart Notes: Hazelnut and Tonka Bean Absolute. Base Notes: Sandalwood, Praline and Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Straight To Heaven Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Kilian Straight To Heaven Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a woody spicy EDP masterfully crafted by perfumer Sidonie Lancesseur.The scent opens with a rich, intoxicating splash of Dark Rum, sweetened by creamy Vanilla and Dried Fruits accord. The heart reveals aromatic Nutmeg, while the base notes unfold with a harmonious blend of earthy Patchouli and fresh Cedarwood, creating an addictively sensual composition that perfectly balances warmth and woody sophistication. Top Notes: Dark Rum, Vanilla and Dried Fruits. Heart Notes: Nutmeg. Base Notes: Patchouli and Cedarwood.

listings.rawTitle: Dior Fahrenheit Eau De Toilette 200ml
listings.description: Dior Fahrenheit Eau De Toilette (200ml) is a timeless and universal EDT that embodies a thirst for the absolute, standing alone in the face of nature's majestic elements. Fahrenheit transcends trends with its unique, contrasting signature that leaves a powerful, lingering trail.Fahrenheit opens with the fresh, vibrant scent of Sicilian Mandarin, a citrus note that adds an exotic touch to the composition. At the heart is a surprising Violet accord, producing a green, slightly floral aroma that contrasts beautifully with the masculine base. The rich, smoky Leather note, inspired by the Russian leather used for hussars' boots, completes the fragrance with an exotic and enchanting effect, making Fahrenheit truly unforgettable. Top Notes: Sicilian Mandarin. Heart Notes: Violet. Base Notes: Leather.

listings.rawTitle: Dior Dune Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Dior Dune Eau De Toilette (100ml) is an oriental woody EDT for women, oceanic in character with a radiant, fresh and subtle accord which seeks to reflect the landscape change where the sky joins the ocean through a warm, floral melange. Comprising a veritable plethora of floral, fruity and woody olfactory notes, the composition features the citrus zest of Sicilian Mandarin at the top with its fresh, fruity accents. A Peony Accord adds its light, calming, vegetal influence to bear whilst creamy, sensual Vanilla in the base with its sweet, spicy accords completes this serene, enveloping scent. Top Notes: Brazilian Rosewood, Aldehydes, Mandarin Orange, Bergamot and Peony. Heart Notes: Lily, Ylang-Ylang, Wallflower, Jasmine and Rose. Base Notes: Amber, Sandalwood, Benzoin, Oakmoss, Vanilla, Patchouli and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Dior Fahrenheit Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Dior Fahrenheit Parfum (75ml) is an oriental spicy fragrance for men which lends a sensual vibrancy to the signature Fahrenheit scent, creating a subtle masculinity and enigmatic attraction. The addictive composition melds extreme olfactory accords with floralcy meeting Leather and Woods, enhanced by Bourbon Vanilla Absolute. Opening with the exotic top note of Sicilian Mandarin in combination with aromatic Liquorice and musky Suede, the composition moves on to a heart featuring the green, slightly flowery notes of sensual Violet and exotic, smoky aspect of Leather. This culminates in the sweet, spicy accord of warm, creamy Bourbon Vanilla. Top Notes: Suede, Liquorice and Sicilian Mandarin. Heart Notes: Violet Leaf, Rum, Coriander and Cumin. Base Notes: Bourbon Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Kilian Angels Share Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Kilian Angels Share Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a warm gourmand EDP masterfully crafted by perfumer Benoit Lapouza.The scent opens with a rich Cognac Oil accord, complemented by warm Cinnamon Essence and Oak Absolute. The heart unfolds with a gourmand blend of sweet Hazelnut and Tonka Bean Absolute, while the base notes reveal a delicious combination of creamy Sandalwood, sweet Praline, and Vanilla, creating an intoxicating composition that pays tribute to the finest French cognac-making heritage. listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Invictus Victory Elixir Parfum Intense 50ml
listings.description: Paco Rabanne Invictus Victory Elixir Parfum Intense (50ml) embodies the ultimate expression of triumph, presenting a fragrance that speaks to those who push beyond their limits. This scent is for the bold and victorious, where intensity meets refinement. Invictus Victory Elixir is the essence of power magnified, a blend of spicy woods and sharp freshness.The olfactory journey begins with an invigorating burst of Fresh Aromatic Lavandin, energised by the crisp spiciness of Green Cardamom and Black Pepper. This vibrant introduction transitions smoothly into an intense heart, where rich Incense intertwines with earthy Indonesian Patchouli, creating a mysterious and masculine core. The journey concludes with a luxurious base where sweet Madagascan Vanilla Bean melds with the rich warmth of Tonka Bean Liqueur, leaving a lasting impression of opulent victory. listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Blush Eau De Parfum 30ml

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Cobalt Eau De Parfum 50ml

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Bergamotto Di Calabria Eau De Toilette 180ml

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Mandorlo Di Sicilia Eau De Toilette 180ml
listings.description: Acqua Di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Mandorlo Di Sicilia Eau De Toilette (180ml) is a EDT for men and women with a delightfully soft fragrance evoking the sweet memories of a Sicilian way of life.The caressingly sweet fragrance is characterised by top notes of Star Anise, Bergamot and Orange. At the heart of this fragrance spray, citrus accents intertwine with soft and enveloping notes of the islands iconic Mediterranean Green Almonds and Ylang-Ylang, while its base is rounded off by Cedar Wood, Vanilla and White Musk notes. listings.rawTitle: Emporio Armani Diamonds Rose Eau De Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Emporio Armani Diamonds Rose Eau De Toilette (50ml) is a fruity, floral fragrance, offering a fresh and vibrant scent designed for the modern woman. listings.rawTitle: Byredo Bal d'Afrique Hair Perfume 75ml
listings.description: Byredo Bal d'Afrique Hair Perfume (75ml) is Ben Gorham's olfactory homage to Africa, reflecting a deep appreciation for its profound influence on dance, art, and music. The heart features Cyclamen and Violet, leading to a grounded base of Moroccan Cedarwood and Vetiver, embodying the spirit of a continent rich in culture and history. Top Notes: African Marigold, Bergamot and Buchu. Heart Notes: Cyclamen and Violet. Base Notes: Moroccan Cedarwood and Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Arancia Di Capri Eau De Toilette 180ml

At its heart, Petit Grain notes merge with an intense Cardamom aroma while the base of this fragrance is rounded off with a light touch of Caramello and sensual notes of Musk. Top Notes: Italian Sweet Orange, Italian Mandarin and Italian Lemon. Heart Notes: Petit Grain and Cardamom. Base Notes: Caramel and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Dior Sauvage Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Dior Sauvage Parfum (30ml) is a rich and highly concentrated interpretation of the iconic Sauvage fragrance, blending extreme freshness with warm, ambery tones and an animalistic allure that comes to life on the skin. Inspired by the untamed beauty of nature beneath a blue-tinged night sky, this scent captures the essence of wide-open spaces and the magic of the wild.Sauvage Parfum opens with the fresh, vibrant notes of Mandarin and Bergamot, setting a lively tone. The heart reveals the creamy richness of Sri Lankan Sandalwood, which envelops the composition with its smooth, milky accords, complemented by a surprising Cedar note with a hint of 'jammy' Raspberry. The base is wrapped in the sweet warmth of Vanilla Absolute, enhanced by the slightly bitter, mouthwatering touch of Tonka Bean. Top Notes: Mandarin and Bergamot. Heart Notes: Sandalwood and Cedar. Base Notes: Vanilla and Tonka Bean.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein CK All Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Calvin Klein CK All Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a fruity floral EDT for men and women which reinvents the original CK One scent. Bright, clean and stimulating, this fragrance conveys the appeal of the individual with their unique form of self-expression and non-conformity.The refreshing composition opens with a zesty melange of citrus notes including Bergamot, Mandarin Orange and Grapefruit Blossom. This leads on to a fragrant floral heart of Jasmine, Freesia and Lily, augmented by the addition of Rhubarb's fruity elements. This culminates in a warmly oriental base where Amber and Musk combine with Vetiver. The fragrant liquid is housed in the iconic opaque white bottle of its CK predecessors. Top Notes: Bergamot, Mandarin Orange and Grapefruit Blossom. Heart Notes: Jasmine, Rhubarb, Freesia and Lily. Base Notes: Musk, Amber and Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Dior Sauvage Eau De Toilette 200ml
listings.description: Dior Sauvage Eau De Toilette (200ml) is a bold and fresh EDT inspired by the vastness of wide-open spaces, capturing the essence of an ozone-blue sky over a sun-scorched rocky landscape.Sauvage opens with an invigorating burst of Reggio di Calabria Bergamot, radiating juicy freshness that instantly commands attention. This vibrant citrus is anchored by the ambery depth of Ambroxan, derived from precious Ambergris, while resinous Elemi and a woody base provide a powerful and confident finish. Sauvage is a signature scent for the authentic man, embodying virility and strength in every spritz. Top Notes: Reggio di Calabria Bergamot. Heart Notes: Elemi. Base Notes: Ambroxan, Ambergris and Woods.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Colonia Intensa Eau De Cologne 180ml
listings.description: Acqua Di Parma Colonia Intensa Eau De Cologne (180ml) is an intense and sophisticated men's fragrance, creating a perfect balance between the traditional and contemporary.It is a classic composition of Bergamot and Lemon notes gets a modern touch with the addition of woods and resin accords, resulting in a unique sensory experience. listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Colonia Club Eau De Cologne 50ml
listings.description: Acqua Di Parma Colonia Club Eau De Cologne (50ml) is a fresh and stylish embodiment of contemporary Italian living, a refined and elegant olfactory interpretation of classic Italian cologne for the gentleman who experiences life with passion.Elegantly dynamic and fresh, the Colonia Club scent is characterised by original top notes of Neroli, Mint and Galbanol. listings.rawTitle: Britney Spears Curious Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Britney Spears Curious Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an exhilarating white floral fragrance accented with Louisiana Magnolia and wrapped in the sensuality of Vanilla-infused Musk. Heart Notes: Tuberose, Jasmine and Pink Cyclamen. Base Notes: Musk, Vanilla and Woody Accords.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Insolence Eau De Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Guerlain Insolence Eau De Parfum (75ml) is a floral, fruity EDP of seduction which depicts a bold, sensual wearer, impossible to resist and who will transport you to a world of daring, irreverence and freedom. Base Notes: Oriental Sandalwood, Resin and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty For Him Eau De Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Gucci Guilty For Him Eau De Parfum (90ml) is a woody, aromatic and spicy EDP for men which seeks to intensify the traditional images of masculine beauty, enhancing their appeal with mystery and unconventionality. The fragrance is housed in a sleek, matte black bottle with a silver cap and embossed G logo. Top Notes: Rose, Balsamic Vinegar, Red Chilli Pepper and Salt. Heart Notes: Lavender, Orange Blossom and Neroli. Base Notes: Cedar and Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy L'Interdit Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Givenchy L'Interdit Eau De Parfum (50ml) unveils the beauty concealed within, marking its stature as an emblematic floral woody fragrance that resonates with your deepest cravings.This enthralling EDP by Givenchy initiates with the familiar zest of Ginger, drawing you into its pristine aura. Progressing, it reveals a captivating heart imbued with the opulence of Orange Blossom, Jasmine, and Tuberose, wrapping you in its luxurious embrace. Descending to its base, the fragrance indulges in the profound, mesmerizing chords of Patchouli and Vetiver, adding depth and intricacy to its allure. The celebrated scent by Givenchy takes you on an odyssey of introspection, inspiring you to acknowledge the shadowed passions within. The fragrance is encased in a classic bottle, its contrasting edges and supple curves mirroring the multifaceted nature of one's identity. Head Notes: Ginger. Heart Notes: Orange Blossom, Jasmine, Tuberose. Base Notes: Patchouli, Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Bottled Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Hugo Boss Bottled Parfum (100ml) stands as a testament to the man who is unmistakably a BOSS. This parfum emanates an overwhelming sense of sophistication and warmth. listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Bottled Infinite Eau De Parfum 100ml

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Terre D'Hermes Eau Intense Vetiver Eau De Parfum 50ml

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Armani Code Eau De Parfum 75ml

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentleman Eau De Parfum 60ml

listings.description: Creed Bois Du Portugal Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a woody, spicy and aromatic, rich men's EDP which combines elegance with a robust virility. Effortlessly masculine, sensual and mysterious, the scent draws its title and inviting spirit from the fragrant palette of the Iberian Peninsula forest with its warm Mediterranean air enlivened by the olfactory notes from pine, oak and chestnut trees. Opening with an aromatic and fruity melange of Basil, Bergamot, Lemon, Lime and Mandarin, the composition leads on to a warm, distinctive heart of Lavender and exotic Spices before culminating in an earthy yet smooth and refined base with the exotic woods of Cedarwood and Sandalwood amalgamating with Patchouli and Vetiver. Top Notes: Bergamot, Lemon, Lime, Basil and Mandarin. Heart Notes: Lavender and Spices. Base Notes: Sandalwood, Patchouli, Vetiver and Cedarwood.

listings.rawTitle: Byredo Black Saffron Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Byredo Black Saffron Eau De Parfum (50ml) is an intense floral amber fragrance with a multifarious olfactory composition which seeks to convey a sense of unity and inclusion. Centred on the smell of Saffron, an exalted spice in India where the Hindu monks and sages wear Saffron clothes as a symbol of abstinence from all material things, thoughts and pleasures, it is revered by Byredo's founder. Opening with a spicy fruity melange of Juniper Berries, Pomelo and spicy Saffron, the heart blends the floral notes of Black Violet and Cristal Rose with the smoked leather nuances of Accord Cuir with its Saffron content. The scent culminates in an earthy, woody drydown with Vetiver and Blonde Woods enlivened by the inclusion of zesty Raspberry. The fragrant liquid is housed in the brand's instantly recognisable, chic and simple monochrome bottle. Top Notes: Juniper Berries, Pomelo and Saffron. Heart Notes: Black Violet, Cristal Rose and Accord Cuir. Base Notes: Blonde Woods, Raspberry and Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Original Vetiver Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Creed Original Vetiver Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a fresh, woody, aromatic EDP for men which conveys the sensual feeling of time spent outdoors amongst verdant greenery, time spent beneath warm sunshine enjoying the stimulating company and lively conversation of friends. Bottling this captivating atmosphere and the irresistible attraction of the great outdoors, Original Vetiver conveys sophistication and romance through its traditional Vetiver interpretation. With a green and masculine signature, the composition includes refreshing Vetiver leaves, aromatic heart and earthy roots for a captivating, fresh and warming effect. Opening with the zesty, fresh and uplifting notes of Lemon, Green Notes and Ginger, the heart features the earthy, leathery characteristics of Vetiver in combination with herbaceous Coriander, peppery Cypress and fresh floral scents. This culminates in a rich and woody base combining White Musk, balsamic Cedarwood and sweet, powdery Guaiac Wood. Top Notes: Ginger, Green Notes and Lemon. Heart Notes: Vetiver, Fresh Floral, Coriander and Cypress. Base Notes: White Musk, Cedarwood and Guaiac Wood.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Aventus Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Creed Aventus Eau De Parfum (30ml) stands as a true testament to masculine excellence, earning its place as the best-selling men's EDP in the history of The House of Creed. This fragrance is a tribute to strength, power, success, and heritage, embodying sensuality, audacity, and contemporary allure. It opens with tantalising fruity top notes of Pineapple, Blackcurrant, Apple, and Bergamot, creating an invigorating and refreshing introduction. As the scent develops, a fresh and fruity heart emerges, characterized by notes of Jasmine, Pineapple, and Patchouli. These elements combine harmoniously, lending a captivating and enduring quality to the fragrance. As Aventus unfolds further, it reveals a rich and robust base, where Oakmoss, Cedarwood, Birch, and Creed's distinctive Ambroxan take centre stage. This woody foundation adds depth and character to the composition, leaving a lasting and memorable impression that exudes confidence and sophistication. Aventus by Creed is an olfactive masterpiece that captures the essence of a modern-day legend. Top Notes: Pineapple, Blackcurrant, Apple, Bergamot. Heart Notes: Juniper Berries, Birch, Patchouli, Jasmine. Base Notes: Musk, Oak Moss, Ambergris, Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Virgin Island Water Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Creed Virgin Island Water Eau De Parfum (50ml) is an exotic citrus, floral and solar fragrance which encapsulates the splendour of summer. Its combination of zesty citrus, floral summer blooms, fresh Coconut and tropical woods transports you to the clear blue waters, sun-drenched beaches and cooling sea breeze of the Caribbean Islands. This fresh, warm and enticing scent conjures images of a sailing trip across the Caribbean, visiting spectacular destinations. Refreshing with its tropical theme, the composition opens with tantalising notes of crisp Mexican Lime, Bergamot and zesty tropical fruits. This moves on to a heart which reflects the delights of an invigorating summer cocktail with exotic White Flowers and fragrant Jasmine mingling with the milky richness of layered Coconut. Tonka Bean and White Musk combine in the base producing an irresistible warmth and serenity to conclude the experience. Top Notes: Bergamot, Lime and Tropical Fruits. Heart Notes: Coconut Milk, Coconut Water, Jasmine and White Flowers. Base Notes: Tonka Bean and White Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentleman Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Givenchy Gentleman Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an exceptional fragrance for men, embodying a magnetic personality that doesn't just follow the flow but becomes it. Ideal for the sensual Gentleman whose appeal stems from a unique blend of strength and gentleness. This EDP offers a woody interpretation that captivates and charms. This fragrance is for the man who confidently embraces his eccentricity, enjoying spontaneous and shared pleasures, setting his own rules with a free spirit. This composition creates a dynamic rhythm from the first moment, beginning with the soft tempo of aromatic lavender and vibrant pepper. It warms up with the smooth Peru balsam and iris, striking a balance between strength and delicacy. The woody tones of patchouli and the sensuality of black vanilla bring forth an addictive oriental note, crafting a rich, textured signature that lingers on the skin throughout the night. Top Notes: Pepper Essence and Lavender. Heart Notes: Orris Concrete and Peru Balm. Base Notes: Patchouli Essence and Black Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Carmina Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Creed Carmina Eau De Parfum (30ml) is a floral, amber, woody and musk EDP for women which celebrates the overt sensuality of feminine allure with a sophisticated composition which conveys a captivating charisma. Opening with the sultry melange of seductive Black Cherry, warming Pink Pepper and spicy, golden Saffron, the heart joins exquisite Rose de Mai with luxurious, indulgent Cashmere Wood, heavenly Peony and fragrant Violet. This culminates in a seductive, intoxicating base of precious Myrrh and Frankincense, together with Amber and smouldering Musk. The fragrant liquid is housed in a bottle clad in a Raspberry hue with flecks of muted Rose. Top Notes: Black Cherry, Saffron and Pink Pepper. Heart Notes: Rose De Mai, Violet, Cashmere Wood and Peony. Base Notes: Frankincense, Myrrh, Amber and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo L'Eau Eau De Toilette 90ml
listings.description: Jimmy Choo L'Eau Eau De Toilette (90ml) combines floral, fresh, and musky notes, softly caressing the skin with a delicate breath which evokes a powerful, radiant femininity. L'Eau has a floral and fruity heart which exposes the essence of the delicious Hibiscus flower, softly blended with sweet fruity notes partnered with a woody depth. This EDT evokes a seductive sweetness and glowing sensuality captured in an irresistible design. Top Notes: Hibiscus Flower and Bergamot. Heart Notes: Nectarine and Peony. Base Notes: Cedarwood and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Millesime Imperial Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Creed Millesime Imperial Eau De Parfum (50ml) is an elegant and stylish EDP for men and women with a citrus, marine and woody character. Drawing its inspiration from the changing levels of daylight as dusk beckons, Millesime Imperial transports you to a world of golden light and flickering silhouettes as the sun's diminishing beams cast soft shadows. Opening with the light, citrus notes of Bergamot, zesty Blackcurrant and refreshing Violet Leaves, the scent leads onto a heart where Salty Marine Accords are softened by the gentler notes of fragrant Orris. This culminates in a woody base combining the depth of Cedarwood, warm Sandalwood and luxurious Musk. The fragrant liquid is housed in an iconic gold bottle, alluring and intriguing, which captures light from every angle. Top Notes: Bergamot, Blackcurrant and Violet Leaves. Heart Notes: Orris and Salty Marine Accord. Base Notes: Cedarwood, Musk and Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Green Irish Tweed Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Creed Green Irish Tweed Eau De Parfum (50ml), inspired by Olivier Creed's family couture legacy, stands as a quintessential fougere EDP, embodying both aromatic freshness and the lush greenery of Ireland. This iconic scent draws its inspiration from the verdant landscapes of the Emerald Isle, evoking images of freshly cut grass and a revitalizing sea breeze, making it a clean and naturally enticing choice for men. Green Irish Tweed pays homage to the Creed family's couture heritage, with its composition reflecting the earthy tones of luxurious hand-woven yarns and the craftsmanship associated with the Linton Tweed Mill.The fragrance opens with invigorating notes of Lemon and Verbena, cooled by a breath of Peppermint, leading into a heart where fresh green Geranium and aromatic Lavender blend seamlessly. The dry down is a sophisticated mix of Cedarwood, Sandalwood, Oakmoss, and Ambroxan, creating a long-lasting, arboreal scent that captures the essence of elegance and the great outdoors. This fragrance paints a vivid picture of spring meadows, delicate wildflowers, and the traditions of countryside estates, where hunting, hip flasks, and horseback riding were the norm. It's a fragrance that offers a perfect dose of nostalgia, akin to a flawlessly tailored riding outfit and the finest tweed suit, making it the definitive touch for the classic gentleman. Top Notes: Peppermint, Verbena, Lemon, Bergamot and Galbanum. Heart Notes: Green Geranium, Lavender and Violet. Base Notes: Cedarwood, Sandalwood, Oakmoss and Ambroxan.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Le Parfum Intense Eau De Parfum 125ml
listings.description: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Le Parfum Intense Eau De Parfum (125ml) is an intense woody amber EDP for men with a sultry, seductive character arousing boundless temptation to rival that of the Garden of Eden.Reflecting this addictive seduction, the composition combines the raw sensuality of Ambergris with the warming freshness of Ginger and sweet intensity of Coconut Woods. Potent masculinity enters the mix in the form of creamy Sandalwood and enticingly spicy Tonka Bean. Housed in the iconic Jean Paul Gaultier bottle, the male torso has been lacquered with a black and green gradient effect to accentuate the muscular torso whose modesty is spared by a single gold vine leaf plucked from the iconic green box. Top Notes: Coconut Wood. Heart Notes: Tonka Bean. Base Notes: Santal Wood.

listings.rawTitle: Montale Chocolate Greedy Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Montale Chocolate Greedy Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an amber vanilla EDP for men and women with a mouthwatering composition filled with delectable creaminess, a sumptuously rich ganache of utter scrumptiousness. Opening with a Coffee and Bitter Orange melange, the scent features a powdery heart reminiscent of the highest quality Cocoa when sprinkled over an expensive truffle. Sensual Vanilla Pods mixed with Chocolate creaminess produce a delicate and subtly gourmand drydown. Top Notes: Moka Bean and Bitter Orange. Heart Notes: Cacao Cream. Base Notes: Vanilla Pods.

listings.rawTitle: Montale Dark Purple Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Montale Dark Purple Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an amber floral EDP for women with a sensual, oriental character which exudes bold seduction. Opening with the zesty, citrus aroma of ripe Plum together with fresh Orange, these top notes are enveloped by luscious, floral notes from intense Rose and Geranium and the enticing aroma of sweet Red Berries. This culminates in a dark, earthy and opulent base with earthy Patchouli combined with animalistic White Musk, exotic Teak Wood and Amber. Top Notes: Plum and Orange. Heart Notes: Rose, Red Berries, Patchouli and Geranium. Base Notes: Musk, Teak Wood and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Himalaya Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Creed Himalaya Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a fresh, spicy, aromatic, woody fougere EDP for men whose uplifting, adventurous, masculine spirit draws its inspiration from the rugged magnificence, beauty, power and eternity of the Himalayan Mountains as experienced by Oliver Creed during a Tibetan mountain-climbing expedition. Opening with a fresh, citrusy melange of Bergamot, Lemon, Grapefruit and Mandarin, the composition leads on to an overtly masculine heart where unique notes of Gunpowder blend with Juniper Berries, Nutmeg and Pepper, giving Himalaya a uniquely innovative edge. This culminates in a pure and seductive drydown of Sandalwood, Vetiver and Cedarwood, perfectly rounding off this irresistible signature scent. The fragrant liquid is housed in a flacon which is unique among the Creed collection for its metallic exterior. It reflects the mountain influence, resembling both a mountaineer's canteen as well as the shiny surface of ice on mountain rocks. Top Notes: Calabrian Bergamot, Mandarin and Sicilian Lemon. Heart Note: Gunpowder, Juniper Berries, Nutmeg, Pepper, Lavender and Jasmine. Base Notes: Sandalwood, Vetiver and Cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Montale Black Aoud Eau De Parfum 100ml

Intense, warm and animalic, the composition is a rich, bubbling melange of velvety Rose, leathery Labdanum and darkly complex Oud. Opening with the zesty citrus notes from Tangerine, the scent features Rose and Labdanum at its heart before culminating with a drydown of Cambodian Agarwood, earthy Patchouli and Musk. Top Notes: Tangerine. Heart Notes: Rose and Labdanum. Base Notes: Patchouli, Agarwood and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Eros Energy Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Versace Eros Energy Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a refreshing and citrusy EDP that delivers an invigorating blast of citrus energy, instantly uplifting and energising the senses. The fragrance begins with a sparkling concoction of Italian Bergamot, Blood Orange, Lime, Lemon, Grapefruit, and Mandarin, each note blending into a harmony that radiates pure joy and delight. As the fragrance progresses, a fiery heart emerges with the heat of Pink Peppercorn and the sensuality of juicy Blackcurrant, complemented by the smooth, soothing presence of White Amber. This combination creates a passionate and enchanting core to the scent. As Eros Energy settles, it reveals a robust base where earthy Patchouli enhances the blend's depth, while clean Musk envelops the senses in a comforting embrace, and Oakmoss adds a touch of classic elegance with its green, velvety texture. Top Notes: Italian Bergamot, Blood Orange, Lime, Lemon, Grapefruit and Mandarin. Heart Notes: Pink Peppercorn, Blackcurrant and White Amber. Base Notes: Patchouli, Musk and Oakmoss.

Present in both the opening and heart of the melange, Bulgarian Rose is augmented with a hint of sweetness to create a divine, light and airy result, flawless like a solitary diamond. In the base, soft, clean, skin-loving Musk delights the senses. Top Notes: Bulgarian Rose. Heart Notes: Bulgarian Rose. Base Notes: Amber and White Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Phizz Daily 3-in-1 Hydration, Electrolytes & Vitamins Effervescent Tablets Orange 60 Tablets

listings.rawTitle: Byredo Bal D'Afrique Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Byredo Bal D'Afrique Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an amber, floral and woody EDP for men and women which depicts the fantasy of arriving in Africa on an imaginary journey, a celebration of African culture through olfactory notes. Characterised by a medium Intensity, the composition gives vibrant expression to this vibe through the excess, euphoria and intensity of its constituent parts.Opening with a combination of musky African Marigold, camphorous Buchu and Bergamot, the fragrant floral heart blends Violet, Cyclamen and Jasmine. This culminates in a woody drydown of Cedarwood and warm, earthy Vetiver. Top Notes: African Marigold, Bergamot and Buchu. Heart Notes: Cyclamen and Violet. Base Notes: Moroccan Cedarwood and Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Billie Eilish Eilish By Billie Eilish Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Eilish By Billie Eilish Eau De Parfum (30ml) is an amber, vanilla EDP for women with a seductive, sensual character, personified by the iconic bottle, crafted in the voluptuous and alluring shape of a female upper torso. The first fragrance launched by renowned music artist Billie Eilish, this fragrance was launched in 2021 and has rapidly gained popularity due to its enticing, sweet notes offset by the warm, ambery hues.Opening with a sweet and fruity, floral melange of Mandarin, Red Berries and Sugar, the composition leads on to a creamy, sensual heart of Vanilla, Rose and Cacao. This culminates in a woody, musky dry down where Tonka Bean melds with Amber. Cruelty-free & vegan-friendly. Top Notes: Sugar, Red Berries and Mandarin Orange. Heart Notes: Vanilla, Cacao, Spicy Notes and Rose. Base Notes: Tonka Bean, Amber, Musk and Woody Notes.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Be Eau De Toilette 200ml
listings.description: Calvin Klein Be Eau De Toilette (200ml) follows One as another fragrance designed for both men and women from the iconic US fashion house. This versatile EDT is a fresh, oriental, and woody fragrance that is aimed at anyone who is individualistic. The tonic musk was launched in 1996 and...

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Arancia Di Capri Eau De Toilette 30ml
listings.description: Acqua Di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Arancia Di Capri Eau De Toilette (30ml) is a relaxing and bright, fruity fragrance for men and women which encapsulates the signature scents of Orange, Mandarin, and Lemon from Capri.This fruity EDT is characterised by bright and radiant top notes of Orange, Mandarin and Lemon scents. At its heart, Petit Grain notes merge with an intense Cardamom aroma while the base of this fragrance is rounded off with a light touch of Caramello and sensual notes of Musk. Top Notes: Italian Sweet Orange, Italian Mandarin and Italian Lemon. Heart Notes: Petit Grain and Cardamom. Base Notes: Caramel and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Her Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Burberry Her Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a floral fruity gourmand fragrance for the headstrong woman, bold and adventurous, full of energy and optimism, enigmatically stylish, living life in the fast lane by her own rulebook. Opening with a sparkling burst of red and dark Berry notes including Blackcurrant, Blueberry and Raspberry, the EDP leads on to a fragrant, floral heart combining sensual Jasmine and romantic, powdery Violet. This culminates in a base lightened by a luminous, White Woods accord together with sensual Dry Amber and earthy Musk. Top Notes: Blackcurrant, Blueberry and Raspberry. Heart Notes: Jasmine Accord and Violet Accord. Base Notes: White Woods, Musk and Dry Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Ariana Grande R.E.M. Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Ariana Grande REM Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a floral, woody fragrance, brimming with limitless, empowering potential. Inspired by Ari's love of outer space and the Universe, this fragrance will make you feel like you can conquer the galaxy.This EDP draws you in with a cosmic blend of Juicy Fig and Warm Salted Caramel. Lavender essence takes you to dreamy new heights, while sparkling Pear Blossom explodes like a supernova in the night sky. Intoxicating Musk, wrapped with Sandalwood, creates the perfect ending to your unforgettable journey. Cruelty-free. Top notes: Quince, Fig, Salted Caramel and Marshmallow. Heart notes: Pear Blossom and Lavender Blossom. Base notes: Tonka Bean, White Musk and Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Afnan Supremacy In Oud Extrait De Parfum 150ml
listings.description: Afnan Supremacy In Oud Extrait De Parfum (150ml) is a versatile and captivating fragrance suitable for a variety of occasions, whether it's a date, a party, or a casual meet-up with friends. This unisex scent is expertly crafted to enhance your unique charisma, making it an essential addition to your fragrance collection. It's more than just a perfume; it's a signature scent that complements and elevates your presence in any setting, embodying elegance and allure.The extrait opens with the rich and exotic top notes of Saffron, Lavender, and Nutmeg, creating an inviting and spicy introduction that captivates the senses. As the fragrance unfolds, it reveals its heart - a blend of Agarwood and Sweet notes, which provide a deep, resonant warmth that is both luxurious and comforting. The journey of this scent culminates in its base notes, where the earthy and sensual aromas of Musk and Patchouli linger, leaving a memorable and lasting impression that is both sophisticated and enchanting. Top Notes: Saffron, Lavender and Nutmeg. Heart Notes: Agarwood. Base Notes: Musk and Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Touch for Women Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Burberry Touch For Women Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a fruity, floral and green fragrance for women which is a timeless, easy-to-wear perfume suitable for all occasions.This EDP has a selection of bright yet soft notes, opening with notes of Blackcurrant, Cassis and Pink Peppercorns. This slowly develops into a floral heart of Peach, Peony, Lily of the Valley, and sweet Jasmine. This dries down to an enticing base of Cedar, Oakmoss, Vanilla, Tonka Bean and Green Almond. This fragrance is presented in a pale pink, elegant bottle and finished with stylish black wooden top. Top Notes: Blackcurrant, Cranberry, Blackberry, Cassis and Pink Peppercorns. Heart Notes: Peach, Peony, Lily of the Valley, Jasmine and Raspberry. Base Notes: Cedar, Oakmoss, Vanilla, Green Almond and Tonka Bean.

listings.rawTitle: Britney Spears Fantasy Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Britney Spears Fantasy Eau De Parfum (30ml) is part of the iconic pop princesses' collection of youthful women's fragrances - created for those who are as seductive, charming and elusive as the superstar singer herself.Fantasy is alive with enchantment - a magical potion that leaves a tantalising trail of love and sensuality. This women's EDP is an intoxicating blend of exotic fruits and florals with a sensual base that creates a fairy tale fragrance inspired by the thrill of the chase. The women's perfume is encased in a rounded, pink bottle speckled with Swarovski crystals, and featuring interlocking rings at the neck that symbolises togetherness. Top Notes: Red Lychee, Golden Quince and Kiwi. Heart Notes: Jasmine Petals and White Chocolate Orchid. Base Notes: Musk, Orris Root and Sensual Woods.
