listings.rawTitle: Gloria Vanderbilt Vanderbilt In Red Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Gloria Vanderbilt Vanderbilt In Red Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a fruity floral EDP for women which depicts an elegant, sophisticated wearer with an intriguing aura and allure.Opening with a zesty and spicy melange of Pear, Bergamot and Pink Pepper, the composition leads on to a floral heart of sensual Jasmine, fragrant Rose and Black Currant. This culminates in a musky, citrusy and comforting base of Vanilla, Vetiver and Cashmeran. Top Notes: Pink Pepper, Bergamot and Pear. Heart Notes: Jasmine, Rose and Black Currant Blossom. Base Notes: Cashmeran, Vanilla and Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Code Le Parfum 125ml
listings.description: Giorgio Armani Code Le Parfum (125ml) is a sensual, oriental woody fragrance for men which conveys the image of a sophisticated, elegant male who exudes effortless magnetism and intense yet unprovocative seduction.This parfum opens with the bright, invigorating top notes of Mandarin and Bergamot, enlivened by the addition of Lemon Essence. This leads on to an aromatic heart combining notes of Rosemary and Lavender from Provence which lend a powerful, magnetic aspect. This culminates in a rich, sensual base with roasted Tonka Bean Absolute lending warmth together with the dry, woodiness of natural Cedar and Musk. Vanilla creates a seductive undertone to this addictive dry down. The shiny, iconic black bottle is adorned with an elegant, golden cap and gold lettering. The textured granular detail at the flacon's neck is reminiscent of a tuxedo's cummerbund. Top Notes: Mandarin, Lemon Essence and Bergamot. Heart Notes: Rosemary and Lavender. Base Notes: Tonka Bean, Vanilla and Cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentleman Society Eau De Parfum 60ml
listings.description: Givenchy Gentleman Society Eau De Parfum (60ml) is a woody, floral, aromatic fragrance for men which redefines the characteristics of modern masculinity with a wild Narcissus flower at its heart.Long-wearing, deep and multifaceted, the EDP opens with the crisp, green, aromatic notes of Sage and the comforting, seductive, spiciness of Cardamom. This leads on to a heart where the rich florality of Wild Narcissus contrasts with the earthy woodiness of a quartet of Vetiver variants, harvested in France, Haiti, Madagascar and Uruguay. This culminates in a sensuous, woody base with creamy Vanilla combining with the addictive essences of Sandalwood and Cedarwood. Gentleman Society is housed in the iconic bottle of Givenchy men's fragrances with a 4G monogram in gleaming silver metal adorning the black lacquered finish. Top Notes: Sage and Cardamom. Heart Notes: Absolute of Narcissus, Essence of Vetiver (Haiti), CO2 Vetiver Extract (Haiti), Essence of Vetiver (Uruguay) and Organic Essence of Vetiver (Madagascar). Base Notes: Cedarwood, Sandalwood and Tasuki Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Jasmine Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Jasmine Eau De Parfum (30ml) is a fruity floral EDP for women bursting with the radiance and inner joy of a composition featuring Jasmine Grandiflorum. This inner joy is further elevated by notes of Mandarin Essence and Magnolia Accord which bring a joyous element to the scent.Opening with a fruity melange of Mandarin and Bergamot, the olfactory trail leads to an overtly floral heart with tender wreaths of Jasmine meeting the sweetness of Magnolia and Damask Rose. This culminates in an earthy, woody base comprising Patchouli, Sandalwood and sensual Benzoin. The fragrant liquid is housed in an elongated bottle featuring a shiny gold cap, crafted from lacquered turquoise stone glass and bearing the distinctive Gucci flora pattern. Top Notes: Italian Mandarin, Bergamot and Black Pepper. Heart Notes: Jasmine, Jasmine Sambac, Magnolia and Damask Rose. Base Notes: Benzoin, Australian Sandalwood and Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy L'Interdit Rouge Eau De Parfum 35ml
listings.description: Givenchy L'Interdit Rouge Eau De Parfum (35ml) captures a whisper of carnal excitement at the heart of its iconic white flower bouquet.Combining the luminous Orange Blossom with opulent Jasmine, the scent achieves a radiant glow, further intensified by a spicy red accord of Blood Orange, Ginger, and Pimento Leaf, all smoothly rounded off with suave Sandalwood. This intricate mix leaves a trail filled with provocative promise. Crafted in France at the historic Givenchy Ateliers, L'Interdit Eau de Parfum Rouge highlights traceable natural ingredients, processed through traditional techniques, to boldly reveal the Underground Flower. The bottle's innovative red lacquer design glows smoulderingly from within, marking a striking debut on the world's perfume stage. L'Interdit invites wearers to experience the thrill of the forbidden and to embrace their singularity. Top Notes: Blood Orange Essence from Sicily, Ginger Extract from Nigeria. Heart Notes: Orange Blossom Absolute from Tunisia, Sambac Jasmine Absolute from India, Pimento Leaves from Jamaica. Base Notes: Patchouli Essence from Indonesia, Sandalwood Essence from New Caledonia.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty For Her Eau De Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Gucci Guilty For Her Eau De Parfum (90ml) is an ambery floral EDP for women who treasure friendship and love, thriving on these emotions to engender self-acceptance and inner confidence. The scent is characterised by the delicate, fresh femininity of Lilac Petals invigorated with a sparkling citrus Mandora facet on a trail of richly sensual amber notes and Patchouli.The composition opens with shimmering top notes of Mediterranean Mandora citrus, natural Bergamot and spicy Pink Pepper, generating a welcoming luminosity and warmth. This leads on to a blooming heart featuring Lilac in combination with a floral melange of Violet, Rose and Geranium. This culminates in an earthy, powdery base blending Patchouli with Amber. Top Notes: Mandora and Pink Pepper. Heart Notes: Lilac. Base Notes: Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a chypre floral EDP for women conveying the image of a confident wearer brimming with inner strength.The composition features the fruity floral sweetness of the Magnolia flower, its Clary Sage-like edge exuding a joyous spirit. The olfactory melange opens with the juicy citrus notes of Dewberry in sensual unison with the creamy Vanilla freshness of Coconut. This leads on to the floral heart of Magnolia, Jasmine Sambac and calming, warming Clary Sage. The scent culminates in the earthy, intense woodiness of Patchouli and Blonde Woods in a drydown which includes the mellow, leathery undertones of Musk. Gucci's iconic flora pattern, featuring vibrant blooms and rich hues, decorates both the bottle and outer packaging of Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia with its captivating purple shade. Top Notes: Dewberry and Coconut. Heart Notes: Magnolia, Jasmine Sambac and Clary Sage. Base Notes: Musk, Patchouli and Blonde Woods.

listings.rawTitle: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Intensely Men's Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Intensely Men's Eau De Parfum (50ml) is an amber, fougere EDP for men which draws its inspiration from Emporio Armani's web series 'Together Stronger', depicting a young couple, irresistibly in love, exploring each other every day both emotionally and physically, challenging the boundaries of their love and making it stronger.This composition opens with a melange of addictively aromatic Chestnut and softly piquant Pink Pepper, leading on to a sensual heart of creamy Vanilla and leathery Suede. This culminates in a drydown of smoky and earthy Vetiver and woody Amber. Top Notes: Pink Pepper and Chestnut Accord. Heart Notes: Vanilla and Suede Accord. Base Notes: Bourbon Vetiver and Ambery Woods Accord.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Armani Code Eau De Parfum 125ml
listings.description: Giorgio Armani Armani Code Eau De Parfum (125ml) captures a vibrant new intensity in this captivating, refillable masculine fragrance.Starting with a fresh and vibrant Green Mandarin essence from Italy, this spicy woody fougere perfume sets a distinctive tone. The heart features a warm and spicy essence of Nutmeg, leading to a base where a rich and warm Tonka Bean Absolute brings out a deep masculine sensuality. The new Armani Code bottle reimagines the original iconic design with an environmentally mindful approach by Giorgio Armani. Its sleek, striking black form, enhanced with silver accents and sensorial touches, is not only aesthetically pleasing but also rechargeable in all formats, demonstrating a commitment to environmental sustainability. Top Notes: Green Mandarin Essence. Heart Notes: Nutmeg Essence. Base Notes: Tonka Bean Absolute.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Rose Passion Eau De Parfum 60ml
listings.description: Jimmy Choo Rose Passion Eau De Parfum (60ml) is a floral EDP for women which depicts a free-spirited woman living and loving life on her own terms.Opening with the rich exotic fragrant combination of Frangipani and Jasmine, the composition leads on to a heart where the freshness of Coconut Milk meets the heady seduction of Orchids. This culminates in a seductive, earthy and woody base of Vanilla and Sandalwood. The pink, jewel-like bottle reflects the character of the wearer with its sense of playfulness, overt glamour, empowerment and allure. Top Notes: Frangipani and Jasmine. Heart Notes: Coconut Milk and Orchid. Base Notes: Vanilla and Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Opium Eau De Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent Opium Eau De Toilette (50ml) is a floral, amber EDT for women which exudes sensuality, allure, and voluptuousness.This composition opens with fruity, aromatic notes of Mandarin and Bergamot, leading to an intense, profound heart of Jasmine and Myrrh, lending a sublime and sensual quality. It culminates in a warm and spicy base with rich notes of Vanilla, Patchouli and Amber. Top Notes: Mandarin, Bergamot and Lily of the Valley. Heart Notes: Jasmine, Carnation and Myrrh. Base Notes: Vanilla, Amber, Patchouli and Sweet Myrrh.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Opium Eau De Toilette 90ml
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent Opium Eau De Toilette (90ml) is a floral, amber EDT for women which exudes sensuality, allure, and voluptuousness.This composition opens with fruity, aromatic notes of Mandarin and Bergamot, leading to an intense, profound heart of Jasmine and Myrrh, lending a sublime and sensual quality. It culminates in a warm and spicy base with rich notes of Vanilla, Patchouli and Amber. Top Notes: Mandarin, Bergamot and Lily of the Valley. Heart Notes: Jasmine, Carnation and Myrrh. Base Notes: Vanilla, Amber, Patchouli and Sweet Myrrh.

listings.rawTitle: Elie Saab Elixir Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Elie Saab Elixir Eau De Parfum (30ml) is an amber floral EDP for women which constitutes a love potion for the sensual, powerful female, exuding magnetism and allure.The composition opens with a citrusy floral melange of Mandarin and Neroli, leading on to a heart of powdery and sensual Iris. This culminates in a warm, earthy and woody dry-down of Benzoin, Myrrh and Amberwood. The scent is housed in a bottle shaped like a precious, faceted sphere with a golden cap, engraved with the Elie Saab monogram. Top Notes: Mandarin Orange and Neroli. Heart Note: Iris. Base Notes: Myrrh, Benzoin and Amberwood.

listings.rawTitle: Guy Laroche Drakkar Intense Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Guy Laroche Drakkar Intense Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a timeless, Oriental men's EDP which conveys a deeply sensual masculine allure which is far too powerful to ignore.Invigorating essences of Italian Bergamot blend with musky Vanilla notes, leaving an enveloping and long-lasting sillage. The Oriental accords of Coriander are warmed by Sage and Suede accords, exuding sensuality. Patchouli is invigorated by underlying notes of Lavender and Juniper Berries. Top Notes: Absinth, Bergamot, Coriander and Rosemary. Heart Notes: Lavender, Clary Sage and Juniper Berry. Base Notes: Moss, Patchouli, Suede and Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Explorer Platinum Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Montblanc Explorer Platinum Eau De Parfum (30ml) is a woody, ambery men's EDP which has been created to reflect a new aspect to Montblanc Explorer, pursuing a new avenue of the spirit of exploration which propels the wearer towards new adventures located in the world's highest mountains.The composition opens with the vibrant green, herbaceous notes of Violet Leaves and Clary Sage, enveloped in the woody intensity of Cedarwood and an accord of sensual, warm and exotic ambery notes. The bottle has been decorated with an impressive, textured silver sleeve inspired by the Montblanc 1858 Geosphere, the watch which paid tribute to the world's seven summit mountaineering challenge. Top Notes: Violet Leaves. Heart Notes: Clary Sage. Base Notes: Cedarwood.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez For Him Bleu Noir Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Narciso Rodriguez For Him Bleu Noir Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a woody EDP for men which is both powerful and subtle, celebrating masculine sensuality with every note. This lush scent embodies the emotional world of seduction, exploring the intriguing duality between sharp clarity and enigmatic allure.Inspired by the mysterious encounter of blue and black, the fragrance opens with invigorating top notes of Bergamot and Black Pepper, while the sensuous heart of Narciso Rodriguez Musk radiates with irresistible warmth. At the base, the woody elegance of Blue Cedar and Black Ebony is enriched with Vetiver and Amber, creating a sophisticated and contrasting sillage. Inspired, diligent and collaborative, he meets life's challenges head on, achieving success through self-accomplishment.This unique composition combines the vibrancy of French Lavender with the power of American Black Cedarwood, and grounds it on strong foundations with the minty vitality of Geranium and the alluring sensuality of Incense. Heart Notes: Lavender, Clary Sage and Geranium. Base Notes: Cedarwood, Patchouli, Tonka Bean and Olibanum.

listings.rawTitle: Zimaya Fatima Velvet Love Pour Femme Eau De Parfum 100ml

Zimaya Fatima Velvet Love is more than just a perfume; it's a statement of love and luxury in every drop.Inspired by Louis Vuitton Coeur Battant. Top Notes: Pear. Heart Notes: Egyptian Jasmine and Ylang Ylang. Base Notes: Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Eau De Parfum 150ml
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Eau De Parfum (150ml) is a daring fragrance that embodies sultry, provocative and enthralling femininity. This floral gourmand EDP couples energy with sensuality, pushing boundaries and redefining desire in a contemporary light for the modern woman. The Black Opium bottle is a marvel of design - feminine, sleek, and dazzling. Adorned with black glitter as if dressed in sequins, the shimmering black of the bottle is contrasted with the pink hue at its core. The radical contours of the bottle silhouette create an edgy and glamorous aesthetic, evoking the sparkling allure of the fragrance within. Top Notes: Pear Accord, Mandarin Essence. Heart Notes: Vanilla, Orange Blossom, White Flowers. Base Notes: Black Coffee Accord, Cedarwood Essence, White Musk, Patchouli.

Zimaya Fatima Pour Femme is more than a perfume; it's a statement of grace and allure, perfect for the woman who cherishes her femininity and strength.Inspired by Parfums De Marly Delina. Top Notes: Lychee, Rhubarb, Bergamot and Nutmeg. Heart Notes: Rose, Peony, Musk, Petal and Vanilla. Base Notes: Cashmeran, Cedar, Vetiver and Incense.

listings.rawTitle: Zimaya Oud Is Great Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Zimaya Oud Is Great Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a woody oriental EDP that captures the essence of an autumn day, combining the richness of freshly ground spices with a gentle floral sweetness. This unisex fragrance is an ode to the golden glow of a cool autumn's day, where the serene breeze carries with it an earthy robustness, enveloping you in a comforting embrace.The fragrance opens with the top notes of Saffron, Nutmeg, and Lavender, creating an inviting and spicy introduction that awakens the senses. As the scent unfolds, it reveals its heart - a powerful blend of Agarwood and Oud. This heart exudes a rich and deep aroma, reminiscent of the sturdy earthiness of a calm wind. Concluding this sensory journey are the base notes of Patchouli and Musk.Inspired by Initio Oud for Greatness. Top Notes: Saffron, Nutmeg and Lavender. Heart Notes: Agarwood and Oud. Base Notes: Patchouli and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Zimaya Sharaf Blend Extrait De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Zimaya Sharaf Blend Extrait De Parfum (100ml) is an entrancing extrait for both men and women that masterfully incorporates the luxurious essence of fine cognac, lending it a naturally rich caramel hue. This perfume is a celebration of elegance and sophistication.It opens with the opulent aroma of Cognac Oil, which is accentuated by Oak Absolute, Cinnamon Essence, and Tonka Bean Absolute, creating a rich and warm opening. As the scent develops, it unfolds into the heart notes of Vanilla and Cinnamon, offering a comforting and inviting warmth. The base is a sublime blend of Amber and Powdery notes, rounding out the scent with a deep and exquisite finish. Top Notes: Woody, Warm Spicy and Sweet. Heart Notes: Vanilla and Cinnamon. Base Notes: Amber and Powdery.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Mon Paris Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent Mon Paris Eau De Parfum (30ml) is a chypre floral EDP for women which reflects Parisian femininity, both seductive and sophisticated.Alluring and hypnotic, the composition features nocturnal Datura, a mysterious and intoxicating flower which is complemented by elegant White Peony, vibrant Red Fruits, and sensual Patchouli. It culminates in a base of White Musk. The multifaceted glass bottle with a deep base has been adorned with a soft lavalliere around the neck in matte silk, together with leather ties and a stunning, gold Yves Saint Laurent tablet. Top Notes: Pear and Fruit. Heart Notes: Datura and White Flowers. Base Notes: Patchouli and White Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Y For Him Eau De Parfum 60ml
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent Y For Him Eau De Parfum (60ml) is an intense, woody EDP for men which exudes the strength, elegance and single-minded determination of a man who blazes his own trail. Inspired, diligent and collaborative, he meets life's challenges head on, achieving success.This fragrance opens with fresh notes of Bergamot and Ginger, augmented by citrusy Green Apple for intense freshness. This leads on to a heart of Sage and Juniper bringing masculinity which contrasts with the elegance of Geranium Absolute and Lavender. It culminates in a sensual and smoky base combining Frankincense and warm Tonka Beans, spiced with Vetiver for intensity. The masculine bottle with signature Y logo has been crafted from thick glass, and holds the crystal blue liquid within as it graduates from opaque black to sky blue. It conveys an ambience of modernity and sophistication. Top Notes: Apple Accord, Bergamot, Ginger, Elemi and Aldehydes. Heart Notes: Geranium Absolute, Juniper, Sage and Lavender. Base Notes: Tonka Bean, Vetiver, Cedar, Olibanum and Amberwood.

listings.rawTitle: Zimaya Noor Oud Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Zimaya Noor Oud Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an EDP that embodies a sweet and oriental charm, with Oud as its central note. This luxurious and captivating scent is designed to be suitable for both men and women, capturing the essence of passion and elegance.The fragrance opens with the rich and exotic aroma of Saffron, setting a sophisticated and alluring top note. The heart of the perfume is a deep and intense blend of Agarwood (Oud) and Rose, creating a perfect balance between the powerful oud and the delicate floral scent. The base of the fragrance features the richness of Agarwood (Oud) again, complemented by the sweet and indulgent notes of Praline and Vanilla, providing a warm and inviting finish. Zimaya Noor Oud is more than just a perfume; it's a celebration of luxury and the captivating allure of Oud.Inspired by Swiss Arabian Shaghaf Oud. Top Notes: Saffron. Heart Notes: Agarwood (Oud) and Rose. Base Notes: Agarwood (Oud), Praline and Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Zimaya Royal Paragon Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Zimaya Royal Paragon Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an alluring oriental and floral unisex EDP that captivates with its intense olfactory character. This perfume is a perfect blend of elegance and seduction, designed for the discerning individual.The fragrance opens with the tangy zest of Bergamot, combined with the crispness of Apple, the soothing aroma of Lavender, and the sweetness of Mandarin Orange, creating a top note that is both refreshing and sophisticated. The heart features a blend of Geranium, Violet, and Jasmine, adding a floral freshness that is both chic and chivalrous. The base is enriched with the warm and inviting notes of Vanilla, Cardamom, Sandalwood, Pepper, Patchouli, and Guaiac Wood, further intensified by amber and the spicy allure of Pink Pepper. The scent is completed with an intriguing note of Caramelised Coffee, making Zimaya Royal Paragon an addictive and distinguished choice.Inspired by Parfums De Marly Leyton. Top Notes: Apple, Lavender, Bergamot and Mandarin Orange. Heart Notes: Geranium, Violet and Jasmine. Base Notes: Vanilla, Cardamom, Sandalwood, Pepper, Patchouli, Guaiac Wood and Caramelised Coffee.

listings.rawTitle: Sure Maximum Protection 96h Clean Scent Anti-Perspirant Deodorant Stick 45ml
listings.description: Sure Maximum Protection 96h Clean Scent Anti-Perspirant Deodorant Stick (45ml) provides maximum 96-hour sweat protection with a fresh and clean scent. The alcohol-free formula benefits from body-responsive technology for confidence tailored to you, ensuring that you feel fresh, dry and protected all day long without causing irritation. Created with a unique blend of skin-moisturising ingredients, the TRISolid formula keeps this strong antiperspirant deodorant gentle enough for everyday use.Formulated with anti-sweat Microtechnology, this deodorant delivers three times as powerful protection whilst Sure's innovative MotionSense technology exudes bursts of fragrance. Microcapsules are deposited on the surface of your skin which are then broken by the friction generated as you move, releasing the refreshing fragrance. It's that simple - the more you move, the more it protects. This anti-perspirant deodorant for women ensures nonstop, all-day freshness and 96-hour protection working in sync with your body.

listings.rawTitle: Gres Cabochard Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Gres Cabochard Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a woody and refined, feminine EDP which blends accents of Tobacco, Citrus and Leather with notes of Lichen and floral, wooded scents.A strong and timeless icon, Cabochard is a tribute to bold, spirited women who aren't afraid to walk their own path. It makes a strong impression, embodying audacious, determined and occasionally capricious femininity. Top Notes: Aldehydes, Galbanum and Sage. Heart Notes: Ylang Ylang, Rose and Jasmine. Base Notes: Oakmoss, Leather, Patchouli and Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Hot Couture Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Givenchy Hot Couture Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a reimagined iconic fragrance that radiates the freshness, florals, and the essence of femininity. This delightful EDP by Givenchy opens with Raspberry's tantalizing and juicy notes, leading to an exquisite heart filled with the luscious Magnolia and the opulent Rosa Damascena flowers. These sweet petal-inspired notes encapsulate a breezy romanticism. The refined bottle design is symbolic of the Maison's exquisite style, bringing an aura of haute couture to the fragrance.This fragrance unveils itself with the inviting top note of Raspberry Accord. Progressing to its heart, a floral embrace awaits with Magnolia Accord and Rosa Damascena Essence, epitomizing the spirit of love and elegance. The bottle reflects craftsmanship and sophistication, mirroring the premium allure of its contents. Top Notes: Raspberry Accord. Heart Notes: Magnolia Accord. Base Notes: Rosa Damascena Essence.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Pour Homme Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Givenchy Pour Homme Eau De Toilette (100ml) presents a vibrant and refreshing EDT, crafted specifically for the discerning gentleman. This fragrance, ideal for those twenty-five years and older, encapsulates the spirit of sophistication and timeless charm in every spritz.The scent journey begins with a lively burst of Grapefruit and Tangerine, complemented by the nuances of Coriander and Dedion. Venturing into its heart, the fragrance reveals the distinct aromas of Davana and Vetiver. Anchoring this olfactory experience, the base unfolds with the solid presence of Cedar and the mystical touch of Oilbanum. Top Notes: Mandarin Orange, Grapefruit, Tangerine, Coriander and Dedion. Heart Notes: Vetiver and Lavender. Base Notes: Cedar and Oilbanum.

listings.rawTitle: Estée Lauder Modern Muse Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Estée Lauder Modern Muse Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a lush, floral, and woody EDP which was inspired by the complexity of a modern woman, with the same dynamic contrasts as her life and her personality.Her creative energy and magnetic femininity are captured by its multi-faceted, sparkling floral aspect, whereas...

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Code Pour Homme Eau De Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Giorgio Armani Code Pour Homme Eau De Toilette (75ml) is a distinctively powerful citrus for the modern man, one who is not afraid to display his pride and sense of self.Code New combines elegance and sophistication to create a truly timeless fragrance. Opening with notes of Green mandarin Superessence, the fragrance develops into a heart of Lavandin before resting on a base of Tonka Bean Absolute and Cedarwood Heart. Top Notes: Green Mandarin Superessence. Heart Notes: Lavandin Heart. Base Notes: Tonka Bean Absolute and Cedarwood Heart.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Amarige Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Givenchy Amarige Eau De Toilette (100ml) embodies the essence of pure femininity, radiating joy and capturing the simplicity of life's happiest moments. This EDT, designed for the modern woman, is a tribute to the spirit of jubilance and the beauty of the Mediterranean.With each spritz, Amarige unveils its soft and sublime notes, creating a scent that's not only delightful but also evokes the serene shores of the Mediterranean, transporting you to a realm of tranquillity and bliss. Top Notes: Orange Blossom, Peach, Plum, Neroli, Brazilian Rosewood, Mandarin Orange and Violet. Heart Notes: Tuberose, Mimosa, Gardenia, Ylang-Ylang, Jasmine, Black locust, Carnation, Red Berries, Black Currant, Cassia, Rose and Orchid. Base Notes: Sandalwood, Woody Notes, Amber, Vanilla, Musk, Tonka Bean and Cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani My Way Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Giorgio Armani My Way Eau De Parfum (30ml) is a floral, woody EDP for the curious woman who seeks new experiences to challenge her preconceptions, covering previously uncharted territory. Connecting with others, she reinvents herself through learning and experience to develop a stronger sense of self.This perfume opens with a sparkling Orange Blossom note, extracted from hand-picked, bitter Egyptian Orange fruit. This leads on to a bright floral heart of Indian Tuberose Flower and culminates in an enveloping, vibrant base of sustainably-sourced Vanilla. The fragrance is housed in a sleek, transparent glass, showcasing the feminine perfume within. It is stoppered with a deep blue rounded cap, acting as a metaphor for the Earth which encapsulates all our human experiences. Top Notes: Calabrian Bergamot and Egyptian Orange Blossom. Heart Notes: Tuberose and Indian Jasmine. Base Notes: Virginian Cedarwood, Vanilla and White Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Bloom Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Gucci Bloom Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a floral EDP for women whose title gently inspires and encourages the wearer to blossom into the optimum, empowered version of themselves, pursuing a journey of self-discovery built on vitality and diversity. Gucci Bloom women flourish in their individual, expressive manner outside conventional limitations.Opening with the energising, romantic and naturally sedative qualities of Jasmine, the composition leads on to a rich, honey-like ambrosial heart with a concentration of blossoms provided by natural Tuberose. This culminates in a powdery, feminine base of intoxicating, Honeysuckle-like Rangoon Creeper. A delicate powder pink colour the lacquered porcelain square-shaped bottle, is appliquéd with the Gucci label ribbed and framed in black. The outer carton is covered inside and outside in Herbarium, a red-and-white toile de Jouy House print of leaves, cherry branches and flowers framed in black. Top Notes: Jasmine. Heart Notes: Tuberose. Base Notes: Rangoon Creeper.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a chypre floral EDP for women conveying the image of a confident wearer brimming with inner strength.The composition features the fruity floral sweetness of the Magnolia flower, its Clary Sage-like edge exuding a joyous spirit. The olfactory melange opens with the juicy citrus notes of Dewberry in sensual unison with the creamy Vanilla freshness of Coconut. This leads on to the floral heart of Magnolia, Jasmine Sambac and calming, warming Clary Sage. The scent culminates in the earthy, intense woodiness of Patchouli and Blonde Woods in a drydown which includes the mellow, leathery undertones of Musk. Gucci's iconic flora pattern, featuring vibrant blooms and rich hues, decorates both the bottle and outer packaging of Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia with its captivating purple shade. Top Notes: Dewberry and Coconut. Heart Notes: Magnolia, Jasmine Sambac and Clary Sage. Base Notes: Musk, Patchouli and Blonde Woods.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Taylor White Diamonds Eau De Toilette 30ml
listings.description: Elizabeth Taylor White Diamonds Eau De Toilette (30ml) is a sheer floral fragrance in which the harmony of flowers and aldehydes in the top notes, together with the sharp base, creates an elegant vintage nuance.This EDT is a timeless fragrance which celebrates the glamour of Elizabeth Taylor. For the classic and sophisticated woman, White Diamonds is a rich and luxurious fragrance with the endless brilliance of a rare jewel. It is the epitome of Elizabeth's star-quality - radiant, glamorous, overwhelmingly beautiful. White Diamonds is a sensual, floral fragrance that imbues its wearer with the glamour and sparkle of her world-famous diamond jewellery collection. Top Notes: Living Amazon Lily and Neroli Bigarade. Heart Notes: Tuberose, Living Jasmin and Living Narcisse Rose. Base Notes: Amber, Oakmoss, Patchouli, and Sandalwood Mysore.

listings.rawTitle: Gres Madame Gres Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Gres Madame Gres Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a floral, oriental fragrance for women. This elegant and sophisticated EDP begins with citrus notes of Grapefruit combined with juicy Pineapple which mingle with spicy notes of Cardamom.The heart provides a graceful bouquet of Magnolia, White Peony and Freesia, creating rich floral tones. The base contribute sensuality, warmth and femininity with soft notes of Vanilla, Sandalwood, Patchouli, providing a unique signature dry down. Top Notes: Pineapple, Grapefruit, Cornflower and Sultan Seeds. Heart Notes: Magnolia, Peony and Freesia. Base Notes: Sandalwood, Vanilla, Patchouli and Leather.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Ysatis Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Givenchy Ysatis Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a tribute to the spirit of liberated femininity, perfectly blending the ethos of sophisticated elegance with joy and sensuality in a spiced floral concoction.This mesmerising EDT by Givenchy begins with the effervescent note of Raspberry Accord, leading to the heart enriched with the exotic Grandiflorum Jasmine Absolute from India, radiating floral freshness. Anchoring the fragrance is the deep and warm note of Vetiver Essence from Haiti, adding a smoky woodiness that complements and balances the preceding notes beautifully, offering a harmonious juxtaposition that speaks of depth and elegance. Top Notes: Raspberry Accord. Heart Notes: Grandiflorum Jasmine Absolute from India. Base Notes: Vetiver Essence from Haiti.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Si Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Giorgio Armani Si Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a timeless floral perfume for the resolute yet graceful woman who is sufficiently self-assured to say 'Si' to the values which best define them. The fragrance conveys the contemporary femininity of Giorgio Armani.This EDP exudes the scent of freshly-laundered sheets drying off in the summer breeze, soft and warm with a hint of sophisticated, creamy sweetness. Intense, voluptuous, and deep, it combines the elegance of Freesia with the delightful honey tones of Rose De Mai Absolute to lend it a certain distinction. The lasting, sensual notes of Oakmoss and Patchouli add captivating softness to this modern chypre. The gold ring which encircles the neck of the Armani Si bottle serves as a symbol of eternity, a perfect wedding, engagement, or anniversary icon. Top Notes: Blackcurrant Liqueur. Heart Notes: Rose de Mai Absolute and Freesia. Base Notes: Patchouli and Oakmoss.

listings.rawTitle: Gloria Vanderbilt Jardin a New York Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Gloria Vanderbilt Jardin à New York Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a floral EDP for women which seeks through its composition to capture the freshness of Central Park with magnificent blossoms and charming accords of delicate white flowers exuding divine scents which are transported on the summer city air.Flower meets wood in this olfactory melange. Woody petitgrain, juicy Pear and fragrant Gardenia release an invigorating, green freshness. Pink Peony, earthy Neroli and intoxicating Jasmine enhance the mix. Top Notes: Gardenia and Petitgrain. Heart Notes: Jasmine, Neroli and Peony. Base Notes: Cedar and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Ange Ou Demon Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Givenchy Ange Ou Demon Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a captivating floral amber EDP that places the noble Lily at its heart, beautifully magnified by the sophisticated elegance of Palisander and Oak Woods. This sensual and elegant scent boasts a high level of natural ingredients, making it a symbol of luxury and femininity, encapsulated within a precious bottle that reflects its exquisite nature.The fragrance opens with the unique blend of White Thyme Essence, Mandarin from Calabria, and Saffron Essence, introducing a vibrant and inviting start. The heart unfolds with the regal presence of Noble Lily, complemented by the exotic aromas of Ylang-Ylang and Orchid Maxillaria, weaving a rich tapestry of floral elegance. The base notes of Tonka Bean, Vanilla, Palisander Wood, and Oak Wood Essence provide a warm and enveloping finish, grounding the fragrance in a deep, mesmerising trail. Top Notes: White Thyme Essence, Mandarin from Calabria, Saffron Essence. Heart Notes: Noble Lily, Ylang-Ylang, Orchid Maxillaria. Base Notes: Tonka Bean, Vanilla, Palisander Wood, Oak Wood Essence.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy L'Interdit Eau De Parfum 80ml
listings.description: Givenchy L'Interdit Eau De Parfum (80ml) unveils the beauty concealed within, marking its stature as an emblematic floral woody fragrance that resonates with your deepest cravings.This enthralling EDP by Givenchy opens with the familiar zest of Ginger, drawing you into its pristine aura. As it evolves, the fragrance reveals a captivating heart imbued with the opulence of Orange Blossom, Jasmine and Tuberose, wrapping you in its luxurious embrace. As it dries, the fragrance indulges in the profound, mesmerising chords of Patchouli and Vetiver, adding depth and intricacy to its allure. The celebrated scent by Givenchy takes you on an odyssey of introspection, inspiring you to acknowledge the shadowed passions within. The fragrance is encased in a classic bottle, its contrasting edges and supple curves mirroring the multifaceted nature of one's identity. Top Notes: Ginger. Heart Notes: Orange Blossom, Jasmine and Tuberose. Base Notes: Patchouli and Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a joyful floral EDP for free-spirited women who abound with positive energy. The composition centres around the Gardenia flower, revered since time immemorial for its splendour and regularly included in elixirs and magic potions. Drawing inspiration from this legendary power, the gorgeous White Gardenia note blends with the smooth, intense florality of Jasmine Grandiflorum Absolute.Opening with a jubilant citrus melange of Pear Blossom accord, Mandarin Orange and Red Berries, the scent moves on to an overtly floral heart combining fragrant Jasmine, spicy and zesty Gardenia and exotic, sultry Frangipani. This culminates in an earthy Patchouli base with Brown Sugar accord adding a delicate sweetness to the silage. The fragrant liquid is housed in an elongated bottle, the lacquered pink glass and shiny gold cap transforming it into an object of beauty. Top Notes: Pear Blossom, Red Berries and Italian Mandarin. Heart Notes: Gardenia, Jasmine and Frangipani. Base Notes: Brown Sugar and Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Armani Code Femme Eau De Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Giorgio Armani Armani Code Femme Eau De Parfum (75ml) is a floral amber EDP for women which conveys the breathless, seductive power experienced in the surprise intimacy and excitement of an unforgettable encounter.Intoxicating and addictive, this fragrance opens with a sensual note of Orange Flower mingling with fresh Ginger accents, which are augmented by a heart of Orange Blossom. This culminates in a creamy, caressing base of Honey and Vanilla. Top Notes: Jasmine and Orange. Heart Notes: Orange Blossom. Base Notes: Honey and Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Taylor White Diamonds Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Elizabeth Taylor White Diamonds Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a sheer floral fragrance in which the harmony of flowers and aldehydes in the top notes, together with the sharp base, creates an elegant vintage nuance.This EDT is a timeless fragrance which celebrates the glamour of Elizabeth Taylor. For the classic and sophisticated woman, White Diamonds is a rich and luxurious fragrance with the endless brilliance of a rare jewel. It is the epitome of Elizabeth's star-quality - radiant, glamorous, overwhelmingly beautiful. White Diamonds is a sensual, floral fragrance that imbues its wearer with the glamour and sparkle of her world-famous diamond jewellery collection. Top Notes: Living Amazon Lily and Neroli Bigarade. Heart Notes: Tuberose, Living Jasmin and Living Narcisse Rose. Base Notes: Amber, Oakmoss, Patchouli, and Sandalwood Mysore.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Eros Pour Homme Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Versace Eros Pour Homme Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a woody, oriental fragrance for the bold, passionate man, embodying excess. Masculine and confident, this sensual EDP evokes Eros - the god of love - bringing charm, passion and seduction splendidly to the fore. Radiant top notes of Italian Lemon and Mandarin are paired with Mint Oil and a unique note of Candied Apple which give way to a heart of Geranium Flower, Clary Sage and Ambermax. In the dry down, Atlas and Virginia Cedarwood, Haitian Vetiver, Indonesian Patchouli and Sandalwood combine with Vanilla, a decadent weapon with its intoxicating and creamy effects and oriental character. The new fragrance is presented in a blue and gold geometric bottle boasting tactile Medusa and Greca details. Top Notes: Italian Lemon, Mandarin, Mint Oil and Candied Apple. Heart Notes: Geranium Flower, Clary Sage Essence and Ambermax. Base Notes: Cedarwood Atlas, Virginia, Vetiver Orpur Essence, Patchouli Coeur, Sandalwood and Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Red Jeans Eau De Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Versace Red Jeans Eau De Toilette (75ml) is a floral, fruity fragrance for women who are young at heart. Light, feminine and intended for everyday wear, this EDT possesses a blend of Jasmine, Vanilla, Musk, Sandalwood and Lily. Top Notes: Peach, Apricot, Freesia and Black Currant. Heart Notes: Rose, Violet, Lily-of-the-Valley, Water Lily and Ylang Ylang. Base Notes: Musk, Sandalwood and Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Crystal Noir Eau De Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Versace Crystal Noir Eau De Parfum (90ml) is a floral, oriental EDP for the charismatic woman, perfect to wear on colder days with its warming aroma of Ginger, and hot notes of Cardamon, and Spicy Pepper.This is followed by the slightly bitter mix of Orange Blossom, Gardenia, and the floral aroma of Peony. The dry down includes warm Sandalwood, Musk, and rare Amber. Top Notes: Cardamom, Ginger and Pepper. Heart Notes: Gardenia, Orange Blossom and Peony. Base Notes: Amber, Musk and Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Woman Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Versace Woman Eau De Parfum (50ml) is an elegant and feminine floral, woody EDP that captures the essence of timeless beauty and sensuality. It is designed for women who exude confidence and grace, making it a perfect addition to any collection. The perfume embraces a harmonious blend of delicate florals and warm, woody notes, offering a versatile scent for both day and evening wear. The fragrance opens with a fresh burst of Frangipani Blossoms and Jasmine, creating a captivating floral introduction. The heart reveals a soft blend of Lotus and Cedarwood, adding a natural depth to the composition. Finally, the base brings a comforting touch of Musk and Amber, rounding off the scent with warmth and sophistication. Top Notes: Frangipani Blossoms, Jasmine. Heart Notes: Lotus, Cedarwood. Base Notes: Musk, Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Uomo Intense Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Valentino Uomo Intense Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a wholly unique EDP by Valentino. Though it can be enjoyed worn by itself, this particular parfum is designed to compliment and fuse seamlessly with other popular Valentino scents, creating a totally unique, personalised perfume to be enjoyed by the wearer. By deeply studying and experimenting with the fine science of fragrance layering, Uomo Intense promises, and entire world of possibility. It is known to work best with fresh fragrances, particularly with powdery and woody notes to illuminate the already musky scent of Uomo Intense.This EDP combines citrus and floral notes with woody subtleties to wrap the wearer in an intense atmosphere. It opens citrus, floral notes of Mandarin Orange and Clary Sage, before developing into a heart of Iris and Tonka Bean which nestles itself upon a bed of Vanilla and Leather. Housed in a faceted, black bottle. Top Notes: Mandarin Orange and Clary Sage. Heart Notes: Iris and Tonka Bean. Base Notes: Vanilla and Leather.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Dreamer Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Versace Dreamer Eau De Toilette (100ml) is an oriental and woody fragrance, intended for the man who knows no limits, who experiences his strength naturally - his elegance spontaneously.The woody, manly and sensual EDT comes from notes of Citrus, Neroli, Bergamot and Petit Grain, resting on a heart of Hyacinth, Clary Sage, Cedar and Geranium, and completed by powerful base notes of Tonka Bean, Musk and Amber. Top Notes: Juniper, Mugwort and Tarragon. Heart Notes: Aerial Flower, Amber Lily and Iris. Base Notes: Amber and Tobacco Flowers.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Uomo Eau De Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Valentino Uomo Eau De Toilette (50ml) is a classically spicy, woody fragrance for men which envelopes the wearer in a refine, masculine atmosphere which inspires confidence and manly sophistication.Comprising a smoky blend of spicy and floral essences, this EDT opens with notes of Bergamot Essence, Lemon Essence and Cardamom Essence, a surprisingly citrusy opening which gradually evolves into a spicy heart of Clary Sage, Lavendin Accord and Black Pepper Essence, lending the fragrance its unexpected strength and character. The base is full of rich and woody notes which leave behind an irresistible trail of Vanilla, Iris, Cedar, and Vetiver. Housed in a multi-faceted, transparent glass bottle which showcases the golden ichor within. Top Notes: Bergamot Essence, Lemon Essence and Cardamom Essence. Heart Notes: Clary Sage Essence, Lavendin Accord and Black Pepper Essence. Base Notes: Cedar Essence, Vetiver Essence, Vanilla Accord and Iris Accord.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Uomo Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Valentino Uomo Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a classically spicy, woody fragrance for men which envelopes the wearer in a refine, masculine atmosphere which inspires confidence and manly sophistication.Comprising a smoky blend of spicy and floral essences, this EDT opens with notes of Bergamot Essence, Lemon Essence and Cardamom Essence, a surprisingly citrusy opening which gradually evolves into a spicy heart of Clary Sage, Lavendin Accord and Black Pepper Essence, lending the fragrance its unexpected strength and character. The base is full of rich and woody notes which leave behind an irresistible trail of Vanilla, Iris, Cedar, and Vetiver. Housed in a multi-faceted, transparent glass bottle which showcases the golden ichor within. Top Notes: Bergamot Essence, Lemon Essence and Cardamom Essence. Heart Notes: Clary Sage Essence, Lavendin Accord and Black Pepper Essence. Base Notes: Cedar Essence, Vetiver Essence, Vanilla Accord and Iris Accord.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Uomo Intense Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Valentino Uomo Intense Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a wholly unique EDP by Valentino. Though it can be enjoyed worn by itself, this particular parfum is designed to compliment and fuse seamlessly with other popular Valentino scents, creating a totally unique, personalised perfume to be enjoyed by the wearer. By deeply studying and experimenting with the fine science of fragrance layering, Uomo Intense promises, and entire world of possibility. It is known to work best with fresh fragrances, particularly with powdery and woody notes to illuminate the already musky scent of Uomo Intense.This EDP combines citrus and floral notes with woody subtleties to wrap the wearer in an intense atmosphere. It opens citrus, floral notes of Mandarin Orange and Clary Sage, before developing into a heart of Iris and Tonka Bean which nestles itself upon a bed of Vanilla and Leather. Housed in a faceted, black bottle. Top Notes: Mandarin Orange and Clary Sage. Heart Notes: Iris and Tonka Bean. Base Notes: Vanilla and Leather.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Bright Crystal Eau De Toilette 30ml
listings.description: Versace Bright Crystal Eau De Toilette (30ml) is a floral and fruity fragrance that is enthralling, voluptuous and eloquent. This EDT perfectly symbolises the glamorous Versace woman, who is strong and sure of her sensual and feminine charm.She is a woman who loves to be enveloped in this fragrance which delicately reveals colourful and juicy Pomegranate grains, iced freshness and shining Yuzu. The beauty of Magnolia, Peonia and Lotus Flower provide voluptuousness and transparency, while Vegetal Amber is delicately sensual and will delight the senses. Top Notes: Pomegranate Grains, Iced Accord and Yuzu. Heart Notes: Magnolia, Peony and Lotus Flower. Base Notes: Plant Amber, Acajou and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Crystal Noir Eau De Toilette 90ml
listings.description: Versace Crystal Noir Eau De Toilette (90ml) is a floral and oriental fragrance with an ethereal yet carnal aspect. Base Notes: Sandalwood, Cashmeran, Vanilla Pod and Heliotropine.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Eros Flame Eau De Parfum 50ml

Simultaneously virile, an ode to passion and a celebration of sensuous rapture, this EDP is characterised by strong contrasts between its ingredients which complement, enrich and enhance one another.The vivacious top notes of fresh, juicy Italian Lemon, Tangerine and Bitter Orange are warmed with notes of Black Pepper from Madagascar and aromatic Wild Rosemary. Base Notes: Texas Cedar, Patchouli Heart, Haitian Vetiver, Mountain Oak Moss Accord and Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Crystal Noir Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Versace Crystal Noir Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a floral, oriental EDP for the charismatic woman, perfect to wear on colder days with its warming aroma of Ginger, and hot notes of Cardamon, and Spicy Pepper.This is followed by the slightly bitter mix of Orange Blossom, Gardenia, and the floral aroma of Peony. The dry down includes warm Sandalwood, Musk, and rare Amber. Top Notes: Cardamom, Ginger and Pepper. Heart Notes: Gardenia, Orange Blossom and Peony. Base Notes: Amber, Musk and Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Bright Crystal Absolu Eau De Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Versace Bright Crystal Absolu Eau De Parfum (90ml) is a sweet, floral fragrance for women, recommended for daytime wear. This sensual scent features delicate notes of colourful, juicy Pomegranate Grains and Japanese Yuzu, blended with a gorgeous fruity and floral heart of Peony, Lotus Flower, Magnolia and Raspberry, wonderfully combined with Musk, Amber and Mahogany. It is presented in a beautiful, pink glass bottle, topped with a large, diamond-cut stopper. Top Notes: Pomegranate, Yuzu and Water. Heart Notes: Peony, Raspberry, Lotus and Magnolia. Base Notes: Musk, Mahogany and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Uomo Born In Roma Intense Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Valentino Uomo Born In Roma Intense Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an enticing amber fougere EDP for men who exude the cool, vibrant energy of Rome's hip streets as the sun sets. This playful yet deeply sensual scent amplifies the addictive nature of the original Uomo Born in Roma fragrance, boasting an explosive personality that remains true to the collection.Opening with the sensual creaminess of Vanilla Bourbon, Uomo Born in Roma Intense captivates with a bewitching blend enhanced by the exotic warmth of Ginger and the Mediterranean spark of Bergamot. The heart features vibrant Lavandin, dancing with the aromatic spice of Nutmeg, heightened by a seductive salty accord. The base culminates in an irresistibly addictive blend of smoky Vetiver and a sophisticated array of woody notes, creating a hypnotic trail. Presented in an iconic studded bottle, this Valentino fragrance for men draws inspiration from Roman architecture and symbolises a rebellious new era in high fashion, led by the fashion house itself. The Born In Roma collection celebrates magnificent personalities and pairings, with Uomo (for him) and Donna (for her), playfully exploring the contrasts between day and night, classic and intensity, and you and me. Top Notes: Vanilla Bourbon, Ginger, Bergamot. Heart Notes: Nutmeg, Lavandin, Salty Accord. Base Notes: Vetiver, Woody Notes.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Eros Pour Homme Eau De Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Versace Eros Pour Homme Eau De Toilette (50ml) is an oriental, fruity EDT for men that personifies masculinity with its intense, vibrant, and glowing freshness, derived from the combination of Mint Leaves, Italian Lemon Zest and Green Apple.An addictive sensuality results from intriguing, oriental elements such as Tonka Beans, Amber, Geranium Flower and Vanilla. Virility, intensity and power are provided by Cedarwood, Vetiver and Oak Moss. Top Notes: Mint, Apple and Lemon. Heart Notes: Tonka Bean, Geranium and Ambroxan. Base Notes: Vanilla, Vetiver, Oak Moss and Cedarwood.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Bonbon Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Viktor & Rolf Bonbon Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a sweet, floral amber EDP for women, characterised by indulgent scents and a Caramel heart, resulting in an addictive perfume.This irresistible composition blends fruity top notes of Mandarin, Orange, and Blackcurrant with heart notes of Jasmine, Orange Blossom and creamy Caramel. Almost good enough to eat, the delicious Caramel notes progress from an intense first impression to a softer and more delicate heart, evolving into a woody base with Cedarwood, Guaiac Wood, Sandalwood, and Amber. Top Notes: Mandarin, Orange and Blackcurrant. Heart Notes: Peach, Jasmine and Orange Blossom. Base Notes: Cedarwood, Guaiac Wood and Caramel.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Voce Viva Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Valentino Voce Viva Eau De Parfum (100ml) a floral, woody EDP for women which seeks to draw a parallel between the sound of your voice and the smell of your fragrance.Opening with refreshing Italian Bergamot, softened by sweet and zesty Mandarin, the composition leads on to an opulent, floral bouquet in the heart where Orange Blossom Absolute melds with golden Gardenia. This culminates in an unexpectedly intense base with Crystal Moss and warm Vanilla blending addictively. The square and sculptured glass bottle reveals the golden scent whilst a Valentino Rockstud highlights the cap and collar. Top Notes: Italian Bergamot Essence and Mandarin Essence. Heart Notes: Orange Blossom Absolute, Golden Gardenia Accord. Base Notes: Crystal Moss Accord, Vanilla and Tonka Bean.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Blue Jeans Eau De Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Versace Blue Jeans Eau De Toilette (75ml) is a woody, citrus and floral fragrance which radiates timeless masculinity and casual coolness.Perfect for everyday use, Versace Blue Jeans comes in a vintage-inspired bottle, featuring denim blue glass. Top Notes: Bergamot, Lemon, Anise and Basil. Heart Notes: Geranium, Rose, Lavender, Jasmine, Sage and Lily. Base Notes: Iris, Sandalwood, Vetiver, Musk, Patchouli and Tonka Bean.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Eau De Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Eau De Toilette (50ml) is a woody, spicy men's EDT, created to reflect the explosive detonation of unrestrained masculinity. This fragrance is presented in a grenade-shaped bottle, encircled by a black band which has ruptured, unable to retain the forceful concoction within.Explosive Chilli and Saffron spices clash head on with the masculinity of Leather and Tobacco and are ignited by the confident power of Vetiver. The zingy fresh notes of Grapefruit and Bergamot are confronted by the iciness of Elemi and Pink Pepper. Top Notes: Pink Pepper, Elemi, Bergamot and Grapefruit. Heart Notes: Cinnamon, Saffron and Paprika. Base Notes: Tobacco, Leather and Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb Eau De Parfum (30ml) is a floral, EDP for women which explodes from the diamond grenade bottle, releasing an eruption of fresh and sweet notes, and depositing you in a world of floral fantasy. This leads on to an opulently floral heart bedecked with intense, sweet, and pure Sambac Jasmine, enticing Centifolia Rose, Freesia, and Cattleya Orchid. In the base, Musk and Patchouli envelope us in an oriental scent, while its milky and powdery elements gently caress our skin. Top Notes: Tea, Bergamot and Osmanthus. Heart Notes: Orchid, Jasmine, Rose, Freesia and African Orange Flower. Base Notes: Patchouli, Musk and Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Donna Born In Roma Intense Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Valentino Donna Born In Roma Intense Eau De Parfum (30ml) is a floral, amber EDP for sophisticated, powerful women who embody the elegance of Rome's modern street culture. This intense and addictive scent pays tribute to the eternal city and its enchanting nights, amplifying the couture elegance of its inspiration.Opening with a captivating blend of Mandarin, Bergamot, and Blackcurrant, this fragrance captures the seductive atmosphere of Rome at dusk. The heart reveals a mesmerising trio of Jasmine, offering a bewitching and passionate embrace. This opulent, luminous floral heart transitions into a warm base of Benzoin and Vanilla, creating a sensuous and irresistible finish. Presented in an iconic studded bottle, Valentino Donna Born In Roma Intense is a nod to the fashion house's rebellious spirit. Drawing inspiration from Roman architecture, the bottle symbolises a new era in high fashion, with the Born In Roma collection celebrating magnificent personalities and pairings through the Uomo (for him) and Donna (for her) duo. Top Notes: Mandarin, Bergamot, Blackcurrant. Heart Notes: Trio of Jasmine. Base Notes: Benzoin, Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Kouros Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent Kouros Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a floral, woody EDT for men which draws inspiration from the gods of ancient Greece, depicting strength, omnipotent masculinity, and a vanquishing spirit.This inspired scent opens with the dominant note of Coriander, energised by Bergamot and empowered by Artemisia. This leads on to a heart blending sensual Clove with the floral notes of Jasmine and the vibrant base of Ambergris and Oakmoss. Top Notes: Aldehydes, Coriander, Clary Sage, Artemisia and Bergamot. Heart Notes: Patchouli, Carnation, Vetiver, Cinnamon, Geranium, Jasmine and Orris Root. Base Notes: Civet, Honey, Leather, Musk, Oakmoss, Amber, Tonka Bean and Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Extreme Eau De Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Extreme Eau De Parfum (90ml) is a woody, spicy men's EDP which reflects an intense, masculine sensuality, restrained for detonation in a black grenade-shaped bottle with a copper restraining strap.This fragrance opens with sparkling Grapefruit top notes, enhanced, and sharpened by notes of Pimento Berries and Black Pepper. This leads on to an aromatic heart which reflects sensuality with its combination of warming Cumin, Cinnamon, and Saffron. The perfume culminates in a dry down of Tobacco strengthened by the balsamic notes of Vanilla and Bourbon and contrasted with sensual, woody Amber. Top Notes: Grapefruit, Pimento Berries and Black Pepper. Heart Notes: Cumin, Cinnamon and Saffron. Base Notes: Tobacco, Vanilla, Bourbon and Amber Wood.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb Tiger Lily Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb Tiger Lily Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an exotic, wild and fierce floral adaptation of the Flower Bomb story blending Solar Coconut Milk, Wild Tiger Lily and Sensual Mango in an enchanting fragrance for the bold and sensual woman who exudes confidence. Awakening your senses, this EDP embraces femininity, harnessing the power of the wild Tiger Lily, conveying confidence and sensuality.The composition opens with a burst of radiant Coconut Milk Accord, creating a solar-like explosion which radiates warmth. Top Notes: Coconut Milk and Bergamot. Heart Notes: Tiger Lily, Jasmine and Freesia. Base Notes: Mango and Benzoin.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Pour Homme Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Versace Pour Homme Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a woody, aromatic fragrance which is the essence of pure masculinity. Diamante Citrus, Bitter Orange Leaves and Neroli Flowers light up this EDT with Mediterranean accents.The heart of Versace Pour Homme is characterised by its mineral-floral aroma of Clary Sage and Blue Hyacinth. Amber and Musk deliver deep and sensual base notes. Top Notes: Lemon, Neroli, Bergamot and Rose de Mai. Heart Notes: Hyacinth, Cedar, Clary Sage and Geranium. Base Notes: Tonka Bean, Musk and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Eau De Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Eau De Parfum (90ml) is a daring fragrance that embodies sultry, provocative and enthralling femininity. This floral gourmand EDP couples energy with sensuality, pushing boundaries and redefining desire in a contemporary light for the modern woman. A trailblazing scent that bewitches with its trail, it is a revolution in a bottle crafted by Marie Salamagne, Nathalie Lorson, Olivier Cresp and Honorine Blanc.The distinctive black coffee accord meets the sensual sweetness of Vanilla, harmonised by the soft allure of White Flowers and Orange Blossom. A comforting base of Patchouli and White Musk enriches the composition, creating an intriguing contrast of light and dark. The ingredients, distilled to their highest quality, result in a captivating, vigorous and vital fragrance, as embodied by YSL Beauty muse Zoë Kravitz. The Black Opium bottle is a marvel of design - feminine, sleek, and dazzling. Adorned with black glitter as if dressed in sequins, the shimmering black of the bottle is contrasted with the pink hue at its core. The radical contours of the bottle silhouette create an edgy and glamorous aesthetic, evoking the sparkling allure of the fragrance within. Top Notes: Pear Accord, Mandarin Essence. Heart Notes: Vanilla, Orange Blossom, White Flowers. Base Notes: Black Coffee Accord, Cedarwood Essence, White Musk, Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Versace L'Homme Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Versace L'Homme Eau De Toilette (100ml) is a woody, oriental fragrance for men, harmoniously blending woods, oriental balms and citrus notes to produce an EDT with an enticing combination of sophisticated, masculine flavours. Top Notes: Lemon, Petit Grain, Basil and Pimento. Heart Notes: Cinnamon, Cedar, Patchouli, Sandalwood and Rose. Base Notes: Oak Moss, Leather, Labdanum, Tonka and Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent La Nuit De L'Homme Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent La Nuit De L'Homme Eau De Toilette (100ml) is an oriental EDT for men which conveys sensuality and seduction, a dark and dangerous character whose overwhelming charisma is not to be resisted.This perfume opens with Bergamot and Cedarwood, leading to a subtle heart blending floral and spicy notes with Violet Leaves and Basil Flowers sharpened by the piquancy and resonance of White Pepper for refined masculinity. This culminates in a base of Sandalwood, Virginia Cedarwood and Haitian Vetiver which serves to emphasise the magnetic vibe. Top Notes: Bergamot, Cedarwood and Ginger. Heart Notes: Violet Leaves, Basil and White Pepper. Base Notes: Vetiver, Sandalwood and Cedarwood.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Born In Roma Donna Yellow Dream Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Valentino Born In Roma Donna Yellow Dream Eau De Parfum (50ml) is a bright, powerful fragrance inspired by the iconic golden sunrise of Rome, known worldwide as the Golden Hour. Bathed in the yellow light of the sun, the Eternal City stirs.This EDP opens with Bergamot Essence, created in the south fields of Italy, complimented by fizzy and zesty Primofiore Lemon. At the heart, Uomo Yellow Dream delves into luxurious notes of Damascan Rose and a delicate Peony scent. A trail of White Musk and Madagascan Vanilla creates an alluring trail of powdery softness. Top Notes: Lemon and Italian Bergamot. Heart Notes: Damascan Rose and Peony. Base Notes: White Musk and Madagascan Vanilla.
